41956cb3.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
41956cb3.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
 Senior Technical Program Manager
   

  

**Overview**
 Foundational Data \& Model Services sits in Data \& AI Foundations, inside Business \& Market Insights. We own the data that B\&MI's analytics and insights products are built on: the pipelines that bring it in, the data models that shape it, and the standards that keep it consistent for everyone downstream. When a product team needs transaction data modelled a particular way, or a new source onboarded, or a definition that means the same thing in two products, that is us.
   

  

 About half the estate is Hadoop and Hive with on\-prem ETL that has been running for years and still serves live products. The other half is Databricks, and we are moving the rest across. The work is two things at once: keeping the old platform reliable while it is still load\-bearing, and rebuilding the data models properly on the new one rather than lifting and shifting what is already there.
   

  

 The team itself is new, brought together from teams that used to sit apart, and the roadmap is still being written. Plenty is undecided. If that reads as an opportunity rather than a risk, you will enjoy this.
   

  

 Role
   

  

 You Will Own The Delivery Plan Across The Squads Doing This Work, And Manage The Dependencies Between Them, The Platform Teams We Rely On, And The Product Teams Waiting On Us. Specifically, You Will
   

  

 Own delivery of the shared data models and pipelines that several product teams depend on, where success is adoption rather than features shipped.
   

  

 Run the migration off Hadoop and on\-prem ETL onto Databricks: sequencing, cutover, and actually switching the old thing off.
   

  

 Keep the legacy platform's operational commitments visible in the plan, so migration work does not quietly starve the systems still in production.
   

  

 Broker the dependencies we do not control, working with central platform, cloud operations and data governance teams.
   

  

 Run vendor and partner engagement: roadmap alignment, milestone tracking, performance against commitments.
   

  

 Bring enough technical depth to challenge decisions on data modelling, pipeline design and data quality, and to explain the trade\-offs to business stakeholders without flattening them.
   

  

 Set how a new team plans and reports: intake, prioritization, cadence, and what leadership sees each month.
   

  

**All About You**
 We do not expect any one person to bring all of this, so apply if most of it fits.
   

  

 Experience running technical programs in data engineering, data platforms or analytics infrastructure.
   

  

 Working knowledge of the stack on both sides of the migration: Hadoop, Hive and traditional ETL on one side, Databricks, Spark and orchestration tooling such as Airflow on the other. Strong SQL throughout. Enough to scope work and spot risk without an engineer translating every conversation.
   

  

 Experience of platform migrations where the old system stays live throughout and the decommissioning is the hard part.
   

  

 Understanding of data modelling and why it matters: schemas, lineage, common definitions, and what breaks downstream when they drift.
   

  

 Understanding of data governance, access control and handling customer data in a regulated business.
   

  

 A track record of getting internal teams to adopt shared platforms, which comes down to persuasion, evidence and follow\-through rather than mandate.
   

  

 Comfortable with ambiguity: able to build a credible plan before every input is settled, and to change it without treating that as a failure.
   

  

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
   

  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

8292473d.title: Staff Technical Program Manager
8292473d.description:
**About Rippling**
 Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
   

  

 Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
   

  

 Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.8B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
   

  

 We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a highly accomplished Technical Program Manager (TPM) — at the Staff level — to play a pivotal role in spearheading our product development and geographic expansion initiatives. This strategic role requires a deep technical background to effectively partner with product managers and engineering managers, providing technical leadership to own the execution plan and deliver complex, cross\-team engineering initiatives. You will be the champion for predictable and timely delivery, able to take ownership of and drive the mitigation of risks to the program, and skilled in facilitating quantifiable success across diverse engineering and product teams. Your core responsibility is to ensure the predictable delivery of products by actively engaging in technical discussions, identifying and proactively resolving dependencies and technical blockers, mitigating architectural risks, and applying best\-in\-class program management practices.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
 Technical Strategy \& Planning
   

  

* Drive strategic, cross\-functional planning and prioritization, partnering with Product and Engineering leadership to develop comprehensive program plans, including roadmap definition, dependency mapping, and resourcing models.
* Drive the process of translating high\-level business and product requirements into actionable, concrete engineering tasks, milestones, and technical specifications.
* Contribute to the definition and tracking of effective technical metrics, driving improvements that optimize engineering operating performance and system health.


 Technical Execution \& Delivery
   

  

* Lead and facilitate regular program\-level meetings and reviews with Product and Engineering leadership to ensure projects achieve successful outcomes.
* Proactively monitor program health, tracking status, risks, issues, and complex technical dependencies across engineering teams.
* Deep dive into technical issues to facilitate resolution, and drive appropriate executive\-level escalations and program\-level change management processes as\-needed.
* Take personal ownership of engineering roadblocks and technical delays, escalating issues appropriately and driving them to timely closure by working directly with engineering leads.


 Process \& Communication
   

  

* Manage high\-level program communications, ensuring all stakeholders—from delivery teams to executive management—are consistently informed of roadmap changes, release plans, and delivery status, with a clear explanation of technical trade\-offs and risks.
* Establish, document, and champion the adoption of new program frameworks, tools, and best practices across the R\&D organization.
* Act as an agent of change, helping to establish and strengthen the Technical Program Management function across the company.


**Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of experience as TPM, Engineering Lead, Manager, or equivalent working directly with software engineering teams.
* Proven track record to communicate technical issues effectively to technical and non\-technical partners at different levels of the organization.
* Proven ability to build and implement detailed plans accounting for ambiguity, dependencies, and technical complexity in a fast\-moving environment.
* Demonstrated excellence in the practice of technical program management, especially in establishing TPM processes from scratch.
* Highly skilled in pragmatically identifying, tracking and reporting on cross team dependencies and collaboratively addressing them effectively with providing/receiving teams.
* Demonstrated attention to detail and a hands\-on disposition.
* Excellent problem solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Proven ability to handle multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Outstanding ability to effectively communicate across all levels of the organization from engineers to executives.
* Four\-year Computer Science, Engineering, Business or related degree, or equivalent work experience.


**Additional Information**
 Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com
   

  

 Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.

94d17d78.title: Security Architect
94d17d78.description:
**Project Role :** Security Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Define the cloud security framework and architecture, ensuring it meets the business requirements and performance goals. Document the implementation of the cloud security controls and transition to cloud security\-managed operations.
  

**Must have skills :** Industry X Security  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:  

  

As an OT Security Consultant, your typical day involves assessing, designing, and enhancing cybersecurity controls for Operational Technology (OT), Industrial Control Systems (ICS), and SCADA environments. You will work closely with clients to identify security risks, develop remediation strategies, and implement robust security solutions to protect critical industrial assets. You will leverage your expertise in cybersecurity frameworks, industrial control systems, security assessments, and risk management to deliver secure and resilient OT environments. Your role also includes contributing to the development of new cybersecurity service offerings, supporting business development initiatives, and driving innovation in industrial security practices.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:  

Expected to perform independently and become an SME.  

Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.  

Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.  

Provide subject matter expertise in the execution of Operational Technology (OT) security workshops, risk assessments, and remediation engagements.  

Conduct security reviews and assessments of OT, ICS, and SCADA environments to identify security gaps and recommend improvements.  

Develop cybersecurity strategies, operating models, roadmaps, and security enhancement plans for clients.  

Lead solution engineering activities and oversee project delivery for OT security engagements.  

Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical security solutions.  

Support the development of new industrial cybersecurity products, services, and offerings to reduce cyber risk in OT environments.  

Perform security research, consulting, and security assessments covering OT Security, ICS Security, SCADA Security, Network Security, Embedded Security, and Industrial Security domains.  

Architect, recommend, and implement security solutions for industrial control systems, applications, data, assets, and personnel.  

Support presales activities, proposal development, scope definition, and marketing initiatives for OT security services.  

Assist in building internal industrial security capabilities, methodologies, frameworks, and best practices.  

Mentor junior team members and contribute to organizational knowledge sharing initiatives.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:  

Must To Have Skills: Operational Technology (OT) Security, Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Security, SCADA Security, Network Security.  

Good To Have Skills: Web Penetration Testing, Infrastructure Security Testing, Endpoint Security Testing, Application Security Testing, IoT/IIoT Security.  

Minimum 5\-6 years of experience in security research, consulting, and security assessments covering OT Security, ICS Security, SCADA Security, and Network Security.  

Preferred experience in Web, Infrastructure, IoT/IIoT, Endpoint, and Application Penetration Testing.  

Extensive expertise in cybersecurity with a strong focus on OT and Industrial Control System security.  

Comprehensive understanding of SCADA systems, PLCs, DCS, HMIs, and industrial control devices.  

Strong knowledge of cybersecurity standards and frameworks including ISA/IEC 62443, NIST SP 800\-82, NERC CIP, and IEC 61511\.  

Experience in performing risk assessments, incident management, and security strategy development within OT environments.  

Proficiency in administering and managing industrial cybersecurity platforms and OT monitoring solutions.  

Strong understanding of software and hardware technologies commonly used in ICS environments, including operating systems, databases, and programming languages.  

Hands\-on experience with industrial cybersecurity tools and technologies such as Nozomi, Dragos, Tenable, Network Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS), and industrial firewalls.  

Experience with vulnerability research, threat modeling, security code reviews, reverse engineering, exploitation techniques, and security testing methodologies including fuzzing and penetration testing.  

Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple engagements and stakeholders effectively.  

  

Additional Information:  

The candidate should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in Operational Technology (OT) Security and Industrial Control Systems (ICS) Security.  

Experience in developing OT security capabilities, service offerings, frameworks, and solutions will be an added advantage.  

Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential.  

Demonstrated ability to work effectively and deliver results within cross\-functional teams.  

This position is based at multiple location.  

A 15 years full time education is required.

1085350f.title: Security Architect
1085350f.description:
**Project Role :** Security Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Define the cloud security framework and architecture, ensuring it meets the business requirements and performance goals. Document the implementation of the cloud security controls and transition to cloud security\-managed operations.
  

**Must have skills :** Industry X Security  

**Good to have skills :** NA  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

  

As an Application Security Consultant, your typical day involves performing security assessments, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing across web applications, mobile applications, APIs, cloud environments, and network infrastructures. You will be responsible for identifying security vulnerabilities, recommending remediation strategies, and implementing robust security controls to protect critical business assets. You will leverage your expertise in application security, threat modeling, security testing methodologies, DevSecOps practices, and security frameworks to enhance the organization's security posture while supporting clients in managing evolving cyber threats.  

  

Roles \& Responsibilities:  

  

Expected to perform independently and become an SME.  

Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.  

Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.  

Perform security assessments, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing across web applications, mobile applications, APIs, cloud platforms, and network environments.  

Conduct security research and vulnerability analysis to identify emerging threats and security risks.  

Architect, strategize, recommend, and implement application security solutions to address business and technical security requirements.  

Perform threat modeling, secure code reviews, vulnerability assessments, reverse engineering, and security testing activities.  

Lead solution engineering activities and oversee project delivery for security engagements.  

Collaborate with business development and solution engineering teams to translate business opportunities into security solutions and technical requirements.  

Support the development of new cybersecurity capabilities, services, frameworks, and offerings.  

Assist in presales activities, proposal development, and marketing initiatives related to Application Security, Cloud Security, and Industrial Security services.  

Provide guidance and recommendations on secure development lifecycle practices and security best practices.  

Work closely with cross\-functional teams to integrate security throughout the software development and deployment lifecycle.  

Mentor team members and contribute to knowledge\-sharing initiatives across the organization.  

  

Professional \& Technical Skills:  

  

Must To Have Skills: Application Security, Web Application Security, Mobile Application Security (Android \& iOS), API Security, Cloud Security, Network Security, Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT).  

Good To Have Skills: Container Security, Embedded Security, IoT/IIoT Security, DevSecOps.  

Minimum 6 years of experience in Security Research, Security Consulting, Security Assessments, and Penetration Testing engagements.  

Strong expertise in architecting, strategizing, recommending, and implementing security solutions.  

Extensive experience with security threats, vulnerability research, and secure software development lifecycle best practices.  

Hands\-on experience in threat modeling, security code reviews, vulnerability assessments, reverse engineering, exploitation techniques, mitigation development, fuzzing, and penetration testing.  

Experience with Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Dynamic Application Security Testing (DAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and Threat Modeling methodologies.  

Hands\-on experience with industry\-standard security testing tools including Burp Suite, Metasploit, Nessus, Fortify SCA, WebInspect, Black Duck, IBM AppScan, Acunetix, Netsparker, Wireshark, Nmap, Drozer, and Kali Linux.  

Strong understanding of Windows and Linux operating systems from a security testing perspective.  

Experience in programming and scripting languages such as Java, Python, Perl, and Ruby.  

Familiarity with DevSecOps practices and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.  

Good exposure to cybersecurity standards and frameworks including PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST, OWASP, WASC, HIPAA, SOX, and MITRE ATT\&CK Framework.  

Ability to lead solution engineering engagements and manage end\-to\-end security project delivery.  

Strong understanding of risk management, security architecture, and secure application development practices.  

Mandatory possession of one or more industry\-recognized security certifications such as CEH, CHFI, ECSA, OSCP, CISSP, CISO, CISM, CompTIA Security\+, or GSEC.  

  

Additional Information:  

  

The candidate should have a minimum of 6 years of experience in Application Security, Security Consulting, and Penetration Testing.  

Experience supporting security presales activities, capability development, and cybersecurity service creation will be an added advantage.  

Strong written and verbal communication skills are essential.  

Demonstrated ability to deliver results while working effectively in cross\-functional teams.  

Experience in secure software development lifecycle practices and DevSecOps implementation is preferred.  

This position is based at multiple locations.  

A 15 years full time education is required.


  

15 years full time education

360d5b07.title: Presales Architect
360d5b07.description:
This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Job Description**
***Job Family Definition:***
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know diverse backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
   

  

**Global Sales** 
 at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000\+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector \& small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Contributions have visible technical impact on a product or major subcomponent. Applies in\-depth professional knowledge and innovative ideas to solve complex problems. Visible contributions improve time\-to\-market, achieve cost reductions, or satisfy current and future unmet customer needs. Recognized internal authority on key technology area applying innovative principles and ideas. Provides technical leadership for significant project/program work. Leads or participates in cross\-functional initiatives and contributes to mentorship and knowledge sharing across the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What you’ll do:**
* Demonstrates unique mastery within the company in one or more solution domains as well as the customer's technical and business environment.
* Orchestrates the design of complex proposals to deliver and communicate tangible business value to customers.
* Mitigates risk to the company by managing both customer and company stakeholder expectations.
* Critical review proposal, applies market intelligence and thought leadership to translate the functional view into a technical view, enhancing proposed workload\-optimized solutions.
* Provides input to all global business units to address key end\-customer IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.
* Leads the team to develop and present high\-level, unique, and imaginative outcome\-based solutions to customer business challenges, translating the business needs of the customer into a functional solution design aligned to those needs.
* Communicates HPE’s end solution value propositions in the language of the customer and demonstrates how the proposition aligns to business outcomes and customer needs.
* Develops and maintains adjacent technology knowledge, along with in\-depth knowledge of current and emerging technologies and trends.
* Contributes to the industry for one or more domains with an active presence at conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support), social media, business events, etc.
* Monitors changing competitive landscape (emerging competitors, start\-ups etc.).
* Drives the Account Business Planning process, leverage knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.
* Facilitates and leads deep\-dive discussions with the client and accounts teams to build customer relationships, understand business needs, evaluate the customer's ecosystem and advocate and present technical strategies for a customer's transformation.
* Identifies acceptable technical solution trade\-offs, risks, and suggests possible remediation.
* Drives collaboration among internal account teams, sets direction, provides guidance, and engages the full portfolio of partners to build effective solution strategies aligned to customer's technical and business challenges.
* Successfully transfers knowledge to external partners to deliver an effective solution to the customer.
* Proactively builds the pipeline by identifying opportunities (e.g., enhancements, unmet or unrecognized needs, up\-selling, and cross\-selling opportunities) within the account.
* Monitors the account pipeline and nurtures active deals from the opportunity to close.
* Uses pipeline insights to help prioritize activities in a way that ensures time, and resources are invested wisely in pursuit of deals with the highest potential.
* Actively participates in sales forecast meetings and provides feedback to accelerate the sales lifecycle.
* Documents ongoing work (activities, tasks) throughout the sales cycle using specific tools and resources and sharing best practices with peers and partners to collaborate more effectively.
* Engages with and builds consultative presence and advisory influence with VPs, CxO, and line\-of\-business (LOB) management and customer thought leaders.
* Anticipates customer needs and proactively engages partners and resources to design innovative solutions and generate customer demand.
* Proactively shares knowledge with peers and actively helps develop knowledge and expertise within the Presales community.


**Education And Experience**
**What you need to bring:**
* Advanced degree in technology or related field preferred, or equivalent technical qualifications
* 12\+ years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling;
* 2\+ Industry standard relevant technology certifications or equivalent experience expected.
* Enterprise architecture frameworks and project management methodologies and certifications are helpful, but not required.


**Knowledge And Skills**
* Unique mastery and experience leading solution configurations and overall architecture design and creating, managing, and positioning demos and proofs\-of\-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.
* Unique mastery of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, and adjacent solution domain(s), showing how they can be combined to address customer needs, and how the workload solution can be adapted for strategic customer and industry solutions.
* Unique mastery with expertise and deep working knowledge with the as\-a\-service (aaS) business model, business value, and complete ecosystem and how that drives aaS strategic goals within one or more domains.
* Expert ability to collaborate cross\-functionally and across HPE to generate new revenue through increased subscription consumption and other aaS models.
* Mastery of executive\-level written, verbal and nonverbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, with ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages as need to perform job requirements.
* Demonstrates unique mastery of discussion and persuasion skills used to support company point\-of\-view, while respectfully questioning and challenging proposed solutions.
* Unique mastery of financial and business acumen\- sales cycle, funnel management, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage \- including typical KPIs important to CxOs; knowledgeable about TCO/ROI concepts and calculations, financial models, and understand how customers generate revenue.
* Unique mastery of consultative and value selling skills, advisory influence, and executive gravitas, including presenting, white boarding, storytelling, objection\-handling, and closing skills.
* Unique mastery of company business knowledge, technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems and tools.
* Strong resource management skills, including how and when to effectively engage SMEs/specialists.
* Hands on experience with multiple products, solutions, tools, or services aligned to respective job responsibility.
* Ability to design and develop a playbook for demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service.
* Ability to deliver live demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service to customers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Unique mastery of project and time management skills or experience with excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, including appropriate due diligence.
* Unique mastery of partner offerings and how/when to leverage them for deals within an area of specialization.
* Unique mastery of and understanding of company’s preferred go\-to\-market strategy, global context, coverage options relative to partners and has expert knowledge of partner offerings, along with how/when to leverage them for deals within area of specialization.
* Unique mastery of strategic planning and account planning skills and expert at using business and technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems.


**Accessibility**
 HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
   

  

 Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
   

  

**What We Can Offer You**
**Health \& Wellbeing**
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

**Personal \& Professional Development**
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
   

  

**Unconditional Inclusion**
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.
   

  

**Let's Stay Connected**

59f7338b.title: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Data Cloud) Architect
59f7338b.description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/23/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Work Experience 5\+ years
* Remote Job
### **Job Description**


This is a remote position.


Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Data Cloud) Architect  

  

  

Job Details
  

* **Employment Type:** Contract
* **Work Mode:** Remote
* **Location:** Offshore
* **Total Experience Required:** 6 to 10 years
* **Relevant Experience Required:** 3\+ years of dedicated architecture and implementation experience within the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Data/Journeys) ecosystem
* **Mandatory Certification:** Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (Journeys) Functional Consultant Associate or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert

  

Job Summary
  

We are seeking an experienced **Dynamics 365 Customer Insights Architect** to design, secure, and optimize our enterprise Customer Data Platform (CDP) and engagement engine. The ideal candidate will orchestrate multi\-source data ingestion streams, map identity resolution rules, configure calculated metrics, and establish real\-time activation loops to power downstream personalization, customer segmentations, and automated marketing journeys.  

  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

* **Design and govern the global Customer Insights data architecture**, configuring real\-time data ingestion pipelines from Microsoft Dataverse, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, and external third\-party transactional networks.
* **Architect complex Identity Resolution rules**, establishing data unification parameters, deduplication logic, match/merge profiles, and unified Customer 360 schemas.
* **Build advanced calculated insights and measures**, utilizing custom SQL\-based metrics, behavioral attributes, and predictive models to score customer lifetime values and churn probabilities.
* **Design high\-impact, omni\-channel customer journeys**, configuring dynamic audience segmentation rules, real\-time trigger events, and personalized content loops across communication channels.
* **Establish secure platform integration blueprints**, constructing data streaming flows connecting Customer Insights with Power BI dashboards, core Dynamics apps (Sales/Service), and external API endpoints.
* **Enforce absolute data privacy and governance guardrails**, managing role\-based access controls (RBAC), multi\-tenant compliance frameworks, and corporate data scrubbing rules (GDPR/CCPA).
* **Audit platform operations and processing latencies**, monitoring ingestion sync health, data refresh cycles, segment processing times, and API limit throttles.

  

  

### **Requirements**


* **6 to 10 years** of enterprise data engineering, CRM consulting, or marketing technology experience, with **3\+ dedicated years** actively designing, building, and maintaining setups explicitly on the Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Insights (formerly Customer Data Platform) framework.
* **Strong technical mastery** of Microsoft Dataverse, Power Platform structures, Azure data ecosystem tools (Data Lake, Synapse), SQL, advanced segmentation logic, and REST APIs.
* **Deep structural understanding** of big data concepts, semantic data modeling, customer lifecycle matrices, identity resolution strategies, and cloud governance frameworks.
* **Mandatory certification:** Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights Associate or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert.

  

Preferred Qualifications
  

* Prior experience implementing **Azure AI/ML studio integrations** to feed custom predictive models directly into Customer Insights profile grids.
* Familiarity with real\-time web/mobile tracking integrations utilizing JavaScript SDKs or enterprise tag management tools.

87646a84.title: Junior Architect
87646a84.description:
Junior Architect

Location: Calicut, Kerala – Onsite

Workplace: Kidzink Calicut Office, Office 2604, Tower 2, HiLITE Business Park, Palazhi, Kozhikode, Kerala

Experience: 2\+ years

Employment Type: Permanent

Salary: ₹30,000 – ₹55,000 per month

About the Role

We are looking for a passionate, energetic and motivated Junior Architect who wants to be actively involved in shaping projects, developing design ideas and taking responsibility for delivering high\-quality work.

The role offers hands\-on exposure to education\-led architecture, interior, fit\-out and construction projects, with involvement across design development, technical documentation, coordination and project delivery.

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, thinks critically, solves problems and takes ownership of their work, with a genuine ambition to grow as an architect.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and contribute to architectural and interior design concepts from initial ideas through design development.
* Prepare and develop plans, elevations, sections, details, presentations and technical documentation.
* Translate design concepts into practical and buildable solutions.
* Coordinate architectural design with interior, structural, MEP, FF\&E, landscape and specialist consultants.
* Work closely with senior architects, designers, technical teams, consultants and contractors.
* Participate in design reviews, coordination meetings, client discussions and site visits.
* Identify design and technical issues and proactively work towards practical solutions.
* Assist with material selections, specifications, BOQs, schedules and construction documentation.
* Review drawings and information to ensure accuracy, coordination and design intent are maintained.
* Support projects through construction and develop an understanding of how design decisions translate into the built environment.
* Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliverables, ensuring they are completed to a high standard and within agreed timelines.

Required Skills \& Experience

* 2\+ years of professional experience in architecture, interior design, fit\-out or a related field.
* Bachelor's degree in Architecture or equivalent.
* Strong interest and understanding of architectural design and design development.
* Ability to develop ideas and contribute meaningfully to the design process.
* Good understanding of architectural drawings, detailing, materials, construction principles and buildability.
* Ability to translate design concepts and ideas into clear and coordinated project information.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to design quality.
* Good communication, coordination, organisation and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities and work with an appropriate level of independence.
* Ability to manage priorities and deliver high\-quality work within agreed programmes.
* Positive attitude, strong work ethic and genuine willingness to learn and develop.

Preferred Skills \& Experience

* Experience in education, hospitality, retail or premium commercial fit\-out projects.
* Exposure to multidisciplinary design coordination.
* Experience with BIM\-based workflows and model coordination.
* Exposure to construction documentation, site coordination or project delivery.
* Experience working with international design consultants, clients or project teams.
* Interest in developing a long\-term career within a design\-led, multi\-geography organisation.

What Success Looks Like

* Assigned design responsibilities are owned and progressed proactively with minimal follow\-up required.
* The architect actively contributes ideas and solutions rather than simply responding to instructions.
* Design work is thoughtful, well resolved and aligned with the project brief and overall design intent.
* Accurate, coordinated and well\-presented drawings and project information are delivered within programme.
* Design and technical issues are identified early, communicated clearly and followed through towards resolution.
* The architect demonstrates increasing confidence and independence in developing and presenting design solutions.
* Technical, design, software and project delivery knowledge continue to develop through each project.
* Feedback is actively sought, understood and applied to improve future work.
* The candidate demonstrates a growing understanding of materials, detailing, construction and buildability.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹55,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

8c171608.title: Senior Consultant SAP FI/CO (Solution Manager)
8c171608.description:
At Dow, we believe in putting people first and we’re passionate about delivering integrity, respect and safety to our customers, our employees and the planet.
   

  

 Our people are at the heart of our solutions. They reflect the communities we live in and the world where we do business. Their diversity is our strength. We’re a community of relentless problem solvers that offers the daily opportunity to contribute with your perspective, transform industries and shape the future. Our purpose is simple \- to deliver a sustainable future for the world through science and collaboration. If you’re looking for a challenge and meaningful role, you’re in the right place.
   

  

**About You And This Role**
 The Solution Manager is responsible for supporting, enhancing, and evolving business applications and digital solutions that enable critical business processes. This role serves as a trusted partner between business stakeholders and IT, providing functional expertise, solution design, application support, continuous improvement, and delivery of technology\-enabled business capabilities.  He or she manages solutions throughout their lifecycle, including analysis, design, implementation, adoption, optimization, support, and retirement. The role works closely with Sr. Solution Managers, business process owners, developers, vendors, and end users to ensure reliable, secure, and value\-driven technology solutions.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Application Lifecycle Management**
* Manage applications and digital solutions through their full lifecycle.
* Support application roadmaps, upgrades, enhancements, and retirement activities.
* Ensure solutions remain secure, compliant, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, automate, and optimize business processes.


**Business Partnership \& Solution Ownership**
* Partner with business stakeholders to understand process requirements and strategic priorities.
* Translate business needs into solution requirements and functional designs.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for assigned applications and business processes.
* Drive alignment between technology capabilities and business objectives.


**Project Delivery \& Continuous Improvement**
* Participate in project planning, requirements gathering, testing, deployment, and change management activities.
* Coordinate and execute functional testing, user acceptance testing, and production support activities.
* Support implementation of new capabilities, SAP enhancements, integrations, automation, AI, and digital initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement efforts by identifying and implementing process efficiencies.


**Operational Support**
* Resolve production incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.
* Analyze root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
* Monitor application health, performance, and user adoption.
* Collaborate with development teams, vendors, and global support organizations to resolve issues.


**Stakeholder Engagement**
* Build strong relationships with business customers and IT partners.
* Communicate solution status, risks, and recommendations effectively.
* Support knowledge transfer, user training, and documentation activities.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance, or related field.
* Min experience of 8\-15 years on the role.
* SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA experience.
* Knowledge of SAP FI/CO, and MM modules.
* Experience supporting enterprise business applications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong data management experience.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
* Understanding of application support, testing, and change management processes.
* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Your Skills**
* Experience with SAP and non SAP systems integrations such as APIs, XML, IDOC.
* Experience with Azure, Power Platform, automation, reporting, and analytics solutions.
* Understanding of financial processes, controls, and compliance requirements.
* Experience leading small\-to\-medium projects and enhancement initiatives.
* SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA experience.
* Knowledge of SAP FI, CO, and MM modules.
* Experience in managing teams.
* Experience supporting enterprise business applications.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong data management experience.
* Experience gathering and documenting business requirements.
* Understanding of application support, testing, and change management processes.
* Ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.


**Additional Notes**
* The ability to accommodate a flexible schedule aligned with international time zones is essential.
* No Relocation support is provided on the role.


**Benefits – What Dow Offers You**
 We invest in you.
   

  

 Dow invests in total rewards programs to help you manage all aspects of you: your pay, your health, your life, your future, and your career. You bring your background, talent, and perspective to work every day. Dow rewards that commitment by investing in your total wellbeing.
   

  

 Here are just a few highlights of what you would be offered as a Dow employee:
   

  

* Equitable and market\-competitive base pay and bonus opportunity across our global markets, along with locally relevant incentives.
* Benefits and programs to support your physical, mental, financial, and social well\-being, to help you get the care you need...when you need it.
* Competitive retirement program that may include company\-provided benefits, savings opportunities, financial planning, and educational resources to help you achieve your long term financial\-goals.

c8e7abaa.title: Customer Solutions Engineer
c8e7abaa.description:
Customer Solutions Engineer \- Forward Deployment Engineering
 




  






 Company: KAVIA AI
 





 Location: India — Remote
 





 Type: Full\-time
 





 Reports to: Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering
 





 Experience: 4–8 years
 





 Compensation: INR 20,00,000 to INR 28,00,000 annual CTC, based on background, experience, and demonstrated customer\-facing technical ownership
 




  






 About KAVIA AI
 





 KAVIA AI is an enterprise software company building the enterprise software engineering platform for complex codebases.
 





 We help engineering teams understand, plan, change, and validate large software systems. KAVIA connects code understanding, workflow automation, artifact generation, reviewable code, and validation across repositories and environments.
 





 Our platform is used by enterprise teams working on consequential software systems. As KAVIA’s product and customer footprint grow, we are expanding the customer engineering capability that turns difficult technical use cases into successful pilots and production adoption.
 




  






 The Role
 





 This is a hands\-on, customer\-facing engineering role at a growing enterprise software company. At KAVIA, the Customer Solutions Engineer serves as a Forward Deployed Engineer: part software engineer, part technical problem solver, and part pilot owner.
 





 Reporting to KAVIA’s Chief Operating Officer and Head of Customer Solutions Engineering, you will work closely with enterprise engineering customers, KAVIA’s product and engineering teams, and company leadership. You will understand a customer’s codebase and operating constraints, demonstrate KAVIA against the right problem, translate that problem into a tightly scoped pilot, and stay accountable through technical validation.
 





 Success in this role is not measured by the number of demos delivered. It is measured by whether KAVIA earns technical confidence: the right problem is selected, the evaluation is credible, blockers are resolved, results are documented, and the customer can make an informed production decision.
 





 This is not a conventional sales\-engineering role built around standard demonstrations, and it is not a support role limited to routing issues. You must be comfortable reading unfamiliar code, working directly in technical environments, and communicating clearly with both engineers and senior stakeholders. The role requires regular overlap with US and European business hours and may include occasional customer travel.
 




  





 What You’ll Do
 

 Lead Technical Discovery
 
* Run structured discovery with engineering leaders, architects, developers, and other technical stakeholders.
* Understand the customer’s codebase, architecture, repositories, build and test systems, development workflow, constraints, and desired outcome.
* Separate the stated request from the underlying engineering problem, and identify where KAVIA can create measurable value.
* Surface dependencies, security or deployment requirements, data\-access constraints, technical risks, and decision criteria early.
* Determine whether an opportunity is technically ready for a demonstration or pilot, and say so clearly when it is not.



 Prepare and Deliver Tailored Demonstrations
 
* Design demonstrations around the customer’s actual use case rather than rely on a generic product walkthrough.
* Select representative code, workflows, and evidence that make KAVIA’s value understandable and technically credible.
* Configure and test the demonstration environment, anticipate likely questions, and prepare recovery paths when live systems behave unexpectedly.
* Explain KAVIA’s reasoning, outputs, limitations, and deployment options with precision and without overclaiming.
* Capture questions and objections, follow up with clear technical answers, and identify what must be proven next.



 Convert Use Cases into Well\-Scoped Pilots
 
* Translate discovery into a concise pilot definition with a clear problem statement, scope, inputs, deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, schedule, and acceptance criteria.
* Define success measures that compare KAVIA\-assisted work with the customer’s current process, including time, effort, quality, completeness, or validation outcomes where appropriate.
* Keep pilots narrow enough to execute quickly while meaningful enough to support a purchase or deployment decision.
* Align customer and internal stakeholders on what is in scope, what is not, and what evidence will constitute success before work begins.



 Own Pilot Execution and Resolve Technical Blockers
 
* Serve as the technical owner for assigned pilots from kickoff through final validation.
* Work directly with repositories, manifests, branches, build systems, APIs, development environments, and deployment configurations as required by the engagement.
* Use KAVIA hands\-on to investigate the customer’s problem, generate or review outputs, and validate results against agreed criteria.
* Diagnose blockers, distinguish product issues from environment or integration issues, and coordinate the right engineering response without losing momentum.
* Maintain a clear execution plan, technical decision log, risk list, and next action for every active pilot.
* Escalate product gaps and delivery risks early, with enough evidence for engineering and leadership to act.



 Move Customers to Technical Validation
 
* Design and run the final validation against the agreed acceptance criteria, including build, test, review, or workflow evidence where applicable.
* Present results honestly, including what worked, what remains unresolved, and what would be required for production use.
* Quantify before\-and\-after outcomes when the evidence supports them and avoid unsupported or inflated claims.
* Produce the technical readout, recommendations, open issues, and proposed next step needed for the customer and KAVIA to make a decision.
* Support the transition from successful pilot to deployment, expansion, or a clearly defined follow\-on phase.



 Turn Customer Learning into Reusable Assets
 
* Write concise technical follow\-ups, solution notes, pilot plans, validation summaries, runbooks, and implementation guidance.
* Contribute credible technical evidence and approved results to case studies, sales collateral, product documentation, and enablement material.
* Convert repeated customer patterns into reusable demo assets, pilot templates, checklists, and internal playbooks.
* Bring structured customer feedback to product and engineering, distinguishing one\-off requests from broadly valuable product improvements.
* Help improve KAVIA’s customer\-engineering methods as the company builds a repeatable enterprise adoption motion.



 What We’re Looking For
 

 Required
 
* 4–8 years of professional software engineering, solutions engineering, implementation engineering, or forward deployed engineering experience, with substantial hands\-on technical ownership.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and production experience in at least one widely used programming language such as Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, C, or C\+\+.
* Ability to enter an unfamiliar codebase, form a useful system model, trace dependencies, diagnose failures, and make progress without a fully specified playbook.
* Working knowledge of Git\-based development, APIs, build and test workflows, CI/CD, containers, cloud or on\-premises environments, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience leading technical discovery, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, implementations, or similarly bounded customer engagements.
* Ability to translate an ambiguous customer problem into a clear technical plan, measurable success criteria, and disciplined execution.
* Strong written and spoken English, including the ability to explain complex technical matters to engineers, executives, and cross\-functional stakeholders.
* Sound judgment under pressure, intellectual honesty about product limitations, and the confidence to challenge an unworkable scope or unsupported claim.
* Strong project ownership, including action tracking, risk management, documentation, follow\-through, and timely escalation.
* Ability to maintain dependable overlap with US or European business hours when customer meetings and pilot execution require it.
* Comfort working in a startup environment where priorities change, processes are still being built, and customer outcomes matter more than role boundaries.



 Strong Plus
 
* Experience with enterprise developer tools, AI\-assisted software engineering, code intelligence, software modernization, testing, or engineering productivity platforms.
* Experience with complex brownfield systems, multi\-repository codebases, embedded Linux, Android, Yocto, RDK, OpenWrt, automotive software, telecom software, or similar platform environments.
* Experience designing secure enterprise deployments, including customer\-controlled cloud, self\-hosted, restricted\-network, or air\-gapped environments.
* Experience working with large language models, agentic workflows, retrieval systems, knowledge graphs, or evaluation frameworks.
* Experience gathering defensible before\-and\-after metrics and presenting technical validation results to enterprise decision\-makers.
* Experience working across product, engineering, sales, and customer teams without losing clarity about technical ownership.
* Startup experience or a record of building repeatable methods from early customer engagements.




 A Note from KAVIA
 





 We are not looking for someone who has used every technology or worked in every domain listed above.
 





 We are looking for a strong, hands\-on engineer who can earn trust with enterprise customers, bring structure to ambiguous technical work, and stay accountable until the customer has credible evidence. Applicants with demonstrated engineering depth and customer\-facing ownership are encouraged to apply, even if their current title is not Customer Solutions Engineer or Forward Deployment Engineer.
 




  




 How to Apply
 

 Please apply with your resume and a short note addressing the following:
 



* Your current location in India and your ability to maintain regular overlap with US business hours.




 Please fill this form:
 
 https://forms.gle/4rYd2zjqhWV6kvbc6

4a69d096.title: Senior Staff Consulting Architect- Cloud Native
4a69d096.description:
Nutanix is seeking a Sr. Staff Consulting Architect – Cloud Native to provide senior technical leadership in the architecture, design, and transformation of enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native platforms based on the Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP), across virtualized, bare\-metal, hybrid, and multi\-cloud environments.
   

  

 The role is intended for a highly experienced cloud\-native architect who can operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior customer stakeholders, lead complex and strategic platform transformation initiatives, and define scalable architecture standards across large and distributed environments.
   

  

 The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect will combine deep hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native technologies with strong consulting, architecture governance, and technical leadership capabilities.
   

  

 The role will also be responsible for developing reference architectures, reusable delivery patterns, technical assets, and enablement programs, while mentoring Staff and Consulting Architects and raising the overall cloud\-native capability of the consulting organization.
   

  

 Hands\-on expertise in Kubernetes, virtualization, platform engineering, CI/CD, GitOps, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) is mandatory.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Enterprise Architecture \& Strategic Advisory
* Provide end\-to\-end architecture leadership for complex enterprise Kubernetes and cloud\-native transformation programs.
* Define strategic platform architectures spanning:
+ Nutanix AHV
+ VMware vSphere
+ Bare metal
+ Public cloud platforms including AWS and Azure
+ Hybrid and multi\-cloud environments
+ Edge and distributed infrastructure

* Lead architecture strategy for large\-scale and multi\-cluster Kubernetes environments.
* Translate business, application, infrastructure, security, and operational requirements into scalable and resilient cloud\-native architectures.
* Define target\-state architectures and multi\-phase transformation roadmaps covering platform adoption, application modernization, migration, automation, and operations.
* Advise customer executives, enterprise architects, infrastructure leaders, platform engineering teams, and DevOps organizations on cloud\-native adoption strategies.
* Establish architecture principles, standards, and technology selection criteria for enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Provide technical leadership for complex architectural decisions, trade\-offs, and escalations.
* Advanced Kubernetes \& Platform Architecture
* Architect enterprise NKP platforms at scale, including:
+ Multi\-cluster and fleet architectures
+ Multi\-tenancy and workload isolation
+ High availability and disaster recovery
+ Cluster lifecycle management
+ Platform scalability and capacity planning
+ Security and governance

* Define advanced Kubernetes networking, storage, ingress/egress, and load\-balancing architectures.
* Design virtualization\-aware Kubernetes platforms considering:
+ Compute and resource allocation
+ NUMA and CPU topology
+ Storage performance
+ Network architecture
+ Failure domains
+ Cluster density
+ Performance optimization

* Define architecture patterns for GPU\-enabled and AI/ML workloads where applicable.
* Architect integration between Kubernetes and enterprise services including:
+ DNS
+ LDAP/Active Directory
+ PKI and certificate management
+ Load balancers
+ Backup and disaster recovery
+ Enterprise monitoring and logging

* Establish architecture patterns for platform standardization across multiple business units, data centers, and geographies.
* Complex Transformation \& Delivery Leadership
* Provide technical leadership for high\-value and technically complex customer engagements from Day\-0 architecture through Day\-2 operations.
* Lead architecture workshops, technical discovery sessions, design reviews, and transformation planning.
* Provide technical oversight for:
+ Platform deployment
+ Cluster onboarding
+ Application migration
+ Application modernization
+ Platform integration
+ Operational transformation

* Guide teams through complex implementation and troubleshooting scenarios spanning:
+ Kubernetes
+ Hypervisors
+ Networking
+ Storage
+ Security
+ Automation
+ CI/CD

* Act as the senior technical escalation point for critical architecture and delivery challenges.
* Ensure architectural decisions are translated into practical, supportable, and repeatable implementation patterns.
* Review and provide technical governance for solution designs produced by Staff and Consulting Architects.
* Automation, GitOps \& Platform Engineering
* Define enterprise automation strategies for Kubernetes and infrastructure platforms.
* Establish standardized GitOps and CI/CD operating models using technologies such as:
+ GitHub Actions
+ GitLab CI
+ Jenkins
+ Argo CD
+ Tekton
+ Flux CD

* Design Infrastructure as Code frameworks using:
+ Terraform
+ Ansible

* Define automation patterns integrating:
+ NKP APIs
+ Kubernetes APIs
+ Nutanix APIs
+ VMware APIs
+ AWS/Azure APIs

* Drive adoption of platform engineering principles, self\-service infrastructure, and developer experience (DevEx) practices.
* Establish reusable automation frameworks and reference implementations that can be adopted across customer engagements.
* Promote secure, compliant, version\-controlled, and auditable platform delivery practices.
* Security, Governance, Resilience \& Operations
* Define enterprise security architecture across infrastructure, Kubernetes, and application platform layers.
* Establish security and governance models covering:
+ RBAC
+ Network policies
+ Pod Security Standards
+ Secrets and certificate management
+ Policy\-as\-Code
+ Workload isolation
+ Multi\-tenancy

* Design policy and governance frameworks using OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent technologies.
* Define enterprise approaches for:
+ Observability
+ Logging
+ Monitoring
+ Backup and recovery
+ Disaster recovery
+ Business continuity

* Establish operational models covering platform lifecycle, upgrades, patching, capacity management, and resilience.
* Review platform performance, scalability, and operational maturity and drive continuous optimization.
* Technical Leadership, Mentoring \& Capability Development
* Serve as a technical authority and escalation point for the Cloud Native consulting organization.
* Mentor Staff Consulting Architects, Consulting Architects, and other technical consultants.
* Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical coaching on complex customer engagements.
* Develop and deliver internal technical enablement programs covering Kubernetes, NKP, platform engineering, automation, and cloud\-native architecture.
* Define competency expectations and technical development paths for cloud\-native architects.
* Lead communities of practice and technical forums to drive knowledge sharing.
* Identify capability gaps and work with leadership to establish targeted upskilling programs.
* Promote engineering and consulting best practices across geographies and delivery teams.
* Reference Architecture, Innovation \& Thought Leadership
* Create and maintain enterprise\-grade reference architectures, design patterns, deployment frameworks, and technical playbooks for cloud\-native platforms.
* Develop reusable consulting assets that improve delivery quality, consistency, and scalability.
* Identify emerging technologies and evaluate their applicability to Nutanix cloud\-native solutions.
* Drive innovation in areas such as:
+ Kubernetes platform engineering
+ Multi\-cluster management
+ GitOps
+ AI/ML platforms
+ GPU\-enabled Kubernetes
+ Application modernization
+ Hybrid/multi\-cloud
+ Developer platforms

* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and other technical teams to provide field feedback and influence product direction.
* Represent the consulting organization in technical forums, customer executive discussions, architecture communities, and industry events where appropriate.
* Contribute to whitepapers, technical blogs, solution briefs, and other thought\-leadership content.


**Technical Skills \& Experience**
 Mandatory Skills – Must Have
   

  

* 15\+ years of experience across infrastructure, virtualization, cloud, Kubernetes, platform engineering, or related technologies.
* Proven experience architecting and delivering large\-scale enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, operations, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.
* Strong hands\-on experience with:
+ Nutanix AHV
+ VMware vSphere
+ Bare\-metal infrastructure

* Strong understanding of enterprise infrastructure architecture across:
+ Compute
+ Storage
+ Networking
+ Virtualization
+ Security

* Strong experience with Nutanix Kubernetes Platform (NKP) or equivalent enterprise Kubernetes platforms.
* Deep expertise in Kubernetes networking, storage, security, ingress/egress, and load\-balancing architectures.
* Deep expertise in:
+ Load balancers
+ SSL/TLS and certificate management
+ LDAP/Active Directory
+ DNS
+ Backup and DR
+ Enterprise observability

* Proven experience designing and implementing CI/CD and GitOps platforms.
* Strong expertise in Infrastructure as Code:
+ Terraform
+ Ansible

* Strong understanding of Kubernetes APIs, infrastructure APIs, and automation frameworks.
* Proven experience designing multi\-cluster, highly available, resilient, and secure Kubernetes platforms.
* Strong troubleshooting capability across Kubernetes, virtualization, networking, storage, automation, and application platform layers.
* Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical engagements and architecture decisions.
* Excellent customer\-facing, consulting, presentation, and executive communication skills.


 Added Advantage – Good to Have
   

  

* Strong experience with public cloud Kubernetes services:
+ Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
+ Amazon EKS

* Experience with hybrid and multi\-cloud architecture.
* Experience with Kubernetes fleet/multi\-cluster management.
* Experience with platform engineering and internal developer platforms.
* Experience with service mesh technologies.
* Experience with GPU\-enabled Kubernetes and AI/ML platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes operators and custom automation.
* Experience with application modernization and containerization.
* Experience with FinOps, capacity planning, and cloud cost optimization.
* Experience influencing product strategy or working directly with product/engineering organizations.


 Trainable / Developable Skills
   

  

* Advanced NKP capabilities and emerging Nutanix cloud\-native technologies.
* Advanced AI/ML platform architecture and GPU orchestration.
* Emerging Kubernetes ecosystem technologies.
* Advanced platform engineering and developer experience frameworks.
* Advanced multi\-cloud governance and FinOps.
* New automation frameworks and cloud\-native tooling.


 Leadership \& Consulting Expectations
   

  

 The Sr. Staff Consulting Architect is expected to demonstrate the ability to:
   

  

* Operate effectively at C\-level, executive, enterprise architect, and senior technical stakeholder levels.
* Lead architecture decisions across multiple technology domains and organizational boundaries.
* Influence without direct authority.
* Challenge existing architecture assumptions and recommend pragmatic alternatives.
* Balance technical excellence with business outcomes, delivery timelines, operational complexity, and cost.
* Establish technical direction for complex and strategic customer programs.
* Independently handle ambiguous and high\-impact technical problems.
* Mentor other architects and elevate the technical maturity of the broader consulting organization.
* Convert field experience into reusable architecture patterns, methodologies, and intellectual property.


 Education \& Certifications
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is an advantage.


**Preferred Certifications**
* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
* Certified Kubernetes Application Developer (CKAD)
* Nutanix certifications:
+ NCP
+ NKP
+ NCX

* VMware certifications:
+ VCP
+ VCAP/VCIX preferred

* Terraform Associate or equivalent
* Ansible Automation certification
* Relevant AWS/Azure certifications


 Location \& Work Shifts
   

  

* Pune – Work from Office
* Travel as required for customer assignments
* Willingness to work US and EMEA shifts based on customer and engagement requirements


 \-\-

119afe6c.title: Solutions Architect - Azure Delivery
119afe6c.description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
   

  

 With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business\-to\-business technology experts.
   

  

 Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
   

  

**Position Summary:**
 The Azure Implementation Engineer is responsible for
 **building, migrating, and onboarding customer environments into Microsoft Azure** 
 as part of structured delivery projects. The role works closely with Solution Architects, Project Managers, and Security teams to implement approved designs, execute migration waves, and prepare environments for steady\-state operations.
   

  

 The position requires
 **hands\-on Azure deployment skills** 
 and
 **basic Active Directory knowledge** 
 to support hybrid enterprise workloads.
   

  

 This is primarily a
 **project delivery and implementation role** 
 , with limited post\-go\-live stabilization support.
   

  

**Key Duties And Responsibilities**
 Working in collaboration with the Regional Service Centre and Azure Delivery teams, responsibilities include:
   

  

**Azure Implementation \& Project Delivery**
* Implement Azure landing zones and subscription structures as per approved architecture.
* Deploy core Azure services: Virtual Machines, VNets, Subnets, NSGs, Load Balancers, Storage Accounts.
* Configure availability, backup, DR, and security baselines.
* Execute workload onboarding and cutover activities during migration projects.
* Perform build, test, and production go\-live activities.
* Prepare implementation guides, build documents, and handover packs.
* Participate in design walkthroughs and technical workshops with customers.


**Migration Execution**
* Perform on\-prem to Azure and cloud\-to\-cloud migrations.
* Assist with discovery and assessment phases using Azure Migrate.
* Execute replication and cutover activities using ASR and Data Box.
* Support post\-migration stabilisation and optimisation phases.
* Track technical actions for migration waves and project milestones.


**Identity \& Active Directory**
* Support identity integration between on\-prem AD and Azure AD / Entra ID.
* Perform user/group sync checks and RBAC configuration.
* Understand AD fundamentals: OUs, DNS, Group Policy basics.
* Assist with MFA and conditional access rollout as part of projects.


**Automation \& Tooling**
* Implement builds using ARM, Bicep, or Terraform templates for to deploy VNets, AKS clusters, and SQL databases.
* Support Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure deployment.
* Use PowerShell / Azure CLI for automation during migrations and builds.


**Security Implementation**
* Hardening the environment by Zero Trust principles.
* Configuring Microsoft Entra ID (IAM) and enforcing Azure Policies.


**AI Integration**
* Build infra for Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Search.


**Operational Readiness \& Handover**
* Assist in operational readiness activities before transition to support teams.
* Create SOPs and runbooks for steady\-state environments.
* Participate in knowledge\-transfer sessions with managed services teams.
* Ensure governance, tagging, and security standards are implemented before handover.


**Qualifications And Experience**
 An Azure Support Engineer should also have the following qualifications and experience\-
   

  

* 5\+ years in cloud or infrastructure delivery roles.
* Strong hands\-on Azure implementation experience.
* Proven involvement in migration or transformation projects.
* Working knowledge of:
+ Azure Compute, Storage, Networking
+ Azure AD / RBAC / Hybrid Identity basics

* Windows and Linux administration experience.
* Basic automation/scripting exposure.
* Experience working in professional services / project\-based delivery environments.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Characteristics**
* Delivery\-oriented mindset with strong documentation skills.
* Comfortable working with project plans and milestones.
* Customer\-facing experience during implementations.
* Ability to follow architecture designs and escalate risks early.
* Exposure to Well\-Architected Framework and governance models is desirable.


**Required Certifications**
* AZ\-104 (Azure Administrator Associate)
* AZ\-500 (Azure Security Engineer)
