96de7e2e.title: Senior Program Manager, ServiceNow Platform
96de7e2e.description:
**About Northern Trust**
 As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
   

  

 Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
   

  

 With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 We are seeking an experienced
 **Senior Program Manager** 
 to lead complex, cross\-functional technology programs within the Corporate Applications Technology business unit under Global Engineering, specifically driving the
 **ServiceNow platform** 
 capabilities. This role will be responsible for driving strategic program planning, execution governance, stakeholder alignment, risk management, and delivery outcomes across multiple teams and initiatives within the ServiceNow capability.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine strong program leadership, business acumen, technical understanding, and executive communication skills to ensure programs deliver measurable value, remain aligned with organizational priorities, and meet quality, compliance, security, and operational expectations.
   

  

**Experience Range:** 
 16\+ years
   

  

**Role Level:** 
 Senior Program Manager
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Program Strategy \& Delivery
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end planning and execution of large\-scale technology programs from initiation through delivery and operational transition.
* Define program scope, objectives, success measures, milestones, dependencies, budgets, and resource plans.
* Coordinate delivery across multiple projects, product teams, engineering teams, vendors, and business stakeholders.
* Ensure programs remain aligned with business priorities, technology strategy, and enterprise standards.


 Governance, Risk \& Controls
   

  

* Establish and manage program governance forums, decision frameworks, escalation paths, and executive reporting rhythms.
* Identify, track, and mitigate program risks, issues, assumptions, and dependencies.
* Ensure adherence to audit, compliance, information security, change management, and operational readiness requirements.
* Maintain high\-quality program documentation, status reporting, and evidence required for governance and control processes.


 Stakeholder \& Executive Communication
   

  

* Partner with senior business leaders, product owners, architects, engineering leaders, operations teams, finance partners, and external vendors.
* Prepare and deliver executive\-ready updates covering program health, key decisions, risks, dependencies, financials, and business outcomes.
* Drive alignment across stakeholders with competing priorities and ensure clear ownership of decisions and actions.
* Facilitate steering committees, program reviews, planning workshops, and cross\-functional working sessions.


 Agile \& Delivery Management
   

  

* Drive Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and hybrid delivery practices across teams and programs.
* Monitor delivery metrics such as velocity, throughput, milestones, burn\-up/burn\-down trends, impediments, and release readiness.
* Coordinate cross\-team dependencies and facilitate timely resolution of delivery blockers.
* Promote continuous improvement in planning, estimation, delivery predictability, and team operating practices.


 Financial, Vendor \& Resource Management
   

  

* Manage program budgets, forecasts, cost tracking, resource plans, and financial reporting in partnership with finance and leadership teams.
* Oversee vendor delivery performance, contract dependencies, and third\-party commitments where applicable.
* Support capacity planning, prioritization, and trade\-off decisions across program workstreams.
* Track program value realization, benefits, and measurable business outcomes.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.
* 12\+ years of experience in program management, project management, technology delivery, or related roles.
* Proven experience leading complex technology programs across multiple teams, geographies, or business functions.
* Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, release management, change management, and technology operations.
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, dependencies, risks, executive communications, and stakeholder expectations.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, facilitation, negotiation, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics for executive audiences.
* Knowledge of ITSM, ITOM, GRC, Security Operations and similar processes and procedures.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* PMP, PgMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, SAFe, or Agile certification.
* Experience in enterprise applications, digital transformation, financial services technology, regulatory programs, or platform modernization.
* Experience managing vendor partners, statements of work, managed services, or third\-party delivery models.
* Knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, automated testing, production support, observability, and operational resilience practices.
* Experience preparing executive dashboards, steering committee materials, and board\-level or senior leadership updates.


**Technical Skills**
* Agile / Scrum / Kanban / SAFe delivery practices
* Jira, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Clarity, MS Project, Excel, PowerPoint
* SDLC, Release Management, Change Management, DevOps, CI/CD
* Program governance, portfolio reporting, and executive dashboards
* Risk, issue, dependency, and decision management
* Budgeting, forecasting, capacity planning, and resource management
* Vendor management, SOW tracking, and third\-party delivery oversight
* Knowledge of ServiceNow Ecosystem will be a significant plus.


**Key Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and enterprise mindset
* Leadership, influence, and cross\-functional collaboration
* Executive communication and presentation skills
* Financial and commercial acumen
* Stakeholder management and expectation setting
* Decision making and problem solving
* Conflict resolution and negotiation
* Delivery discipline, ownership, and accountability
* Coaching, mentoring, and continuous improvement orientation


**Working with Us**
 As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
   

  

 Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
   

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**
 Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
   

  

**About Our Pune Office**
 The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
   

  

 Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

 Who We Are
   

  

 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge\-to\-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. Helping some of the largest companies in the world modernize their networks to meet the demands of a digital future, Aruba is redefining the “Intelligent Edge” – and creating new customer experiences across intelligent spaces and digital workspaces.  Job Family Definition

Provides the deepest level of product\- and technology\-specific expertise available to customers from anyone in the sales organization in deal pursuit situations.  What You’ll Do

9ffa061b.description:
**Job Description**
 About the job
   

  

**About Comprinno**
 Comprinno is a NASSCOM\-incubated company headquartered in Bangalore, with offices in Pune, Coimbatore, and the United States. We specialize in cloud transformation, DevOps, infrastructure automation, and Artificial Intelligence, enabling organizations to build scalable, secure, and high\-performing cloud environments on AWS. Our flagship SaaS platform, Tevico, offers intelligent cloud governance and observability for AWS workloads. It helps enterprises improve uptime, reduce costs, and ensure compliance by proactively detecting anomalies and triggering automated remediation workflows. As a trusted partner to both startups and enterprises, we combine deep cloud expertise with a customer\-first mindset. Our services span Cloud Migration, Modernization, Security, Managed Services, Data Analytics, and Generative AI solutions, driving innovation and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a dynamic and customer\-focused Presales Engineer – Cloud \& AI to support our Cloud Transformation, Modernization, Managed Services, and AI/GenAI practices. This role is pivotal in shaping technical solutions for prospective customers, driving value\-based conversations, and bridging the gap between customer challenges and Comprinno's cloud and AI capabilities. As a Presales Engineer – Cloud \& AI, you will work closely with Sales, Solution Architects, Data \& AI teams, and Delivery teams to understand customer requirements, design high\-level solutions, and articulate how Comprinno's offerings can accelerate digital transformation and business outcomes. This is a high\-impact role that combines cloud solutioning, technical consulting, AI awareness, customer engagement, and presales excellence.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Customer Discovery \& Solutioning
   

  

* Engage with prospective customers to understand business objectives, technical challenges, and transformation goals.
* Conduct discovery workshops, assessments, and technical discussions to identify cloud and AI opportunities.
* Translate business requirements into high\-level cloud and AI solution architectures.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects and technical teams to develop scalable and cost\-effective solutions.


 Cloud Transformation Consulting
   

  

* Support customer initiatives across:
* Cloud Migration
* Application Modernization
* DevOps Transformation
* Managed Services
* Security \& Compliance
* Resilience \& Disaster Recovery
* Conduct cloud assessments and migration readiness evaluations.
* Prepare cloud cost estimates, modernization roadmaps, and optimization recommendations.
* Leverage AWS programs and frameworks such as:
* Migration Acceleration Program (MAP)
* AWS Well\-Architected Framework (WAFR)
* Foundational Technical Review (FTR)


 AI \& GenAI Solution Consulting
   

  

* Identify opportunities for AI, GenAI, and Agentic AI adoption within customer environments.
* Participate in AI discovery workshops and business value discussions.
* Support solution design for AI\-powered applications leveraging AWS AI services.
* Collaborate with Data \& AI teams to position analytics, machine learning, and Generative AI offerings.
* Assist customers in identifying suitable use cases for:
* Generative AI
* AI Assistants
* Knowledge Management Solutions
* Intelligent Automation
* Conversational AI


 Proposal Development \& Technical Presales
   

  

* Collaborate with Solution Architects to create:
* Technical Proposals
* Architecture Diagrams
* Effort Estimates
* Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Technical Responses to RFPs/RFIs
* Present solutions, recommendations, and technical approaches to customer stakeholders.
* Support Proof of Concepts (PoCs), demonstrations, and technical validations.
* Participate in technical reviews and solution walkthroughs.


 Customer Engagement \& Thought Leadership
   

  

* Attend customer meetings jointly with Sales teams to provide technical expertise.
* Build credibility and trust with customer technical and business stakeholders.
* Contribute to webinars, workshops, technical presentations, and customer\-facing events.
* Write blogs, case studies, solution briefs, and technical content that supports business growth.
* Maintain an active presence in cloud and AI communities.


 Collaboration \& Knowledge Management
   

  

* Collaborate with Delivery teams to ensure smooth handover and alignment between presales and execution.
* Maintain reusable presales assets, templates, assessment frameworks, and knowledge repositories.
* Continuously stay updated on AWS services, AI advancements, partner programs, and emerging technology trends.
* Contribute to internal capability building and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.


 Travel \& Customer Interaction
   

  

* Travel as required for customer meetings, workshops, assessments, events, and strategic engagements.
* Represent Comprinno professionally during all customer\-facing interactions.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in Presales, Solution Consulting, Cloud Consulting, Technical Sales, or related customer\-facing roles.
* Strong understanding of AWS cloud services across:
* Compute
* Networking
* Storage
* Security
* Databases
* Knowledge of cloud migration and modernization frameworks such as AWS MAP.
* Familiarity with AWS cloud assessment tools including Migration Evaluator and AWS Well\-Architected Tool.
* Understanding of:
* Kubernetes
* Containerization
* Cloud\-Native Architectures
* DevOps Practices
* Hands\-on exposure to Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Ability to create:
* Solution Documents
* Architecture Diagrams
* Technical Proposals
* Effort Estimates
* Statements of Work
* Understanding of Generative AI concepts including:
* Large Language Models (LLMs)
* Prompt Engineering
* Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* AI Assistants
* Agentic AI Concepts
* Familiarity with AWS AI services such as:
* Amazon Bedrock

* Experience positioning AI, GenAI, Analytics, or Data Engineering solutions.
* Familiarity with AI frameworks such as:
* LangChain

* CrewAI
* OpenAI APIs
* Anthropic APIs
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience conducting AI assessments, GenAI workshops, or AI proof\-of\-concepts.
* Experience contributing to webinars, blogs, case studies, or technical marketing content.

* Customer\-centric mindset with strong problem\-solving abilities.


**Desired Qualifications \& Skills**

* Understanding of compliance frameworks such as:
* ISO 27001
* SOC 2
* HIPAA

* Contributions to industry blogs, webinars, conferences, technical communities, or open\-source initiatives.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

* Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand customer business challenges.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.

* Passion for cloud technologies, AI, and emerging innovation.
* Collaborative team player who can work across Sales, Architecture, Delivery, and Product teams.

 What Success Looks Like

 Why Join Comprinno

46b0c209.title: Senior Specialist, EHS Solution Architecture
46b0c209.description:
Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
* Join a global healthcare biopharma organization and shape the architecture that connects digital capabilities across Maintenance, Engineering, Asset Reliability, Manufacturing Site Operations, and Environmental Health Safety.
* Lead the evolution of ME and EHS from individual product platforms toward an interoperable, governed, secure, and data\-driven ecosystem integrated with critical enterprise systems.
* Design central data hubs and reusable information services that make engineering and broader company EHS data discoverable, trusted, contextualized, and available for operational reporting, business insights, advanced analytics, and AI use cases.
* Conceptualize digital\-thread capabilities that preserve business context and data continuity across engineering, project delivery, commissioning, asset handover, operations, maintenance, reliability, and EHS processes.
* Work across global product teams, manufacturing sites, enterprise architecture, data and analytics, cybersecurity, quality, infrastructure, integration teams, vendors, and managed service providers.


Role Overview
  
We are hiring a Solution Architect to define and deliver the target architecture for the company. The architect will focus on extending existing platforms so they can interoperate with critical enterprise systems, designing central data hubs for Engineering and other products, and enabling governed use of digital data for business insights and AI. The role combines strategy, hands\-on architecture, feasibility assessment, solution design, technical governance, and delivery leadership.
  
The Solution Architect will translate business and product strategies into architecture principles, capability models, reference architectures, integration patterns, data\-product designs, technology roadmaps, and executable implementation increments. The role will assess current\-state constraints, identify reusable platform capabilities, evaluate build\-versus\-buy options, guide proof\-of\-concept and pilot work, and ensure solutions are secure, compliant, scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards.
  
  

What You Will Do
  
* Define the MEEHS target architecture: Develop current\-state, transition\-state, and target\-state architectures spanning applications, integrations, identity, cloud services, infrastructure, data, analytics, security, and operations.
* Enable enterprise interoperability: Design and implement integration patterns that connect with critical enterprise systems through APIs, events, middleware, managed file exchange, master data services, and governed data\-sharing mechanisms.
* Architect central data hubs: Design central data hubs for Engineering and other EHS products, including ingestion, storage, transformation, semantic modeling, metadata, lineage, access, quality, retention, observability, and consumption layers.

**Title: AVP, Solution Architect (L11\)**
**Company Overview:** 
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 Synchrony's Engineering Team is a dynamic and innovative team dedicated to driving technological excellence. As a member of this Team, you'll play a pivotal role in designing and developing cutting\-edge tech stack and solutions that redefine industry standards. The Credit Card that we use every day to purchase our essentials and later settle the bills \- A simple process that we all are used to on a day to day basis. Now, consider the vast complexity hidden behind this seemingly simple process, operating tirelessly for millions of cardholders. The sheer volume of data processed is mind\-boggling. Our collaborative environment encourages creative problem\-solving and fosters career growth. 66910edb.title: Senior Security Consultant – AWS Cloud Architecture
66910edb.description:
**About Gruve**
 Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well\-funded early\-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 AWS Cloud Architect responsible for designing, building, and owning the complete AWS foundation for Gruve's Cisco ISE\-as\-a\-Service (ISEaaS) multi\-tenant managed service, with 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure and network security environments. Owns the AWS Organization and multi\-account landing zone, tenant network architecture, security guardrails, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, and cloud cost management. This is a hands\-on build role: the successful candidate will personally author Terraform modules and design the account structure that every customer tenant is provisioned from, while applying reliability engineering practices to reduce operational toil. Working knowledge of Cisco ISE, RADIUS, and enterprise network security concepts.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design and implement multi\-account AWS Organization structure, including Organizational Units (OUs), management account separation, and consolidated billing.
* Design and enforce Service Control Policies (SCPs) and organization\-level guardrails for tenant isolation and compliance.
* Design tenant network architecture: VPC, multi\-AZ subnet design, route tables, VPC endpoints, NAT, DNS (Route 53 private zones including PTR records), and IP address management (IPAM).
* Implement AWS Transit Gateway hub\-and\-spoke connectivity with per\-tenant route tables, Site\-to\-Site VPN, and Direct Connect.
* Implement AWS security services: IAM and IAM Identity Center (SSO), KMS customer\-managed keys, CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, and Security Hub.
* Own cloud cost management and FinOps: per\-tenant cost attribution, tagging strategy, budget alerts, Cost Explorer and CUR\-based chargeback reporting, and cost modeling to support service pricing and margin analysis.
* Design for high availability and disaster recovery across Availability Zones and regions, including backup, restore, and recovery runbooks.
* Apply reliability engineering practices: automation\-first operations, toil reduction, failure\-mode analysis, and infrastructure observability.
* Implement policy\-as\-code and security scanning in CI/CD pipelines (Checkov, tfsec, or equivalent).
* Partner with automation and ISE engineering teams to ensure infrastructure outputs integrate cleanly with configuration management.
* Subscribe to and manage the Cisco ISE AMI listing on AWS Marketplace per Region, including EULA acceptance and AMI version/release validation before each tenant build.
* Verify and manage AWS service quotas (EC2 instance types, EIPs, VPC limits) per Region/tenant.
* Configure Network ACLs and manage Elastic IP allocation policy (use only where explicitly required; avoid public exposure of ISE by default).
* Enable VPC Flow Logs for tenant VPCs/subnets where required by security or compliance standards.
* Configure EC2 instance metadata options (IMDSv2\) and other instance\-level hardening attributes.
* Own EC2 user\-data / bootstrap configuration for the ISE AMI (hostname, management IP, NTP, DNS) so it hands off cleanly into the Platform Automation Engineer's post\-bootstrap automation.
* Define NTP source design for ISE nodes alongside the existing DNS/Route 53 designs.
* Own the end\-to\-end AWS infrastructure validation checklist (EC2, EBS, security groups, routing, DNS, NTP, IAM, encryption, monitoring) at each tenant go\-live.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, or cloud architecture roles.
* Demonstrable experience designing and building a multi\-account AWS Organization or landing zone from the ground up.
* Strong hands\-on Terraform experience — candidates should be able to describe modules they have personally authored.
* Solid understanding of AWS networking, including Transit Gateway, VPN, and hybrid connectivity to on\-premises environments.
* Experience with cloud cost management, tagging strategy, and cost attribution in multi\-tenant or managed service environments.
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect \- Professional preferred; AWS Advanced Networking or Security specialty certifications an advantage.
* Experience in a managed services provider (MSP), multi\-tenant SaaS, or hosted service environment is highly desirable.
* Familiarity with Cisco ISE, NAC, or enterprise network security concepts is an advantage.
* Strong documentation, design communication, and cross\-team collaboration skills.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* AWS Core: AWS Organizations, Control Tower, Account Factory, Service Control Policies (SCPs), IAM, IAM Identity Center (SSO), EC2, EBS, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, Systems Manager (SSM), CloudWatch.
* AWS Networking: VPC, Subnets, Route Tables, Transit Gateway, Site\-to\-Site VPN, Direct Connect, Route 53, VPC Endpoints, NAT Gateway, IPAM.
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (module authoring, remote state, workspaces), Git, CI/CD pipelines, policy\-as\-code (Checkov / tfsec / Sentinel).
* Security \& Governance: CloudTrail, AWS Config, GuardDuty, Security Hub, KMS key policies, least\-privilege IAM design, multi\-tenant isolation patterns.
* Cloud Financial Management: Cost Explorer, Cost and Usage Report (CUR), tagging strategy, budgets and alerts, per\-tenant chargeback and cost modeling.
* Scripting \& Automation: Python, Bash, PowerShell (any one or more), REST API integration.
* Familiar with Technologies: Cisco ISE, RADIUS / RADSec, 802\.1X, Ansible, Azure, Kubernetes.


**Why Gruve**
 At Gruve, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive and contribute their best work. If you’re passionate about technology and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 Gruve is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and thank all who apply; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

 How we work
   

  

* A remote\-first team, working with clients in the US, UK and India.

Responsibilities

1284c983.title: Sr. Tech Infra Program Manager, OIS NANO
1284c983.description:
**Description**
 Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS) provides the technology infrastructure backbone of every Amazon fulfillment site globally — and Quick Commerce is rewriting the rules of how that infrastructure gets built. This role will be the single threaded leader Quick commerce tech infrastructure for an entire country.
   

  

 Quick Commerce demands a fundamentally different approach: frugal, vendor\-managed infrastructure that launches at unprecedented velocity while maintaining enterprise\-grade availability. As the country's single\-threaded infrastructure owner, you will define the network and device strategy that enables Amazon to launch and operate hundreds of sites at speed and at a fraction of traditional cost. You will own the country\-level technology roadmap, drive vendor relationships, govern availability and financial outcomes, and partner directly with senior business operations leadership. Quick Commerce is the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores, and team NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) shapes its technology backbone.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 The NANO TIPM owns the country\-level infrastructure strategy — defining architecture standards and readiness criteria against which all site launches execute. For network infrastructure, the TIPM owns end\-to\-end scope from vendor selection through SLA governance through financial outcome. For End\-User Equipment (associate\-facing devices such as scanners, workstations, and printers), the TIPM owns identification and recommendation while partnering with Device Tech for certification. The role's responsibilities fall into four themes — Theme 1 sets the framework, Theme 2 executes, Theme 3 governs, and Theme 4 feeds business needs back into Theme 1\.
   

  

 Theme 1 — Strategy, Vendor Management, and Contract Governance: Own the country's network technology roadmap, drive vendor selection end\-to\-end, and identify end user devices meeting regional cost and performance targets across all applicable site types.
   

  

 Theme 2 — Site Launch and Network Deployment: Define playbooks, architecture standards, and deployment sequencing for the country, stepping in at escalation points where decisions carry fleet\-wide implications beyond execution\-level authority.
   

  

 Theme 3 — Operations Excellence, Governance, and Financial Accountability: Own network availability outcomes, device fleet health, and financial performance across the country's fleet, driving vendor performance through structured governance cadences.
   

  

 Theme 4 — Partnership with Business Operations Leadership: Translate the country's business growth priorities into infrastructure strategy, surfacing performance insights, capacity risks, and cost tradeoffs that inform decisions across the region.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 You own the network and device technology infrastructure of Quick Commerce in India — the fastest growth vector for Amazon Stores. Your day moves between defining regional network strategy that scales from hundreds to thousands of sites, steering technology capability investments toward fleet\-scale readiness, evaluating transitions that deliver cost reduction versus legacy models, and presenting infrastructure roadmaps to senior business operations leadership. You make architecture and vendor decisions that determine availability, cost trajectory, and launch velocity for an entire geography
   

  

**About The Team**
 The NANO (Network and Assets for Nimble Operations) team sits within Operations Infrastructure Services and exists to solve a singular challenge: enabling Amazon Operations to launch and operate thousands of small\-footprint sites at speed, at scale, and at a fraction of traditional infrastructure cost. The team owns the full infrastructure lifecycle — network strategy, vendor contracts, site launches, incident management, and financial governance — across India, United States, Middle East, United Kingdom, and Japan. Quick Commerce dark stores represent the overwhelming majority of the use cases today, scaling from \~500 sites to 3,000\+ by 2028, with the enablement model extending to every emerging no\-capex site type in Amazon's portfolio.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of program management or technical project management experience
* Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior leadership
* Knowledge of information technology infrastructure domains such as compute server platforms, storage server platforms, server components, network devices, technologies and architectures, IT service delivery principles and best practices
* Experience managing conflict, escalations, negotiating compromise, influencing others and problem solving with engineering teams
* Experience participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results, or experience communicating results to senior leadership
* Experience managing large\-scale projects from end to end


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a technology field


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

44990485.title: Digital Solution Specialist
44990485.description:
**This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Solution Specialist based in India.**
 This role combines digital solutions, sales, customer education, and orthodontic industry expertise in a customer\-facing environment.
   

  

 You will help customers adopt and maximize the value of digital orthodontic products and solutions.
   

  

 The position has a strong commercial focus, with responsibility for developing opportunities and achieving sales targets within an assigned territory.
   

  

 You will build long\-term professional relationships while providing training, onboarding, education, and responsive customer support.
   

  

 The role also involves working closely with internal teams across marketing, finance, operations, customer service, and delivery.
   

  

 You will contribute customer insights, competitive intelligence, and product feedback to help strengthen digital adoption and business growth.
   

  

 This is a full\-time remote opportunity requiring strong autonomy, agility, organization, and a deep understanding of the orthodontic sector.
   

  

**Accountabilities**
* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets while supporting timely account receivables in coordination with finance teams.
* Provide comprehensive training, education, onboarding, and marketing support to customers using digital orthodontic solutions and product portfolios.
* Respond promptly to customer questions, concerns, and support requests, ensuring effective resolution and a high level of customer satisfaction.
* Develop and maintain strong customer relationships while identifying opportunities to increase adoption and utilization of digital products.
* Build a track record of converting existing business and customers toward digital product solutions.
* Develop territory\-specific sales and educational strategies, tools, and approaches to increase customer engagement and product utilization.
* Manage territory planning, account coverage, budgets, expenses, and related commercial activities in accordance with established guidelines.
* Demonstrate products and communicate their features, benefits, and clinical value using appropriate sales and educational materials.
* Collect customer feedback, complaints, market intelligence, and competitive information and communicate relevant insights to marketing and management teams.
* Share new product ideas, extensions, and customer needs with relevant internal teams for evaluation.
* Prepare and maintain required sales, activity, expense, business, and customer reports accurately and on schedule.
* Coordinate with relevant operational and delivery teams to provide customers with accurate expectations regarding product availability and delivery timelines.
* Ensure all customer interactions, sales activities, reporting, and business practices comply with applicable company policies and regulatory requirements.


**Requirements**
* 5\+ years of experience in the orthodontic industry, preferably in a sales, training, customer education, or commercially focused role.
* Graduate degree in dentistry, medicine, science, or engineering; an MBA or equivalent business qualification is preferred.
* Strong understanding of orthodontic products, digital solutions, and customer adoption processes.
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical or clinical concepts clearly to different audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain long\-term professional relationships with customers.
* Strong training and customer\-education capabilities, including the ability to guide and support customers throughout their learning and adoption journey.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to manage territory activities, reporting, budgets, and multiple priorities effectively.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and develop creative approaches to customer engagement and business development.
* Results\-oriented mindset with strong commercial awareness and a focus on achieving measurable objectives.
* High level of agility and adaptability, with the ability to coordinate effectively across internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, particularly when addressing customer issues and identifying opportunities for improvement.


**Benefits**
* Full\-time remote work opportunity in India.
* Opportunity to work within the digital orthodontics and dental technology sector.
* Customer\-facing role combining commercial development, education, training, and digital solution adoption.
* Exposure to innovative digital orthodontic products and evolving healthcare technology.
* Opportunity to build long\-term relationships with healthcare professionals and industry stakeholders.
* Cross\-functional collaboration with marketing, finance, operations, customer service, and delivery teams.
* Opportunity to contribute market insights and customer feedback to product and marketing initiatives.
* Professional development through customer education, product training, and industry engagement.
* Compensation, healthcare coverage, and additional benefits may vary according to the employment arrangement and applicable local policies.

c06b323a.description:
**Lead SAP Technology Architect (all genders)**



At Tenthpin, we are looking for a visionary SAP technology expert to take a leading role in shaping exciting cutting edge programmes with our Tier 1 clients. This is your opportunity to define and drive innovation at the forefront of Life Sciences digital transformation.



You’ll report directly to our Global Technology Community Lead and serve as an SAP technology SME—championing innovation, ensuring excellence, and shaping the future of SAP Consulting.


**The Opportunity**



As a Lead SAP Technology Architect, you’ll play a pivotal role in guiding clients through complex digital transformations, defining technical strategy, and delivering high\-impact SAP solutions. This is more than just a technical role—you’ll influence global strategy, lead cutting\-edge transformations, and help scale a fast\-growing global consultancy.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Serve as Tenthpin’s global SAP technology SME, reporting to the Global Technology Community Lead and helping drive strategy and growth.
* Lead SAP Architecture and solution design, aligning with client goals and industry best practices.
* Advise on greenfield, bluefield, and brownfield transformation strategies.
* Guide clients through ECC to S/4HANA RISE transition journeys, ensuring scalable and future\-ready architectures.
* Lead technology discussions in proposals, workshops, and client presentations.
* Contribute to thought leadership by staying at the forefront of SAP trends and shaping internal methodologies.
* Act as Application Owner of Tenthpin’s internal SAP test, development, and demonstration systems \- supporting consultants in modelling new technology advancements that benefit Life Sciences clients.
* Mentor and coach junior consultants, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence.


**Your Experience**



You’re a strategic SAP technology leader with a passion for innovation, a deep understanding of SAP’s evolving landscape, and a strong track record of success in large\-scale projects.


**You bring:**


* Extensive experience in SAP architecture, technology strategy, and full lifecycle implementations.
* Deep knowledge of S/4HANA, SAP BTP, and modern transformation methodologies.
* Proven leadership in large\-scale SAP programs—ideally within Life Sciences.
* Strong understanding of SAP’s technology roadmap and ecosystem.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills—comfortable influencing both technical and business leaders.
* A growth mindset and a drive to continuously enhance the value of technology consulting services.


**Preferred Certifications (or willingness to obtain):**


* P\_SAPEA: SAP Certified Professional – SAP Enterprise Architect
* P\_BTPA: SAP Certified Professional – Solution Architect – SAP BTP
* C\_BCSBS: SAP Certified Associate – Positioning SAP Business Suite


**Why Tenthpin**



Tenthpin is a global consulting and technology boutique for the Life Sciences industry. With more 400\+ consultants, we operate out of eight countries: US, Switzerland, Germany, UK, Portugal, Poland, Japan, and India. At least 16 of the top 20 Life Sciences companies worldwide already rely on Tenthpin, trusting our independent, unbiased advice and services.



 Why Tenthpin technical consulting? Life Sciences are in our DNA and technical delivery in Life Sciences GxP is a specialist skillset and includes working on leading SAP innovations; we value technical members as part of one consulting team; and we are not a “factory” – we have an approach, an opinion, and pride ourselves on our expertise.



 We offer a competitive salary and benefits package. Plus, a collaborative work environment that encourages professional growth and development.


Are you passionate about digitally transforming Life Sciences companies? Do you want to create an impact with leading brands and deliver real value? Enjoy working in an entrepreneurial and collaborative team?


**We look forward to hearing from you**

41dada66.title: Staff Software Architect
41dada66.description:
**Please Note:**

**1\. If you are a first time user, please create your candidate login account before you apply for a job.**

**2\. If you already have a Candidate Account, please Sign\-In before you apply.**

**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Job Description:** Staff Software Engineer \- Full\-Stack \& AI\-Assisted Engineering


Modern Full\-Stack Software Engineering with AI Coding Tools Proficiency \& Technical Leadership

**Position Overview**
=====================


We are seeking a highly passionate and skilled engineer to lead and execute full\-stack enterprise product engineering initiatives. This senior role requires deep full\-stack engineering expertise across Java, React, and containerization technologies (Docker), combined with advanced proficiency in leveraging AI coding tools such as Cursor and Claude Code to drive engineering velocity and architectural excellence across the team.

  

The ideal candidate will lead development across enterprise product lines (Agile Requirements Designer, Service Virtualization, and Test Data Manager), architectural design, complex problem solving, and mentorship of engineering peers.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1\. Architectural Leadership \& Solution Design**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead technical design, architecture, and feature implementation across complex, multi\-component enterprise software products.
* Champion and scale AI\-assisted development practices (such as Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) across the engineering team to maximize velocity and code quality.
* Perform deep root\-cause analysis for complex system defects and architect robust, scalable fixes across backend and frontend stacks.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Solution Architects, and UX leads to translate business requirements into technical blueprints.

**2\. Senior Hands\-On Development \& Implementation**
------------------------------------------------------

* Architect and write scalable, highly maintainable, and robust code using Java 17\+ (Spring Boot) and modern React (TypeScript).
* Design containerized microservice architectures using Docker and Kubernetes orchestration configurations.
* Build, optimize, and maintain complex RESTful APIs, asynchronous messaging, and database schemas.
* Establish advanced workflows in AI coding environments (Cursor, Claude Code) to automate refactoring, test generation, and documentation.
* Conduct high\-rigor peer code reviews, ensuring strict compliance with security baselines, design patterns, and quality standards.

**3\. Quality Engineering \& AI System Validation**
---------------------------------------------------

* Architect end\-to\-end testing strategies covering unit, integration, performance, and security testing across microservices and AI\-enabled modules.
* Implement automated verification pipelines for AI/ML features, ensuring correctness, accuracy, and edge\-case resilience.
* Monitor enterprise application performance in production, establishing observability, logging, and automated alerting metrics.

**4\. Technical Mentorship \& Process Innovation**
--------------------------------------------------

* Define technical standards, design patterns, and engineering best practices for the organization.
* Mentor engineers on advanced full\-stack techniques, system design, and pragmatic AI\-assisted workflows.
* Evaluate and introduce innovative technologies, tools, and frameworks that deliver clear business and technical ROI.

**Required Technical Expertise**
================================

**Core Programming Languages \& Frameworks**
--------------------------------------------

* Java 17\+: Spring Boot 3\.5\+, Microservices, REST APIs, Performance Tuning
* React: TypeScript, JavaScript ES6\+, hooks, custom state management
* Docker \& Container Orchestration: Dockerfile optimization, multi\-stage builds, Kubernetes/EKS
* SQL \& Data Architecture: Complex query optimization, schema design

**AI Coding Tools \& Workflows**
--------------------------------

* AI\-Assisted Development Tools: Expert\-level proficiency in Cursor IDE (agentic workflows, context windows), Claude Code CLI, GitHub Copilot.
* Prompt \& Agent Workflows: Advanced prompt engineering, context orchestration, and automated agent workflows for engineering teams.

**Enterprise Technology Stack**
-------------------------------

* Backend Architecture: Spring Boot, Microservices, Event\-driven architecture, RESTful APIs, GraphQL
* Frontend Ecosystem: React, TypeScript, Angular (legacy maintenance/migration), Vite, Webpack
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL, Oracle, MongoDB (NoSQL), database migration frameworks
* DevOps \& CI/CD: Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitLab CI, Gradle, Maven
* Security \& Compliance: Keycloak, OAuth2, JWT, PII detection, and secure coding practices

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

**Education \& Experience**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related technical field.
* Minimum of 12\+ years of hands\-on software development experience in full\-stack enterprise product engineering.
* Proven technical leadership track record delivering enterprise\-grade software products built with Java/Spring Boot, React, and Docker.
* Mastered hands\-on usage of modern AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code) in daily development workflows.
* Proven ability to mentor engineers and drive architectural standards across engineering groups.

**Leadership \& Soft Skills**
-----------------------------

f37d7a39.title: Associate Director - AI Infrastructure Architect (AI Factory)
f37d7a39.description:
**Summary**
 Novartis architecture principles call for AI adoption guided by business value: AI is evaluated for new solutions and enhancements wherever it delivers a clear benefit, and it must be delivered on infrastructure that is secure, compliant and economically sustainable. Within Cloud \& Hosting Services, AI \& HPC Engineering is the single product management and delivery channel for AI infrastructure and AI use\-case onboarding. The AI Infrastructure Architect sets the architecture those platforms are built to.
   

  

 The role defines the reference architecture and guardrails for AI workloads across Azure, AWS and private AI environments: training and inference platforms, GPU capacity and scheduling, data pipelines and data access, model operations, logging, monitoring, cost control and lifecycle governance. It establishes the standard intake pattern by which an AI use case moves from idea to a hosted, monitored, auditable service, so that scientists and business teams get speed without the organisation inheriting uncontrolled risk.
   

  

 This is an individual contributor architecture role. Its authority comes from design quality, evidence and adoption rather than from line management.
   

  

**About The Role**
**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own the AI infrastructure reference architecture and the standards that govern training, fine\-tuning, inference and retrieval\-augmented patterns across public cloud and private AI hosting.
* Define the standard AI workload intake pattern, including architecture review criteria, data classification handling, environment selection and the conditions under which a use case may go to production.
* Set guardrails for sensitive data, model access, prompt and inference logging, monitoring, resilience, retention and cost, in partnership with Security, Data Privacy and Quality.
* Design GPU and accelerator capacity patterns \- shared pools, reservations, scheduling, quotas and burst to cloud \- and support the associated capacity and cost models.
* Support qualification of AI platforms, regions and services for enterprise consumption together with AI \& HPC Engineering and the public cloud architects.
* Define the MLOps and LLMOps reference chain: model registry, versioning, evaluation, deployment, drift and performance monitoring, and decommissioning.
* Maintain architecture decision records for AI platform choices, linking each to business value, risk posture and total cost of ownership.
* Advise business, research and Infrastructure Solution Delivery stakeholders on feasible AI infrastructure options, and translate scientific and commercial requirements into technical designs.
* Track the AI infrastructure market, evaluate emerging accelerators, model\-serving stacks and platform services, and bring credible innovation into the roadmap.
* Coach engineers and architects on AI infrastructure practice and act as a role model for the Novartis Values and Behaviours.


**Essential Requirement**
* 8\+ years' experience in infrastructure, cloud, or platform architecture, with a strong track record of designing and supporting enterprise\-scale technology solutions.
* Demonstrated expertise in building, deploying, and operating AI and machine learning infrastructure within production environments.
* Experience enabling AI solutions to transition from proof\-of\-concept stages into scalable, governed, and business\-critical services.
* Strong knowledge of GPU and accelerator technologies, Kubernetes, container orchestration, and cloud\-based AI platforms such as Azure and AWS.
* Hands\-on experience with model serving, inference optimization, MLOps/LLMOps practices, and modern data and vector pipeline architectures.
* Solid understanding of identity and access management, observability, cost optimization (FinOps), and secure AI platform operations.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI principles, including explainability, auditability, logging, human oversight, and risk management controls.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI infrastructure concepts to technical and non\-technical audiences while driving collaboration across engineering, security, privacy, and business teams.


**Desirable Requirement**
* Fluent English, written and spoken. Additional languages are an asset.

 You can find everything you need to know about our benefits and rewards in the Novartis Life Handbook. https://www.novartis.com/careers/benefits\-rewards
   

  

**Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**

Combining to achieve breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. Ready to create a brighter future together? https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people\-and\-culture

95224ad2.title: Program Manager
95224ad2.description:
**About the company** 




 TinkerLabs is a problem\-solving and innovation consulancy that applies Design Thinking and Behavioral Science to address complex business and social impact challenges. Since 2013, the team has partnered with 100\+ organizations across 15\+ industries, including Fortune 500 companies, leading Indian enterprises, and global non\-profits. Clients range from Microsoft, Unilever, Tata Group, Mahindra \& Mahindra, Flipkart, and L\&T to the Gates Foundation, UNFPA, and GIZ. Through consulting engagements, sprints, and workshops, TinkerLabs helps teams generate bold, human\-centered, and simple ideas that drive meaningful change. More information about their work and collaborations is available at www.tinkerlabs.in.
 



  





**About the role** 





 Can you turn ambitious project visions into seamless operational reality? We are hiring for a
 
**Program Manager** 

 who can balance high\-energy facilitation with rigorous operational mastery for a very important and elaborate education programme at TinkerLabs. 
 




  






 We’ve partnered with a large corporate to equip students from design and engineering institutes in India to build products and services for a social impact cause using our methodology. The goal is to help students build strong ideas and connect them to an incubator that brings their ideas to life. 
 




  






 We’re looking for a Program Manager who can run this national\-scale design thinking workshop program \- you’ll be the force that turns a complex programme run smoothly for all stakeholders involved. And when a session needs a facilitator, you are able to stand up and run it yourself.
 




  






 This is not a coordination role. You are expected to shape the plan for the year, defend it with the client, and then deliver it.
 




  





**What will you do** 



* **Master multi\-city operations:** 

 Build and manage the end\-to\-end programme roadmap across multiple colleges nationwide. Track milestones, coordinate schedules, mitigate risks and bottlenecks, manage stakeholder and client communications and ensure seamless delivery
* **Organise the chaos:** 

 Drive key activities and keep track of all moving parts \- institutional partnerships, workshop content, facilitators training, workshop sessions, student submissions, feedback loops and important project tasks without missing a beat
* **Manage client trust:** 

 Lead client\-facing communications with poise and empathy. Set clear expectations, navigate bottlenecks seamlessly and bring grounding and ease to complex timelines
* **Streamline team resourcing:** 

 Balance workloads, forecast talent needs and hire the right people
* **Manage hybrid delivery:** 

 Seamlessly bridge the gap between digital learning platforms and in\-person events across various facilitators\- keeping student engagement consistent and the quality of project high
* **Facilitate with high energy:** 

 Lead engaging, interactive design thinking workshops both in\-person and online



  





**What are we looking for:** 




*Must haves:* 



* **Proven facilitation \& coaching experience:** 

 3\+ years of experience leading workshops, teaching, or facilitating design thinking, human\-centered design (HCD), or experiential learning modules.
* **Genuine facilitation ability:** 

 Has ability to command a room independently for 30\+ participants \- adapt on the fly when an exercise isn't landing, and build quick rapport with college students and faculty alike
* **Strong project management chops:** 

 Track record of managing complex projects/programmes with multiple moving parts, stakeholders, and strict deadlines \- nothing goes missing when working with you
* **Solid client management and communication skills** 

 : Comfortable delivering bad news, collaborating on solutions, sending clear emails and being seen as a trustworthy face for the client.
* **Willingness to travel:** 

 Eagerness to travel to college campuses across India (Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3\) for live workshop modules



  





*Good to haves:* 



* Experience
 
**working with colleges, universities or student communities** 

 in India.
* **Comfort using AI tools** 

 as part of workshop delivery and content preparation.
* A
 
**design or education** 

 background.



  





**Besides the work, what is in it for you:** 



* **Ownership from day one.** 

 You won't just follow a playbook \- you will shape how this massive programme journey unfolds and scales.
* **High\-impact learning.** 

 You will watch students transform from passive learners into confident, empathetic problem\-solvers over the course of a full academic year.
* **High Impact, High Velocity:** 

 We move fast and aim high, offering an environment where you do meaningful, rewarding work while respecting personal boundaries.



  





**How to apply:** 





 To help us get a feel for how you think, we’d love for you to respond to one question:
 





 Tell us about a time when you managed a complex, long\-term project with many moving parts. What were the main challenges and how did you pivot from there?
 




  





*Please feel free to share the response in any format you would do justice to \- write it, draw it, record it.* 




  






 Please share your
 
**response, updated resume and relevant work sample/facilitation videos** 

 to
 
**curios@tinkerlabs.in** 

 with the subject line:
 
**Program Manager\_(Your name)** 




  





*As a human will review all the applications, everyone will receive a reply in due time*

d640ff0e.title: Program Manager
d640ff0e.description:
**What Makes This Role Different**
----------------------------------


This is not a traditional project\-management role focused only on schedules, meetings, and status reports.


At Mirabilis Design, the Program Manager works across the full business cycle, from **product development and bug resolution to customer evaluations, sales opportunities, support activities, and marketing programs**. For someone interested in developing into a future **Program Leader, Product Manager, Operations Leader, or Business Leader**, this role offers significant learning and responsibility.


You will have visibility into what is happening across the organization and will play a key role in keeping teams aligned, identifying issues early, and ensuring that important commitments move forward.


The role provides direct exposure to:


* Engineering and product development
* Customer requirements and technical evaluations
* Sales opportunities and commercial priorities
* Marketing campaigns, events, and programs
* Product releases and support activities
* Senior management decision\-making


You will not simply report progress. You will help **drive progress**.


For someone who wants to understand how a technology company operates end\-to\-end and build experience across product, operations, customers, and business, this is an excellent opportunity.


**Location:** Chennai, India, Hybrid or Remote as applicable  

**Experience:** 3\+ years of relevant experience, or recent MBA with strong internship experience  

**Function:** Program Management / Operations / Cross\-Functional Execution


**About the Role**
------------------


Mirabilis Design is looking for a highly organized, proactive, and execution\-focused **Program Manager** to help coordinate activities across product development, customer support, product evaluations, sales, and marketing.


This is a highly cross\-functional role with visibility across the organization. The Program Manager will work with engineering, sales, marketing, customer\-facing teams, and management to ensure that assignments are clearly understood, properly owned, progressing according to plan, and completed on time.


The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys bringing structure to complex activities, following through on commitments, identifying risks early, and ensuring that teams remain aligned.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


The Program Manager will coordinate and track activities across multiple areas of the business, including:


* Product development and release activities
* Bug identification, prioritization, tracking, and resolution
* Customer support and technical follow\-up
* Product evaluations, trials, and customer deliverables
* Sales opportunities and related internal actions
* Marketing programs, campaigns, webinars, events, and content activities


You will be responsible for ensuring that every important activity has clear ownership, timelines, dependencies, and measurable progress.


A key part of the role is not simply tracking whether an assignment has been made, but confirming that it is actually progressing as expected.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


* Coordinate activities across engineering, product, sales, marketing, and customer\-facing teams
* Maintain visibility into open assignments, priorities, deadlines, and dependencies
* Follow up with team members to confirm progress and completion
* Obtain regular feedback to verify that programs are progressing according to plan
* Identify delays, bottlenecks, resource conflicts, and execution risks early
* Escalate issues before they become major schedule or customer problems
* Track customer evaluations, support requirements, product issues, and related internal actions
* Ensure important customer and sales commitments receive timely follow\-up
* Help coordinate product releases, bug fixes, demonstrations, evaluations, and marketing initiatives
* Provide concise **daily progress updates** and structured **weekly management reports**
* Highlight accomplishments, risks, delayed activities, dependencies, and actions requiring management attention
* Continuously improve internal processes for planning, tracking, communication, and execution

**Who We Are Looking For**
--------------------------


Candidates should have one of the following backgrounds:


* **3\+ years of experience** in program management, project management, product operations, engineering operations, or a similar role


**OR**


* A **recent MBA graduate** with strong and relevant internship or prior work experience in technology, product management, operations, consulting, engineering, or program management

**Desired Skills**
------------------


The successful candidate should have:


* Strong organizational and follow\-up skills
* Excellent written and verbal communication
* Ability to work across technical and business teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Strong attention to detail
* Ability to identify problems and bottlenecks before they impact delivery
* Confidence working with engineering, sales, marketing, customers, and senior management
* Ability to summarize complex activities into clear management updates
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability
* Comfort working in a fast\-moving technology environment


Experience in semiconductors, electronics, EDA, software products, aerospace, automotive, or other engineering\-focused industries is an advantage.

c8a00072.title: Presales Engineer
c8a00072.description:
**About Covlant** 

  






 Covlant is building the AI\-native quality layer for modern software teams. Most engineering organizations face the same trade\-off on every release: run the entire regression suite and wait hours for feedback, or run a subset and risk letting defects slip into production. Covlant removes that trade\-off.
 




  






 Our AI\-driven impact testing platform analyzes every pull request against a deep map of the entire codebase to understand exactly what changed and what that change affects. It then selects the right tests from a team's existing suites to cover the impacted code paths. Where coverage is missing, Covlant's quality agents generate and validate new tests, so only meaningful, trustworthy tests are run. Engineers and QA teams stay in control through a clear review experience that shows what was tested, what passed or failed, and why.
 




  






 The result is faster feedback loops, leaner regression cycles, lower test\-maintenance overhead, and greater confidence in every release. Covlant fits into the tools teams already use across their CI/CD pipelines and development workflows.
 




  






 We're an early\-stage company working with enterprise engineering and QA teams, and we're growing our team in Bangalore. Joining Covlant now means shaping how the product is positioned, sold, and adopted, working closely with founders, Product, and Engineering, and helping define a new category in software quality.
 




  




**Role \- Presales Engineer** 

  






 Covlant is hiring a customer\-facing Presales Engineer to lead technical discovery, tailored demos, proof\-of\-concepts, and solution design for enterprise prospects evaluating our software testing and quality\-engineering platform.
 




  






 The ideal candidate combines a strong technical foundation in QA space with customer\-facing solutioning experience. They should be able to engage credibly with engineering and QA teams, understand complex testing challenges, and articulate Covlant’s capabilities in terms of tangible operational and business outcomes.
 




  




**Key responsibilities** 

  




* Lead technical discovery to understand a prospect’s applications, testing maturity, release workflow, toolchain, integrations, security needs, stakeholders, and decision criteria.
* Deliver tailored product demos, workshops, architecture discussions, and technical presentations for QA, engineering, IT, and executive stakeholders.
* Scope and run POCs with clear use cases, customer commitments, success criteria, milestones, risks, and a conversion plan.
* Partner with Account Executives/Sales leadership to develop technical win plans, address objections, and progress enterprise opportunities.
* Handle technical evaluations, RFP/RFI responses, security questionnaires, integration discussions, and solution\-design requests.
* Advise prospects on test automation strategy, CI/CD integration, test reliability, regression efficiency, and implementation best practices.
* Translate product capabilities into quantified customer value—for example, reduced regression effort, faster release cycles, lower test\-maintenance cost, improved automation coverage, and reduced production\-defect risk—and build credible ROI/value cases for buyers.
* Create reusable demo environments, discovery frameworks, POC templates, solution briefs, and competitive/technical collateral.
* Feed recurring customer needs, objections, gaps, and market insights back to Product, Engineering, and GTM teams.
* Ensure a structured technical handoff from closed\-won opportunities to implementation or customer\-success teams.



  




**Ideal candidate profile** 

  




* 4–7 years of overall experience, with meaningful early hands\-on work in software development, QA, SDET, test automation, or implementation.
* 2–4 years in a customer\-facing technical role: Presales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Solution Consultant, Technical Consultant, or similar.
* Strong experience in QA/testing and automation, including practical familiarity with tools and concepts such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, API testing, CI/CD, Git, Jira, Jenkins/GitHub Actions, cloud testing, and test frameworks.
* Can communicate confidently with QA leads, engineering leaders, architects, product teams, and executive sponsors.
* Has led or materially contributed to tailored demos, POCs, technical discovery, solution proposals, and enterprise evaluations.
* Comfortable navigating integrations, APIs, SSO/RBAC, security reviews, cloud/SaaS architecture, and enterprise buying processes.
* Commercially aware: able to turn technical outcomes into a business case, quantify impact, and support sales teams through complex deal cycles.
* High ownership and comfortable operating in an early\-stage SaaS environment.
