We are looking for an experienced AI Transformation Consultant – Pre\-Sales \& Discovery to work with U.S.\-based small and mid\-sized businesses and help them identify opportunities where AI, automation, workflow optimization, and process redesign can deliver measurable business value.

This is a senior, client\-facing consulting and pre\-sales role. The ideal candidate should be comfortable engaging with business owners and senior executives, understanding business processes, identifying operational challenges, assessing AI opportunities, developing business cases, and presenting transformation recommendations.

**Key Responsibilities**  
**1\. Executive Workshops \& Client Engagement**

* Conduct structured AI opportunity and transformation workshops with U.S. clients.
* Engage with business owners, senior leaders, functional heads, and process owners.
* Educate clients on practical applications of AI, automation, knowledge systems, and workflow redesign.
* Identify meaningful AI opportunities rather than promoting AI tools without a clear business case.
* Adapt discovery and workshop discussions based on the client's industry and business challenges.

**2\. Business Discovery \& Process Analysis**

* Conduct detailed discussions and interviews with senior stakeholders.
* Understand business models, operational workflows, existing systems, challenges, and growth objectives.
* Identify bottlenecks, repetitive processes, information gaps, decision delays, and customer experience issues.
* Document current\-state processes and define desired business outcomes.
* Determine whether a problem requires **process improvement, automation, AI, or a combination of solutions**.

**3\. AI Opportunity Assessment**

* Identify and prioritise approximately **3–7 AI/process improvement opportunities** for each qualified client.
* Evaluate opportunities based on:
* Business value
* Implementation feasibility
* Risk
* Data readiness
* Time to impact
* Develop current\-state and future\-state process maps.
* Estimate potential:
* Cost savings
* Time savings
* Productivity/capacity improvements
* Revenue impact
* Customer experience improvements
* Develop phased transformation roadmaps covering quick wins and longer\-term initiatives.

**4\. Pre\-Sales \& Commercial Conversion**

* Present AI transformation findings and recommendations to senior client stakeholders.
* Build compelling, evidence\-based business cases linked to the client's strategic and financial objectives.
* Work closely with sales leadership to develop proposals, implementation approaches, and commercial opportunities.
* Position implementation services as the logical next step following the assessment.
* Maintain follow\-up with qualified opportunities through conversion.
* Contribute to the development of a strong implementation pipeline.

**5\. Internal Capability Development**

* Develop reusable discovery questionnaires, workshop frameworks, assessment methodologies, and industry\-specific AI use\-case libraries.
* Identify recurring client challenges and convert them into scalable service offerings.
* Enable sales and account management teams to identify qualified AI transformation opportunities.
* Continuously improve assessment methodologies based on client feedback and implementation outcomes.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* **8\+ years of experience** in one or more of the following:
* Management Consulting
* Business Transformation
* Digital Transformation
* Process Excellence
* Business Process Management
* Enterprise Pre\-Sales
* AI / Intelligent Automation Consulting
* Business Analysis with senior client\-facing responsibility
* Strong experience working directly with **senior executives and business stakeholders**.
* Excellent ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and processes quickly.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, process\-mapping, and facilitation skills.
* Ability to convert business problems into **quantifiable business cases and ROI opportunities**.
* Strong consultative selling and stakeholder management skills.
* Excellent presentation and executive communication skills.
* Working knowledge of:
* Generative AI
* AI automation
* Workflow automation
* Knowledge management systems
* Modern SaaS platforms
* Ability to effectively use AI tools for research, analysis, synthesis, and creating client deliverables.
* Prior experience working with **U.S. clients** and understanding the U.S. business environment.

Interested candidates drop your resume to **jobs@prognova.co**

Pay: From ₹1,500,000\.00 per year

Work Location: In person

0a0a6a77.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
0a0a6a77.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

  

AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
  

  

Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
  

  

AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.  

  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.  

  

As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.  

  

Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.  

  

You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.  

  

As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
  

  

To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.  

  

Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).  

  

A day in the life  

The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.  

  

About the team  

ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.  

  

You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

7bb19d16.description:

 6 Months – 1 Year
   

  

**Location:** 
 Indore, Madhya Pradesh
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 Work From Office
   

  

**Notice Period:** 
 15–30 Days Preferred
   

  

**About GrowwStacks**
 GrowwStacks Automation Solutions specializes in business process automation, IT automation, low\-code/no\-code solutions, RPA, AI, and workflow automation. We help businesses improve efficiency and streamline operations through technology\-driven solutions.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 We are looking for an
 **IT Client Solutions Executive** 
 to manage client interactions from
 **qualified lead to proposal closure and project handover** 
 .
   

  

 This is a
 **client\-focused role and not a lead\-generation position** 
 . The candidate will work with qualified leads provided by the company, understand client requirements, conduct discovery calls, coordinate with the technical team to identify suitable solutions, prepare proposals, manage client follow\-ups, and support a smooth transition from pre\-sales to delivery.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a client\-first approach, strong coordination abilities, and the willingness to learn and understand new IT solutions.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Connect with qualified leads and manage initial client communication.
* Conduct discovery calls to understand client requirements, business processes, challenges, and expectations.
* Gather and document client requirements accurately.
* Understand GrowwStacks' services and identify suitable solutions based on client requirements.
* Coordinate with developers and project managers to validate technical feasibility and solution approach.
* Prepare and coordinate project proposals including scope, deliverables, timelines, and commercials.
* Present and explain proposed solutions to clients in a clear and professional manner.
* Handle client queries and coordinate internally to provide appropriate responses.
* Conduct regular follow\-ups with clients regarding proposals, feedback, revisions, and next steps.
* Maintain professional relationships with clients throughout the pre\-sales process.
* Coordinate the handover from client discussions to the technical/delivery team with complete requirements and project details.
* Stay involved after handover whenever required to ensure smooth communication between the client and internal teams.
* Maintain proper records of requirements, proposals, client communication, and follow\-ups.


**Requirements**
* Graduate in a technical discipline such as B.Tech, B.E., MCA, M.Tech, or equivalent.
* 6 Months – 1 Year of relevant experience in IT client servicing, pre\-sales, business analysis, solution consulting, project coordination, or IT services.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Confident in handling client calls and requirement discussions.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
* Basic understanding of IT services and willingness to learn automation, AI, RPA, and related technologies.
* Good proposal preparation, follow\-up, coordination, and documentation skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with both clients and technical teams.
* Proactive, organized, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a client\-facing environment.
* Candidates must be based in Indore.
* Candidates with a 15–30 day notice period will be preferred.

21e1b817.title: HCLS Solutions lead IRC302899
21e1b817.description:
**Description**
 Join GlobalLogic’s Architects Team within the Healthcare Business Unit in India, supporting clients globally. This strategic role focuses on engaging new clients, solving real\-world healthcare challenges, and launching data\-driven AI/ML projects. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to translate complex business needs into impactful data science solutions. If you’re passionate about applying data science in a meaningful domain and want to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
   

  

 15\+ years of experience in MedTech/ Healthcare domain architecting and building platforms (SaMD, IOMT), well versed with EMR, EHR, DICOM, PACS, Clinical workflows
   

  

 Experience in data science or machine learning roles, with exposure to healthcare projects.
   

  

 Good expertise and skills using Claude/Codex or equivalent AI tools to do research, planning, software development and testing.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python and/or any other programming language (C/C\+\+, JAVA, C\#, etc)
   

  

 Strong communication and visualization skills for storytelling with data.
   

  

 Experience building cloud solutions (Azure, AWS, or GCP – at least one strong) using native hyperscaler services.
   

  

 Experience with LLM and GenAI constraints and limitations and how to overcome those.
   

  

 English proficiency at Advanced level.
   

  

 Good presentation and demonstration skills
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the design and development of solutions across HealthTech and MedTech projects.
   

  

 Be comfortable with ambiguity, onsite/embedded work, have willingness to travel and work directly at the customer’s environment, building solutions under a hard deadline with incomplete requirements.
   

  

 Participate in technical presales by analyzing business cases and identifying opportunities for AI/ML application.
   

  

 Lead Discovery and/or Advisory projects, understand customer’s needs, collect inputs and pain points from the customer and create working SW prototypes within limited time to demonstrate feasibility \& value.
   

  

 Collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and QA to further develop prototypes into scalable production systems.
   

  

 Contribute to the development of GlobalLogic’s healthcare\-focused AI accelerators and reusable components.
   

  

 Present technical solutions to clients, both business and technical audiences.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to privacy, security, and compliance standards for data and AI usage.
   

  

 Author clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

7f25aaa5.title: Forward Deployed AI Architect
7f25aaa5.description:
BOTS.AI (HR Anexi) · Mumbai, Andheri West · Full\-time, on\-site
 



**About BOTS.AI** 




 BOTS.AI is the AI deployment wing of HR Anexi, built on 19\+ years of working inside Indian organisations. We don't ship demos. We build agents that do the work every day, in production: chasing collections, reconciling invoices, booking dealer orders and closing out plant analytics. Our clients range from family\-run businesses to listed companies and global multinationals, across consumer retail, financial services, agri\-commodities, and diamonds and jewellery. Every deployment is a new environment and a new problem, and what we learn in one becomes the starting point for the next.
 



**The problem** 




 India's largest family\-run businesses are ready for AI. Their systems are not. Critical processes live in WhatsApp groups, spreadsheets and the experience of a few senior managers. Technology companies build models and advisory firms build strategies, but very few build working systems inside that reality. That is the work we do.
 



**The role** 




 The Forward Deployed AI Architect is responsible for turning a client's workflow into a system that runs reliably in production, and for proving the value it creates. You design the architecture and you build it. On every engagement you work alongside our Principal, AI Transformation, who owns the client relationship, the commercials and adoption. You own the design, the build and the evidence that it works.
 



**What an engagement involves** 



* **Discovery.** 
 Working directly with finance, HR, sales or plant teams to understand how work actually moves, and deciding what should be automated, what should use an existing tool, and what should remain with people.
* **Build.** 
 Designing and building the system, including its integration with the client's existing software, its safeguards and its monitoring.
* **Proof.** 
 Measuring accuracy, speed, cost and usage, and presenting the results in a form a CFO can use to decide whether to scale.
* **Compounding.** 
 Converting each successful deployment into a reusable design, and turning repeated client problems into agents BOTS.AI builds and sells as its own products.



**The standard we hire to** 




 We do not require years of experience in AI. The field is too young for that to be a meaningful measure. We require evidence of what you have already done. The strongest candidates will be able to show that they have:
 


* **Owned a system in production that other people depended on,** 
 in any discipline (software, data, cloud, infrastructure or enterprise systems), and been accountable when it failed.
* **Built something with AI on their own initiative:** 
 a tool, an agent, an automation or a competition entry, created because they wanted to understand the technology, not because a role required it.
* **Measured their work in business terms,** 
 such as cost reduced, time saved, errors eliminated or adoption achieved.
* **Explained a technical decision to a non\-technical decision\-maker** 
 and seen it adopted.
* **Taught, documented or mentored** 
 in a way that made others more capable.



 Candidates typically bring 5–10 years of experience. Our own architects have come from backgrounds such as DevOps and site reliability engineering. What matters is the evidence above, not the title you held.
 



  





**What you will become here** 




 Within your first year, you will have designed and delivered production AI systems across several industries, built reference architectures used on engagements you were not part of, and contributed directly to the products BOTS.AI takes to market. Few roles in India offer this range of real deployment experience this early in the field's development.
 



  





**This role is not suited to candidates who** 



* Require a complete specification before engaging with a problem
* Consider a working demonstration to be a finished result
* Prefer presenting to leadership over working alongside operational teams



  





**Selection process** 



1. **Application.** 
 Your CV and a short written note covering two things: one system you owned in production (what it did, what went wrong, and what you changed), and one thing you built with AI on your own initiative (why you built it and what you learned).
2. **Conversation with founder's office** 
 (30 minutes).
3. **Work sample.** 
 We share an anonymised client workflow or a problem statement. You submit a one\-page design and discuss it with us in a 45\-minute session. (Subjective)
4. **Team conversation.**



 We aim to complete the process within 2 weeks.

f936127e.title: Application Consultant-AWS Cloud
f936127e.description:
**Introduction**
 A career in IBM Consulting is built on long\-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You’ll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you’ll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You’ll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long\-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As an Application Consultant for AWS Cloud, you will lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement and utilize your strong understanding of software architecture fundamentals to drive project success. You will collaborate with clients to deliver successful projects, leveraging your proficiency in cloud implementation methodologies like the garage method.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**
* Implement Cloud Architecture: Lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement, utilizing your knowledge of software architecture fundamentals and cloud native development principles to ensure successful project delivery.
* Collaborate with Clients: Work closely with clients to understand their needs and deliver tailored solutions, leveraging your strong communication and leadership skills to ensure effective collaboration and project success.
* Map Components to AWS Services: Utilize your experience with AWS to map existing components and functionalities to AWS\-specific services, ensuring seamless integration and optimal system performance.
* Develop Cloud Solutions: Apply your proficiency in technologies like Node.js, Spring Boot, or Netflix OSS to develop cloud solutions that meet client needs and adhere to cloud native development principles.
* Provide Technical Guidance: Offer technical guidance and support to clients, leveraging your knowledge of cloud computing fundamentals, containers, and serverless computing to help them make informed decisions about their cloud architecture.


**Preferred Education**
 Master's Degree
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
* Software Architecture Fundamentals: Exposure to software architecture fundamentals, including design patterns and principles, to lead the implementation of architecture for omnichannel systems of engagement.
* Cloud Implementation Methodologies: Proficiency in using the garage method for cloud implementation, with experience working with cloud native development principles, containers, and serverless computing fundamentals.
* API and Microservices Architecture: Experience working with API and Microservices\-based architecture implementation, with proficiency in at least one of the following technologies: Node.js, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, or Netflix OSS.
* AWS Services Mapping: Experience with AWS, including the ability to map existing components/functionalities to AWS\-specific services, with a solid understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of related AWS Services.
* Cloud Development Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript, CSS, and familiarity with Angular.js, with the ability to apply this knowledge to develop cloud solutions.


**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
* Familiarity with Scripting Technologies: Exposure to scripting technologies like JavaScript and CSS is beneficial for developing cloud solutions. Knowledge of these technologies can be applied to create tailored solutions for clients.
* Knowledge of Angular.js: Familiarity with Angular.js is advantageous for developing cloud solutions, allowing for more versatile and effective solutions to be delivered to clients.

df111201.title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI and DATA - Azure Data Architect - Manager
df111201.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS – Data and Analytics (D\&A) – Manager – Azure Data Architect**
 As part of our EY\-GDS D\&A (Data and Analytics) team, we help our clients solve complex business challenges with the help of data and technology. We dive deep into data to extract the greatest value and discover opportunities in key business and functions like Banking, Insurance, Manufacturing, Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing and Auto, Supply Chain, and Finance.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 We’re looking for Managers (Big Data Architects) with strong technology and data understanding having proven delivery capability. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm as well as a part of a growing Data and Analytics team.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Develop standardized practices for delivering new products and capabilities using Big Data \& cloud technologies, including data acquisition, transformation, analysis, Modelling, Governance \& Data management skills
* Interact with senior client technology leaders, understand their business goals, create, propose solution, estimate effort, build architectures, develop and deliver technology solutions
* Define and develop client specific best practices around data management within a cloud environment
* Recommend design alternatives for data ingestion, processing and provisioning layers
* Design and develop data ingestion programs to process large data sets in Batch mode using ADB, ADF, PySpark, Python, Snypase
* Develop data ingestion programs to ingest real\-time data from LIVE sources using Apache Kafka, Spark Streaming and related technologies
* Have managed team and have experience in end to end delivery
* Have experience of building technical capability and teams to deliver


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Strong understanding \& familiarity with all Cloud Ecosystem components
* Strong understanding of underlying Cloud Architectural concepts and distributed computing paradigms
* Experience in the development of large scale data processing.
* Hands\-on programming experience in ADB, ADF, Synapse, Python, PySpark, SQL
* Hands\-on expertise in cloud services like AWS, and/or Microsoft Azure eco system
* Solid understanding of ETL methodologies in a multi\-tiered stack with Data Modelling \& Data Governance
* Experience with BI, and data analytics databases
* Experience in converting business problems/challenges to technical solutions considering security, performance, scalability etc.
* Experience in Enterprise grade solution implementations.
* Experience in performance bench marking enterprise applications
* Strong stakeholder, client, team, process \& delivery management skills


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Design and propose Azure\-based data and AI solutions that align with customer objectives and solve business challenges.
* Develop and present demonstrations, prototypes, and PoCs to showcase the value and capabilities of the proposed solutions.
* Create technical proposals, presentations, and respond to requests for proposals (RFPs) and information (RFIs).
* Lead the technical aspects of project delivery, ensuring that implementations align with the initial solution design.
* Define and implement best practices and agile methodologies for the delivery of scalable Cloud solutions.
* Provide expert guidance on data strategy, cloud architecture, and the technology stacks needed for data modernization, AI, and machine learning workloads.
* Data: Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake, Azure Data Factory, Azure SQL, and Cosmos DB.
* AI/ML (knowledge): Azure Machine Learning, Azure Cognitive Services, and Azure OpenAI.
* Minimum 7 years hand\-on experience in one or more of the above areas.
* Minimum 10 years industry experience


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Project management skills
* Client management skills
* Solutioning skills


**What We Look For**
* People with technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

aaf08547.title: HCLS Solutions lead IRC302899
aaf08547.description:
**Description**
 Join GlobalLogic’s Architects Team within the Healthcare Business Unit in India, supporting clients globally. This strategic role focuses on engaging new clients, solving real\-world healthcare challenges, and launching data\-driven AI/ML projects. You will work closely with clients and internal stakeholders to translate complex business needs into impactful data science solutions. If you’re passionate about applying data science in a meaningful domain and want to shape the future of healthcare, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

**Requirements**
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, or related field.
   

  

 15\+ years of experience in MedTech/ Healthcare domain architecting and building platforms (SaMD, IOMT), well versed with EMR, EHR, DICOM, PACS, Clinical workflows
   

  

 Experience in data science or machine learning roles, with exposure to healthcare projects.
   

  

 Good expertise and skills using Claude/Codex or equivalent AI tools to do research, planning, software development and testing.
   

  

 Proficiency in Python and/or any other programming language (C/C\+\+, JAVA, C\#, etc)
   

  

 Strong communication and visualization skills for storytelling with data.
   

  

 Experience building cloud solutions (Azure, AWS, or GCP – at least one strong) using native hyperscaler services.
   

  

 Experience with LLM and GenAI constraints and limitations and how to overcome those.
   

  

 English proficiency at Advanced level.
   

  

 Good presentation and demonstration skills
   

  

 Job responsibilities
   

  

 Lead the design and development of solutions across HealthTech and MedTech projects.
   

  

 Be comfortable with ambiguity, onsite/embedded work, have willingness to travel and work directly at the customer’s environment, building solutions under a hard deadline with incomplete requirements.
   

  

 Participate in technical presales by analyzing business cases and identifying opportunities for AI/ML application.
   

  

 Lead Discovery and/or Advisory projects, understand customer’s needs, collect inputs and pain points from the customer and create working SW prototypes within limited time to demonstrate feasibility \& value.
   

  

 Collaborate with software engineers, cloud architects, and QA to further develop prototypes into scalable production systems.
   

  

 Contribute to the development of GlobalLogic’s healthcare\-focused AI accelerators and reusable components.
   

  

 Present technical solutions to clients, both business and technical audiences.
   

  

 Ensure adherence to privacy, security, and compliance standards for data and AI usage.
   

  

 Author clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.
   

  

 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:** 
 We provide our employees with competitive salaries, family medical insurance, Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance , NPS(National Pension Scheme ), Periodic health awareness program, extended maternity leave, annual performance bonuses, and referral bonuses.
   

  

**Fun Perks:** 
 We want you to love where you work, which is why we host sports events, cultural activities, offer food on subsidies rates, Corporate parties. Our vibrant offices also include dedicated GL Zones, rooftop decks and GL Club where you can drink coffee or tea with your colleagues over a game of table and offer discounts for popular stores and restaurants!
   

  

**About GlobalLogic**
 GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward\-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

d9798685.title: Cloud Consultant (Infor WFM, Java, 3-5 Yrs)
d9798685.description:
**Department:** 
 Infor Consulting Services
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad
   

  

**Description**
 We are seeking a techno\-functional WFM Consultant with 3\+ years of experience in the Infor Workforce Management (WFM) suite. The ideal candidate will have expertise in implementing, enhancing, and supporting Infor WFM solutions, with strong functional and technical knowledge to effectively address business requirements primarily for customers in AMER region which requires working in night shift.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**A Typical Day in the Life Includes:**
 As a Senior WFM Consultant for IMS, the candidate will be required to perform the following:
   

  

* Collaborate as a core member of the IMS WFM team, working closely with customers, business stakeholders, and Infor team members across various functions and levels.
* Leverage and enhance techno\-functional expertise in the Infor WFM suite and related third\-party technologies to support application configuration, customization, enhancements, and user enablement initiatives.
* Drive end\-to\-end delivery of Infor WFM enhancements and customizations, with primary focus on:


 Multi\-Viewer Scheduler (MVS) for advanced workforce scheduling and operational visibility.
   

  

 Time \& Attendance for workforce time management, compliance, and pay rule administration.
   

  

 Labor Forecasting and Budgeting (LFSO) for demand\-based planning and labour optimization.
   

  

* Analyse customer business requirements and objectives, translating them into effective functional and technical solutions that align with business needs.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and issue resolution support for complex application, configuration, and integration challenges.
* Guide customers in effectively utilizing Infor WFM tools and capabilities to maximize operational efficiency and business value.
* Support implementation, testing, deployment, and post\-production activities to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Mentor and support junior consultants by sharing knowledge, promoting best practices, and assisting with solution design and problem resolution.
* Create and maintain high\-quality documentation, knowledge articles, training materials, and change management artifacts.
* Participate in on\-call, standby, and off\-hours support activities as required to support business\-critical operations


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ss years of experience in Workforce Management (WFM) solutions, with hands\-on experience in implementation, enhancement, and support activities.
* Strong techno\-functional knowledge with hands\-on experience in developing custom solutions using Java/J2EE, Groovy Scripting, APIs, Web Services (REST/SOAP), JavaScript.
* Experience in configuring, customizing, and supporting Infor WFM applications to meet business requirements.
* Proficiency in SQL and relational databases for data analysis, troubleshooting, and reporting.
* Experience developing and supporting reports and dashboards using IBM Cognos or similar reporting tools.
* Strong understanding of workforce management concepts, scheduling practices, labor compliance, and timekeeping processes.
* Experience in requirements gathering, solution design, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex functional and technical issues and provide effective solutions.
* Familiarity with system integrations, APIs, data interfaces, and batch processing.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience working directly with customers and stakeholders in a consulting or support environment.
* Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within global, cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to participate in on\-call or off\-hours support as required


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Responsible for supporting IMS customers from AMER Region.
* Addressing techno\-functional issues (ticket based) issues.
* Meet the ticket SLAs.
* Maintain customer satisfaction levels.
* Work on development/retrofitting of customizations.
* Responsible for supporting both Cloud and On\-Prem customers


**About Infor**
 Infor is where ambition meets impact. Join a global community of bold thinkers and innovators, where your expertise doesn't just solve problems. it shapes industries, unlocks opportunities, and creates real\-world impact for billions of people. At Infor, you're not just building a career. you're helping to build what's next.
   

  

 Infor is a global leader in business cloud software products for companies in industry specific markets. Infor builds complete industry suites in the cloud and efficiently deploys technology that puts the user experience first, leverages data science, and integrates easily into existing systems. Over 60,000 organizations worldwide rely on Infor to help overcome market disruptions and achieve business\-wide digital transformation.
   

  

 For more information visit www.infor.com
   

  

**Our Values**
 At Infor, we strive for an environment that is founded on a business philosophy called Principle Based Management™ (PBM™) and eight Guiding Principles: integrity, stewardship \& compliance, transformation, principled entrepreneurship, knowledge, humility, respect, self\-actualization.
   

  

 We have a relentless commitment to a culture based on PBM™. 7814b1ec.title: Delivery Manager
7814b1ec.description:
Greetings from NAM Info Pvt Ltd,
 



  





*We have an opportunity for the position below. Please go through the job description. If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply and share your updated resume at praveen@nam\-info.com* 




  





**Role: Delivery Manager** 




**Work Location: Pune (Hinjewadi Phase 2\) — Local Pune Candidates Only** 




**Work Mode: Hybrid** 




**Client: Inferyx (Full\-time)** 




**Total Experience: 9\+ Yrs** 




  





**Interview Mode: 2 Virtual Rounds \+ 1 Face\-to\-Face Round** 




  





**About Inferyx** 




 Inferyx is a next\-generation Data Orchestration Platform enabling enterprises to build scalable Data Lakes using Medallion Architecture (
 *Bronze → Silver → Gold* 
 ) across various domains including BFSI, Telecom, Retail, Manufacturing, and Healthcare. Inferyx accelerates data engineering delivery through a low\-code orchestration engine, reducing data pipeline build times by up to 60% compared to traditional approaches.
 



  





 We are aggressively expanding our India footprint and looking for a seasoned Delivery Manager to take end\-to\-end ownership of our client delivery programs.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 As the senior delivery owner for Inferyx’s enterprise client accounts, you will inherit an active, operational engagement and serve as the single point of accountability for delivery health, stakeholder management, and client satisfaction. You will operate with high autonomy, manage technical complexity, and ensure delivery excellence—enabling our executive leadership to focus on nationwide growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Client Delivery Ownership** 



* Own end\-to\-end delivery of the Inferyx data platform, including medallion architecture implementation, sprint governance, and Go\-Live milestones.
* Lead daily/fortnightly scrum calls, sprint reviews, and stakeholder reporting.
* Maintain delivery health by tracking sprint velocity, proactively managing risks, resolving blockers, and escalating only critical exceptions to executive leadership.
* Ensure all contractual SLAs, delivery milestones, and quality standards are consistently met or exceeded.
* Maintain and update the Client Delivery Runbook, RACI matrix, and issue logs, presenting monthly summaries to Inferyx leadership.



  





**2\. Stakeholder \& Relationship Management** 



* Act as the primary senior relationship manager between Inferyx and client teams (Project Managers, Architects, and Business Owners).
* Conduct fortnightly on\-site visits to client locations to participate in steering committees, executive reviews, and architecture sessions.
* Manage delivery escalations professionally, converting challenges into opportunities to strengthen client trust.
* Identify and cultivate internal client champions to advocate for Inferyx platform adoption and expansion across other business units.



  





**3\. Program Governance \& Reporting** 



* Drive structured program governance using weekly status reports, risk registers, RAID logs, and monthly steering dashboards.
* Maintain a transparent, metric\-driven single source of truth for delivery status that is executive\-ready at all times.
* Prepare and present monthly delivery review decks to Inferyx’s Head of Technology, COO, and CEO.
* Track key delivery KPIs, including sprint velocity, defect rates, deployment frequency, and Client NPS.
* Manage Production incidents, conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and implement sustainable action plans to minimize incident recurrence.
* Manage Change Requests (CRs) professionally—scoping, pricing, and negotiating without damaging client relationships.



  





**4\. Technical Collaboration \& Platform Adoption** 



* Partner with Inferyx engineering and pre\-sales teams to ensure the platform is deployed to its maximum capability at the client site.
* Identify expansion opportunities within client accounts for new business units, additional data domains, or advanced medallion layers.
* Participate in architecture reviews, data model walkthroughs, and pipeline design sessions, applying technical depth to ask the right questions.
* Translate client feedback into actionable insights for internal product teams to shape the Inferyx product roadmap.



  





**5\. Team Leadership \& Onboarding** 



* Successfully onboard into the engagement via a structured 4–6 week handover from the outgoing delivery lead.
* Mentor and manage junior delivery resources or Business Analysts assigned to the account.
* Establish and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for repeatable delivery processes.
* Contribute to Inferyx's overall delivery methodology through best practices, reusable frameworks, and lessons learned.



  





**Qualifications \& Requirements** 




**Essential (Must Have)** 



* Experience: 9 to 13 years of total experience in technology delivery, program management, or client\-facing delivery roles within enterprise IT.
* Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of Data platforms—Data Lakes, Data Warehouses, ETL/ELT pipelines, or Data Orchestration tools.
* Architecture: Practical understanding of Medallion Architecture, Lakehouse concepts, or multi\-layer data processing (
 *Bronze / Silver / Gold* 
 ).
* Agile Governance: Hands\-on experience leading Agile/Scrum delivery (sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and velocity tracking).
* Location \& Mobility: Must be currently residing in Pune (or local to Pune) and willing to visit client sites in Hinjewadi Phase 2 on a fortnightly basis.
* Certifications: PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent Project Management certification.
* Soft Skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi; proven capability to navigate complex corporate structures and manage stakeholders up to the C\-suite level.



  





**Preferred (Good to Have)** 



* Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, GCP BigQuery, Databricks, Snowflake, or AWS.
* Experience working in a product startup or scale\-up environment, demonstrating adaptability in fast\-paced setups.
* Understanding of BFSI data domains (e.g., reconciliation, settlement, regulatory reporting) or Telecom data domains.
* Cloud certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect, AWS Certified Data Analytics, or GCP Professional Data Engineer.
* Track record of building delivery playbooks, SOPs, and scaling delivery processes from scratch.

****Lyzr, in a minute****
**Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day\-to\-day use. Today, 500\+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.**
**Our Presales team is where enterprise leaders decide that AI agents are worth serious investment. This role shapes that decision.**
****The role****
**Lyzr’s largest enterprise deals are won on business cases, not feature lists. As Solution Architect \- Pre\-sales , you will partner with our sales and solution teams on major enterprise opportunities — building the value case, quantifying business impact, and working directly with CFOs, COOs, and other business leaders to shape how AI agents fit their strategy. You will carry real influence over enterprise strategy, go\-to\-market, and how customers structure delivery and cost around AI.**
* Team: Presales
* Level: Senior
* Work mode: Hybrid


****What will make you win this role****
**These are the core requirements — the substance of the job.**
* 8\+ years of strong business solutioning background. You turn a customer’s business problem into a structured, quantified solution narrative.
* Executive\-level communication. You have worked with and reported to CTOs/ CIOs and business leaders and you are credible in that room.
* Value engineering and business transformation. Value generation, business consulting, and transformation work are your core toolkit, not adjacent skills.
* Strategy and go\-to\-market shaping. You have contributed to enterprise strategy, investor communications, and go\-to\-market decisions.
* Delivery and cost optimisation. You have optimised cross\-functional delivery and cost structures, and can bring that lens to customer conversations.


****Life at Lyzr****
* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company\-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools — you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem\-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators — the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes — and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.


**Lead technical discovery with enterprise buyers and partner teams, mapping use cases to Lyzr Solutions
   

  

 Design reference architectures for customer VPC, multi\-cloud and air\-gapped on\-prem deployments, including integration with existing data, identity and security stacks.**
**Build and deliver tailored demos and scoped POCs that prove value within a fixed timeline.**
**Own the technical response on RFPs, security questionnaires and architecture reviews**
**Enable GSI and consulting partner architects through workshops, solution blueprints and joint deal support.**

We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
   

  

 Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
   

  

**Job Description**
 F5 gives the world’s largest businesses, service providers, governments, and consumer brands the ability to securely deliver every app, anywhere—with confidence. We do this by working collaboratively in an innovative environment, helping each other succeed. We take great pride in being trusted advisers to our customers, offering the best solutions for their interests. If our mission and culture excite you, we would love to talk to you!
   

  

**The SE Job Overview:**
 The Solutions Engineer (SE) is a sales and technical role with focus on customer/partners and is part of the sales organization. The SE’s primary responsibility is to support the sales team with technical skills and provide technical knowledge around F5 solutions to our customers. To be effective, an SE needs to have excellent technical skills and knowledge on both F5 products and the “eco\-system” that we work in. Fear not, we do provide training and certification to keep abreast with these critical skills!
   

  

 The high\-level objective is to achieve the allocated sales target and selling relevant F5 solutions and products to our customers business needs, in partnership with the Sales Account Manager. From our customer(s) perspective, the SE is a trusted adviser who proactively learns and understands their technical and business challenges and is able to propose effective solutions to mitigate their concerns/offer gainful solutions. The F5 SE not only presents the technical features but also business benefits in the Technical Value Proposition.
   

  

 Sounds interesting? Read on!
   

  

**What you’ll do:**
* Articulate the F5 product strategy, messaging and positioning F5’s value proposition and solutions for customer business objectives
* Provide technical expertise through sales presentations, solution designs, solution demonstrations, proof of concepts by various mediums – in\-person/virtual presentations, white boards etc
* Determine viability of opportunity and map out organizational structure.
* Drive the sales process in partnership with the Account Manager, by identifying the Technical Decision Maker, getting their technical validation, support, and sponsorship.
* Consistently provide world\-class customer service through the customer life cycle
* Work collaboratively with internal technical and sales resources, share best practices, updates, offer and seek expertise as the need arises in various opportunities.


**How you’ll do it:**
* Experience in secure Cloud architectures, Security product like WAF, ZTNA, Firewall, SSL VPN
* Experience with public/private cloud vendors and automation toolsets, basic CI/CD understanding.
* Experience with SaaS vendor and able to articulate SaaS benefits
* Experience with container orchestration solutions (eg: OpenShift, Kubernetes)
* Proficient in one or more programming languages will be added advantage, good understanding of routing, switching, virtualization


**What you’ll bring:**
* 10\+ years of related industry experience with FSI \& Enterprise background
* 6\+ years of experience in a similar customer facing technical role
* Familiarity/experience with F5 or similar industry solution deployment a plus
* Relevant certifications a plus

de66ca31.title: Technical Program Manager
de66ca31.description:
**Who are we?**  

Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80\+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing American companies since 2008\.  

In this role, you will own and drive strategic technical programs assigned by the Engineering organization. Program assignments will shift over time based on where the business requires delivery leadership — you may lead a single large, multi\-quarter initiative or a portfolio of smaller related efforts. In all cases, the programs you own will be funded, executive\-sponsored initiatives that advance our technology strategy, architectural direction, and/or company strategic plan. You will be expected to ramp quickly on new domains, establish the operating cadence and reporting for the programs you inherit, and transition mature programs into a sustainable business\-as\-usual state.
### **How will you contribute?**


**How will you contribute?**


* Understands the system architecture within program domain. Knows how to make sure dependencies are not broken by development changes and that program systems are not broken by upstream changes.
* Able to consider the larger picture (e.g., efficiency, availability, operability, scalability, business goals, customer experience, etc.) and balance it against the needs of engineering teams who have to build, maintain and extend features for the life of the technology. Incorporates these requirements into project plans.
* See's patterns and discovers solutions; makes connections to improve project/process efficiency. Knows what solutions exist elsewhere and how they can be connected.
* Can convey detailed technical knowledge (verbally, in writing, and via diagram) to engineering team(s) (Q. Why did we build X? What business goal does it solve?).
* Knows how to assess engineering practices for testing, triage and maintenance and work with manager(s) to establish the right methods for effective project delivery.
* Multi\-disciplinary organizational skills with strong people and conflict management abilities.
* Analytical, design, problem solving skills towards customer success.
* Communication and collaboration skills.
### **What will you bring?**


* As part of your project and program ownership, you know the larger business picture (i.e., customer experience, organization goals, opportunities, and/or problems) and you deeply understand the technical requirements of the solutions being built (i.e., architecture, dependency impacts, efficiency, performance, availability, operability, etc.).
* You also take the time to understand the needs of engineers (who have to build, maintain, and extend features for the life of the system) to make appropriate trade\-offs.
* You remove blockers and impediments that impact the team. Organize the team to provide productive, consistent and steady output.
* You partner effectively with technical managers to secure resources, scope engineering efforts, set project priorities, milestones, and drive delivery.
* You provide status reporting to senior leadership and C\-staff on your program.
* You help teams determine where to iterate to make improvements.
* You determine if success metrics are in place, and if not work to define them.
* Bachelors/Masters or equivalent.
**About our culture**  

Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

d643748f.description:
**Job ID** R.0061348 **Primary location** Bengaluru, Karnataka **Date posted** 09/24/2026 **Worker type** Regular **Workplace flexibility** Remote \- Nationwide Save


Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well\-being, and work\-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.


Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.


An Architect within the technology organization will provide thought leadership and direction in aligning projects and solutions to a technology vision they will help evolve. This role works closely with business partners and technology leadership in the assessment of business initiatives and their impact on current technology, modernization efforts and change management. The role will entail developing technology strategies, reference architectures, solutions, best practices and guidance across the entire IT development organization; with particular focus on total cost of ownership, stability, scale and performance.


In this rapid paced environment, the person must possess a "can\-do" attitude while demonstrating a strong work ethic. This person should have a strong aptitude to help drive decisions. He or she will be actively involved in influencing the strategic direction of technology at Empower and Great West Financial. There will be collaboration across teams including IT Infrastructure, PMO office, Business, and third\-party integrators in reviewing, evaluating, designing and implementing solutions.


The Architect must understand the available technology options and educate and influence technology teams to leverage them where appropriate. The Architect will recognize and propose alternatives, make recommendations, and describe any necessary trade\-offs. In most cases, the Architect will lead the design and implementation of end\-to\-end solutions directly with the development teams.


The ideal candidate will leverage their technical aptitude and direction\-setting skills with the development organization to prove out technical concepts quickly using a variety of tools, methods, \& frameworks.


DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES / ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:


* Help define and execute on the business aligned data strategy and vision.
* Develop, document, and provide input into the technology roadmap for Empower and Great West Financial.
* Create Reference Architectures that demonstrate an understanding of significant components and the relationships between them.
* Maintain a high level of skill in various application deployment and workload architectures, such as Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS), Platform\-as\-a\-Service (PaaS) and Infrastructure\-as\-a\-Service (IaaS).
* Connect data strategy to integration protocols and technologies, such as REST \& resource\-oriented design, OData and API Gateways.
* Design and modernize complex data architectures into cloud compatible or cloud native data solutions where applicable. Create strategies and designs for migrating data to cloud systems.
* Participate in the evaluation of new technologies, integration options, challenge the status quo, create solid business cases, and influence direction while establishing partnerships with key constituencies.
* Implement best practices, standards \& guidance, then subsequently provide coaching of technology team members.
* Make leadership recommendations regarding strategic architectural considerations related to data design and process.
* Provide strong leadership and direction in development/engineering practices.
* Collaborate with other business and technology teams on architecture and design issues.
* Respond to evolving and changing security conditions. Implement and recommend security guidelines.
* Provide thought\-leadership, advocacy, articulation, assurance and maintenance of the Enterprise Architecture discipline.

EDUCATION:


Technical bachelor s degree (e.g. computer science, IS, engineering, math, etc.) or a non\-technical bachelor s degree (e.g. Business)


OTHER PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:


* 5\+ years of experience in the development and delivery of database systems.
* 3\+ years of experience creating solution architectures and strategies across multiple architecture domains (business, application, data, integration, infrastructure and security).
* Solid experience with three or more of the following technology disciplines: SOA \& Microservices design, Cloud Architectures, Big Data/Advanced Analytics, Data Warehouse systems, Advanced Programming, Modern Integration Methods (API Gateway/Web Services, Messaging \& RESTful architectures), NoSQL, Client\-side Development (e.g. Web and/or Mobile).
* Expertise in addressing architectural cross cutting concerns and their tradeoffs, including topics such as caching, monitoring, operational surround, high availability, security, etc.
* Demonstrates competency applying architecture frameworks and development methods.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling, security patterns and integration methods.
* Experience with DevOps processes and tools.
* Understanding of business process analysis and business process management (BPM).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrates continuous learning of new technologies.
* Self\-motivated individual that thrives in a team environment.
* Financial industry expertise preferred (Investments, Asset Management, etc.).

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications of the job. The employer has the right to revise this job description at any time. You will be evaluated in part based on your performance of the responsibilities and/or tasks listed in this job description. You may be required perform other duties that are not included on this job description. The job description is not a contract for employment, and either you or the employer may terminate employment at any time, for any reason, as per terms and conditions of your employment contract.
We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, religion, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by applicable state or local law.
