e831608e.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
e831608e.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
   

  

 Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
   

  

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Karnataka

**Overview**
**Overview**
**Be a trusted advisor for Generative AI and Modern Work** 
 : Translate customer challenges into high\-value solutions using M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform. Drive ROI\-focused scenarios that accelerate productivity, automation, and decision\-making.
   

  

* Drive Customer Success across Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform: Lead design and implementation of integrated solutions, covering prompt engineering, copilots/agents lifecycle, Power Platform connectors, data access, and environment strategy.
* Scale AI and low\-code solutions through Agentic AI and automation: Apply Copilot Studio and Power Platform capabilities (Power Automate, Power Apps, Dataverse) to help customers build secure, scalable, governed AI agents and workflows.
* Champion adoption, change management, and business value realization: Engage with business leaders, IT, and security teams to enable widespread usage, demonstrate value, and secure long\-term success and renewal.
* Evangelize best practices and reusable IP: Contribute to communities, internal assets, repeatable frameworks, and technical accelerators to drive consistent and scalable customer outcomes.
* Embrace a learn\-it\-all mindset: Maintain deep technical readiness in M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, M365 administration, and modern AI architecture aligned to Customer Success Unit (CSU) priorities and corporate initiatives.


**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**
 Business Impact
   

  

 Operates according to required operational excellence and proven practice standards throughout all sales stages/activities/tools of record (e.g., pipeline updates, time tracking). Collaborates across Microsoft and customer/partner teams through on\-strategy delivery to achieve customer/partner objectives and increase customer/partner satisfaction. Proactively manages business and technical risks, adapts methodology and applies governance principles to identify, communicate, and minimize business and technical risks. Executes work in compliance with industry and Microsoft guidelines and procedures. Continuously prioritizes among competing demands in their work and identifies where impact occurs with customers, ensuring alignment with business priorities and goals.
   

  

 Delivers solutions in line with company methodologies (e.g., product offerings such as value\-based deliverables \[VBDs], advice, training, technical validation), ensuring proven practices and patterns are followed to prepare customers for operational readiness and achievement of their business goals and targets. Leveraging knowledge of change management proven practices and/or involving the change management team, proactively helps the customer deploy for long\-term organizational adoption to increase customer satisfaction and drive consumption/usage. Guides customers/partners towards a well\-architected (e.g., secure, resilient, artificial intelligence \[AI]\-enabled), and cost\- and performance\-optimized solution to increase retention and expansion opportunities. Provides feedback to Unified Delivery Team on VBDs to refine and further develop content.
   

  

 Proactively identifies new opportunities for Consumption, Usage \& Unified expansion (especially Enhanced Solutions) at scale based on business value to customer/partner and clear understanding of the Microsoft value proposition for supported platforms to empower cloud success, foster and strengthen security and resiliency, and drive AI innovation. Actively listens to and respectfully challenges customers/partners, building trust to then advocate for alternative architectures/solutions/approaches that shape and/or enhance customer requirements. Identifies, and evaluates industry trends (e.g., customer industry verticals, information technology \[IT] industry), gathers customer/partner insights (e.g., feedback around technical preferences, environments, business needs, competitive landscape), and maps existing architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes. Proactively captures opportunities in appropriate systems, processes, and tools, working collaboratively across the organization to execute on opportunities aligned with Microsoft's Customer Engagement Model.
   

  

 Proactively identifies, escalates, and mitigates blockers using appropriate tools and processes to accelerate solution deployment, value realization and usage/consumption. Applies business, technical, industry, and/or enterprise knowledge to architecture or support projects to meet business and information technology (IT) requirements and resolve identified constraints.
   

  

 Customer Centricity
   

  

 Proactively acts as the voice of the customer/partner, sharing ideas, feedback, insights, success stories and strategic/technical input with Engineering teams, Product Offerings teams and internal communities leveraging relevant insights from feedback tools and systems. Identifies patterns of feedback across customers/partners/territories/industries and leverages them to develop strategic and actionable insights. Presents business cases to program managers to influence product roadmaps, decision making, bug fix prioritization, and own and drive initiatives as appropriate.
   

  

 Identifies and/or translates customer/partner problems into industry solutions aligned with Microsoft product and platform strategy, and explains why and/or how they meet customer/partner outcomes and return on investment (ROI) goals (e.g., via proof of concept, minimally viable product \[MVP], rapid prototype) relative to competitive offerings. Proactively helps the customer/partner adopt and use Microsoft product/platform strategy\-aligned (cross\-solution area) solutions. Builds relationships with technical decision makers (TDMs), and helps build the bridge between TDMs and business decision makers (BDMs). Independently interacts as needed with customers/partners' Chief Information Officer (CIO), Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and other C\-level (CXO) roles to bridge understanding of security, compliance, operational and risk requirements across BDMs, TDMs, CIO and CISO teams, appropriately engaging additional subject matter experts when deeper expertise is required.
   

  

 Drives self and guides other team members to focus on customer/partner experience through efficient delivery and ensuring a seamless and connected customer experience. Defines customer/partner conditions of success by leveraging an understanding of customer goals. Anticipates and addresses customer/partner dissatisfaction and unmet needs, and executes strategies to improve customer experience, value realization, and acceleration of transformation.
   

  

 Partner Specialization
   

  

 Identifies and prioritizes several opportunities that align with revenue goals, and orchestrates growth of solution utilization pipeline with partners. Provides assistance with partner and sales teams to bring clarity to specific opportunities through proof of concept and technical pre\-sales support.
   

  

 Understands solution area\-specific market opportunities (e.g., competitor insights) and collaborates with Global Partner Solutions (GPS) business stakeholders to lead and execute initiatives to translate opportunities into actions. Proactively guides and supports partners in developing repeatable offerings, practices, products, and solutions. Advises the partner throughout initial strategic customer implementations.
   

  

 Technical Leadership
   

  

 Leverages market insights and demand signals to assist leadership in identifying relevant areas in which to drive up\-skilling and/or accreditations based on demand. Role models technical readiness, both depth\-aligned to solution area priorities and breadth\-aligned to Customer Success Unit (CSU)/corporate initiatives (e.g., security, resilience, AI), and influences team to drive their own technical readiness. Acts as a mentor, leading readiness and upskilling activities in the team/organization by educating colleagues on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing proven practices.
   

  

 Proactively identifies gaps through delivery, communicates those gaps to relevant team members and internal/external stakeholders, and connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas that drive changes and improvements to products, IP (both existing and new), technologies, and/or processes/practices that enable solutions to scale across customers. Contributes to the development and modification of Microsoft's structured frameworks and methodologies. Provides thought leadership and innovation to customers/partners and internal communities at the local level.
   

  

 Contributes to leading virtual teams (v\-teams) around technologies and customer/partner challenges, and shares ideas, insights, and strategic, technical input with technical teams, internal communities across the field, and the larger virtual team across Microsoft using knowledge of Microsoft architectures and their context in the competitive landscape. Demonstrates strong industry knowledge and increases recognition for Microsoft solutions by contributing to and sometimes leading presentations and engagements with external and internal audiences (e.g., Tech Connect, Build, Ignite) Contributes to intellectual property (IP) and identifies patterns where no IP exists (e.g., CoPilot and AI scenarios) to help build scalable and repeatable models. Participates in external technical and non\-technical community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, webcasts, blogs, hackathons) that elevate the Microsoft brand and shares learnings across internal teams.

 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Liberal Arts, or related field AND 4\+ years experience in cloud/infrastructure technologies, information technology (IT) consulting/support, systems administration, network operations, software development/support, technology solutions, practice development, architecture, and/or consulting OR equivalent experience.

c39993cb.title: Transformation Program Manager
c39993cb.description:
At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting\-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose.


**Your Role**
-------------


The role owns the end\-to\-end shaping, mobilisation and delivery of enterprise transformation – process reengineering, operating model change, digital and data platforms, and the change management that makes the new way of working stick – with accountability for measurable business value, not go\-live sign\-off.


*In this role you will play a key role in:*


* **Stakeholder leadership and CXO communication**: operate as the single point of confidence for the CEO/CXO group. Brief leadership with clarity, candour and a clear ask; report honestly including bad news; and hold alignment across function heads, plant and market leadership, finance, procurement, HR and partner executives who do not report to you. Surface resistance early and distinguish genuine business objection from turf protection.
* **Program shaping and value ownership –** convert leadership intent into a sequenced roadmap, funding envelope and defensible business case; stay accountable for benefit realisation well beyond deployment
* **Multi\-vendor ecosystem leadership –** run consortia of consultants, system integrators, OEMs and specialist partners under different commercial constructs. Own RFP to award, SOW/NFA, SLA and penalty frameworks, milestone\-linked invoicing and change control. Eliminate seams between vendors, hold each to outcomes rather than effort, and act decisively – including descoping or exiting a non\-performer mid\-program
* **A****doption, not just deployment –** define adoption metrics up front and be judged on them: usage, process compliance, data quality, cycle time and cost outcomes after go\-live. Own the change architecture – communication, leadership cascades, champion networks, training, hypercare and sustainment \& **Governance and financial control –** run a disciplined review rhythm with owner\-and\-date closure; control budgets, phased fund release, commitment\-versus\-spend and forecast\-at\-completion; enforce a single source of truth and auditable decision trails
**Your Profile**
----------------


* 14–20 years overall, with at least two enterprise transformation programs personally led end to end – typically ₹100 crore\+ in value, 18–36 months, enterprise\-wide impact \& Five or more delivery partners running concurrently, with ownership of the commercial and performance relationship.
* Sustained exposure to CXO and board forums – not through a sponsor, but as the person in the room answering the questions \& Delivery across multiple cultures – multi\-country, post\-merger integration, or a genuinely diverse multi\-state Indian footprint spanning corporate, plant and field
* Scope extending well beyond IT – process, organisation, commercial and behavioural change explicitly owned \& Accountability for a business number – cost, working capital, cycle time, service level or revenue – with evidence of delivered versus promised
* A program taken through serious trouble – a failing vendor, slipped go\-live, funding freeze or organised pushback – with a candid account of the recovery
**What you will love about working here**
-----------------------------------------


* We recognize the significance of flexible work arrangements to provide support. Be it remote work, or flexible work hours, you will get an environment to maintain healthy work life balance.
* At the heart of our mission is your career growth. Our array of career growth programs and diverse professions are crafted to support you in exploring a world of opportunities.
* Equip yourself with valuable certifications in the latest technologies such as Generative AI.
Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end\-to\-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

175734ef.title: Solutions Architect, ISV
175734ef.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Sales (AGS) drives adoption of the AWS Cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud.
   

  

 Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer\-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud.
   

  

 AWS is where innovation, risks, and ideas are celebrated. We are builders; we try new things, imagine big dreams and reuse whenever we can. It is still Day 1 for us, and we are looking for curious people to be part of our diverse teams of thinkers, problem solvers, and doers. Come join us and work with AWS technologies that enable our Independent Software Vendor (ISV) customers and partners to adopt cloud\-based solutions.
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 This role is within the ISV team in Amazon Web Services India (AWS India) and can be based out of Bangalore, Delhi, Mumbai, Pune and Hyderabad locations.
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you’ll help your customers plan their successful cloud journey leveraging emerging technologies like GenAI to achieve business outcomes. You’ll solve complex, technical challenges so your customers can focus on their business. This includes using your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures. You’ll drive or take part in technical solutions discussions, diving deep into the details with customer teams.
   

  

 Building relationships to understand our customers and partners is key. As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll use your interpersonal skills to influence a variety of stakeholders from technical teams to executives. You’ll help ensure their short\-term technology decisions are aligned with their long\-term goals. Speeding up the adoption of our services will be part of your day to day.
   

  

 You’ll also act as thought leader in the wider community. This includes taking part in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops. You won’t just be part of an industry movement; you’ll be leading it.
   

  

 As a customer obsessed advisor, you’ll also have the chance to shape the direction of our products and services. This is through gathering feedback from customers whilst collaborating with our engineering and service teams.
   

  

 To be successful in this role you need to be passionate about ISV and cloud architectures. You are a builder with genuine curiosity about how technology can support your customers’ business models and objectives.
   

  

 Want to find out what it’s like to be a Solution Architect at AWS? Watch this video (https://bit.ly/3keYcC9\).
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 The Solutions Architect team at AWS is responsible for helping customers successfully implement cloud technologies. In a typical week you will meet multiple customers, and you will collaborate with them on designing and operating well\-architected solutions. You will earn their trust and show them the art of the possible, educating them around the capabilities of AWS. Partnering with internal teams and experts, leveraging a deep knowledge of our tools and products, you’ll craft highly scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures that address our customers’ business problems. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to continuously learn and innovate daily.
   

  

**About The Team**
 ISV Solutions Architects work hand in hand with AWS customers to help drive AWS services adoption. They are at the crossroads of business and technology and engage with customers of different stages. Supporting the overall technical relationship between customers and AWS, they work to understand the customer's business needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with technology. Solutions Architects also have broader impact at scale, taking a supporting role in creating and presenting technical content and best practices.
   

  

 You will be part of a team that is responsible for driving adoption of AWS technologies while bringing differentiated value to customers. This is a team dedicated to ISV customers, an important and growing subset of customers for AWS India. ISV customers follow unique technology adoption patterns and growth trajectories that distinguish them from traditional businesses, so you will be employing engagement strategies and programs tailored to their business needs and technical preferences.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
* Experience in a similar role such as technical account manager, consultant, solutions architect, platform engineer, systems engineer, cloud architect, or service delivery manager
* Experience in specific technology domain areas like software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data and analytics
* 4\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems, or experience in computer architecture


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of AWS services
* Experience architecting, migrating, transforming or modernizing customer requirements to the cloud
* Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification
* Experience conveying complex technical concepts to both technical and business audiences
* 4\+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or degree in advanced technology


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Karnataka
   

  

 Job ID: A10477252

5e417996.title: Application DevOps & Modernisation Architect - VOIS
5e417996.description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Application DevOps \& Modernisation Architect to lead large\-scale application discovery, assessment, migration and modernisation initiatives. You will collaborate with business owners, application owners and technical specialists to understand objectives, functional and non\-functional requirements, dependencies and constraints.
   

  

 You will define practical modernisation strategies, evaluate solution options and translate application needs into secure, scalable and resilient platform designs. The role requires extensive expertise across application architecture, DevOps, cloud platforms, containerisation, infrastructure as code and continuous delivery.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Lead application discovery and assessment across architecture, integrations, dependencies, databases, infrastructure and operational requirements
* Facilitate discovery workshops, architecture reviews and technical discussions with business and technical stakeholders
* Capture business objectives, functional requirements, non\-functional requirements, constraints and expected outcomes
* Define application migration and modernisation strategies using approaches such as Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retain, Retire and Repurchase
* Research and evaluate solution options, recommending effective development and implementation patterns with an open\-source\-first approach where appropriate
* Produce high\-level designs, low\-level designs, architecture diagrams, deployment models, dependency maps and technical recommendations
* Translate application requirements into platform requirements covering compute sizing, storage, connectivity, load balancing, DNS, databases, security, high availability, disaster recovery and observability
* Collaborate with platform, network, database, security and cloud architects to ensure infrastructure designs meet application requirements
* Support solution implementation, migration, technical troubleshooting and post\-migration stabilisation
* Communicate architecture decisions, risks, trade\-offs and recommended next steps clearly to business and technical audiences
* Work independently across multiple technical workstreams while maintaining effective stakeholder collaboration


**Who You Are**
 Essential experience and capabilities
   

  

* At least eight years of relevant experience across application architecture, DevOps, cloud, migration and modernisation
* Strong experience in large\-scale application discovery and assessment
* Demonstrated ability to take ambiguous requirements through discovery, option evaluation and recommendation
* Strong knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, CI/CD, Git and GitOps

a804f478.description:
About Trantor
 



  





 Trantor is a global technology services and engineering company specializing in delivering high\-impact Professional Services, Customer Success, and Engineering solutions for leading enterprise software companies. Our consultants partner with some of the world's most innovative technology organizations to help customers successfully deploy, adopt, and maximize the value of their platforms.
 



  





 We are looking for a highly skilled Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to join our team. This is a customer\-facing consulting role where you will deploy and optimize enterprise database environments, implement AI\-powered solutions, and act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer lifecycle.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, configure, and optimize managed and self\-managed database clusters across cloud and on\-premises environments.
 



  





 You will also lead the implementation of AI\-powered conversational analytics solutions that transform plain\-English questions into precise SQL queries.
 



  





 This role combines technical implementation, architecture consulting, customer engagement, and AI adoption. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable leading executive discussions, conducting technical workshops, and performing hands\-on deployments.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Customer Deployment \& Implementation
 



 Deploy, configure, and optimize enterprise database environments for customers.
 



 Install, configure, and support self\-managed database clusters across cloud and on\-premises infrastructure.
 



 Perform cluster sizing, architecture design, upgrades, migrations, and production readiness assessments.
 



 Configure high availability, disaster recovery, backup, security, and performance optimization.
 



 Troubleshoot complex infrastructure, database, and deployment issues.
 



 AI Solution Implementation
 



 Deploy and configure AI\-powered analytics solutions for enterprise customers.
 



 Integrate AI solutions with customer datasets and enterprise workflows.
 



 Enable customers to leverage natural language queries and AI\-powered analytics.
 



 Validate AI outputs, optimize prompts, and support customer adoption.
 



 Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams by providing implementation feedback and product improvement recommendations.
 



 Technical Consulting
 



 Serve as the primary technical advisor during customer implementations.
 



 Lead discovery sessions, technical workshops, and architecture reviews.
 



 Translate business objectives into scalable technical solutions.
 



 Recommend best practices for deployment, performance, scalability, and security.
 



 Produce high\-quality technical documentation and implementation guides.
 



 AI \& Automation
 



 Leverage AI tools to accelerate deployments, troubleshooting, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
 



 Develop automation scripts to simplify repetitive deployment and operational tasks.
 



 Utilize modern AI coding assistants and productivity tools to improve engineering efficiency.
 



 Stay current with advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, and enterprise AI technologies.
 



 Customer Success
 



 Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, architects, and engineering teams.
 



 Drive successful implementations while ensuring an exceptional customer experience.
 



 Mentor customer teams through knowledge transfer sessions and operational best practices.
 



 Collaborate with Customer Success and Support teams to ensure seamless project handoffs.
 



  





**Required Qualifications** 




 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
 



 8\+ years of experience in Professional Services, Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, or Technical Consulting.
 



 Experience deploying enterprise software solutions in customer environments.
 



 Experience with distributed SQL or relational databases such as PostgreSQL, CockroachDB, YugabyteDB, MySQL, or similar technologies.
 



 Database administration and performance tuning experience.
 



 Data ingestion and ETL pipelines.
 



 Monitoring platforms such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Datadog.
 



 Infrastructure as Code using Terraform or Ansible.
 



 CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
 



 Strong Linux system administration skills.
 



 Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
 



 Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes and containerized applications.
 



 Strong networking fundamentals, including DNS, TLS/SSL, firewalls, and load balancing.
 



 Experience with Python, Bash, or other scripting languages.
 



 Familiarity with REST APIs and enterprise integrations.
 



 Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills.

9288a56f.title: Project Manager / Delivery Lead
9288a56f.description:
**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an experienced Delivery Lead / Senior Project Manager to lead and manage the delivery operations across our Product and Software Engineering divisions. The role will be responsible for end\-to\-end delivery ownership, project planning and governance, customer engagement, resource management, quality, timelines, budgets, and successful execution of multiple projects. The candidate will work closely with Engineering, Product, QA, Architecture, Business Development, HR, and senior leadership teams to ensure predictable and high\-quality project delivery. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in managing software/product engineering projects, leading cross\-functional technical teams, handling multiple customers/projects, and driving delivery excellence.


**What You Will Do**
--------------------


* 1\. Delivery \& Project Management
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of multiple Product and Software Engineering projects.
* Define project objectives, scope, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
* Ensure projects are delivered within agreed scope, schedule, quality, and budget.
* Establish project governance, review mechanisms, dashboards, and reporting structures.
* Track project progress, identify risks and dependencies, and drive timely corrective actions.
* Manage project priorities and ensure effective allocation of technical resources.
* Drive Agile/Scrum or appropriate project delivery methodologies based on project requirements.
* Ensure effective sprint planning, backlog management, reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
* Monitor project KPIs, delivery metrics, productivity, utilization, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* 2\. Product \& Software Engineering Leadership
* Work closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Architects, Tech Leads, Developers, QA, DevOps, and other stakeholders.
* Provide delivery leadership across software/product development lifecycle.
* Ensure alignment between product requirements, technical architecture, development, testing, deployment, and support.
* Facilitate resolution of technical and operational blockers affecting project delivery.
* Ensure engineering teams follow defined development, testing, documentation, security, and quality standards.
* Drive continuous improvement in development and delivery processes.
* Support adoption of automation, DevOps, CI/CD, Agile practices, and engineering best practices.
* 3\. Customer \& Stakeholder Management
* Act as a senior point of contact for key customers and strategic accounts.
* Understand customer requirements, expectations, priorities, and business objectives.
* Conduct regular project reviews and communicate delivery status, risks, issues, and mitigation plans.
* Manage customer escalations and ensure timely resolution.
* Build strong and long\-term relationships with customers and stakeholders.
* Participate in customer meetings, requirement discussions, project kick\-offs, reviews, and steering committee meetings.
* Identify opportunities for expanding existing engagements in coordination with Business Development/Account Management teams.
* 4\. Resource \& People Management
* Plan and forecast manpower requirements based on project pipeline and business priorities.
* Ensure optimum utilization of engineering resources across Product and Software divisions.
* Work closely with HR and recruitment teams for hiring and onboarding requirements.
* Identify skill gaps and recommend appropriate training and development initiatives.
* Mentor Project Managers, Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and other delivery team members.
* Drive performance management and ensure clear ownership and accountability within teams.
* Develop a strong delivery leadership pipeline and succession plan.
* 5\. Project Financial \& Commercial Management
* Monitor project budgets, costs, resource utilization, and profitability.
* Work with Finance and Business teams on project billing, invoicing, milestones, and commercial commitments.
* Track project profitability and identify cost optimization opportunities.
* Support preparation of project estimates, resource plans, proposals, Statements of Work (SOWs), and commercial inputs.
* Ensure delivery commitments are aligned with contractual and commercial requirements.
* 6\. Risk, Quality \& Compliance
* Establish proactive project risk and issue management processes.
* Maintain project risk registers and ensure mitigation plans are implemented.
* Identify delivery risks related to resources, technology, dependencies, scope, timelines, and customer commitments.
* Ensure compliance with organizational processes, information security requirements, and quality standards.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and corrective/preventive actions for major delivery issues.
* Ensure appropriate project documentation and audit readiness.
* 7\. Business \& Strategic Contribution
* Work with senior leadership to develop and execute delivery strategies for Product and Software Engineering.
* Contribute to annual and quarterly business planning.
* Support technology and capability development initiatives.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, automation, scalability, and margins.
* Participate in pre\-sales activities, solution discussions, estimations, technical presentations, and customer proposals when required.
* Support new business opportunities by providing delivery feasibility, effort estimates, resource plans, and execution strategies.
* Build delivery capabilities aligned with the organization's future product and technology roadmap.
* Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
* On\-time project delivery
* Project profitability and budget adherence
* Customer satisfaction and retention
* Resource utilization
* Project quality and defect levels
* Delivery productivity
* Schedule and milestone adherence
* Project risk and issue closure
* Employee retention and team engagement
* Successful project ramp\-up/ramp\-down
* Revenue and margin contribution
* Process improvement and automation initiatives
**What We’re Looking For**
--------------------------


* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* MBA/PGDM or relevant project/program management qualification will be an advantage.
* 5–10\+ years of relevant experience in software/product engineering and project/program delivery.
* Strong experience managing multiple projects and cross\-functional engineering teams.
* Proven experience in customer\-facing delivery management roles.
* Strong understanding of software/product development lifecycle.
* Experience with Agile/Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, estimation, resource management, risk management, and delivery governance.
* Preferred Technical/Domain Exposure
* Experience in one or more of the following areas would be preferred:
* Product Engineering
* Embedded Software / Firmware
* IoT
* Cloud Applications
* Web \& Mobile Applications
* Enterprise Software
* API / Microservices
* DevOps \& CI/CD
* QA \& Test Automation
* System Integration
* Hardware–Software integrated products
* Desired Skills
* Strong leadership and people\-management skills
* Excellent customer and stakeholder management
* Strong project planning and execution capabilities
* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving ability
* Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Strong negotiation and conflict\-resolution skills
* Business and commercial acumen
* Ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced engineering environment
* Strong decision\-making and ownership mindset
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams without direct authority
* Tools \& Methodologies
* Exposure to tools such as:
* Jira / Azure DevOps
* Confluence
* MS Project / Smartsheet
* Microsoft Teams
* Power BI / project dashboards
* Git / GitHub / GitLab
* CI/CD tools
* Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies is preferred.
* Ideal Candidate Profile
* The ideal candidate is a delivery\-focused technology leader who can operate at both strategic and execution levels. The person should be capable of managing customer expectations and business priorities while ensuring engineering teams have the right direction, resources, and support to deliver successfully.
* The candidate should be comfortable managing multiple projects, large cross\-functional teams, senior customers, project financials, escalations, and delivery governance, while continuously improving engineering and delivery processes.
* Key expectation: The role should not be limited to traditional project tracking. The incumbent will be expected to take overall ownership of Product and Software delivery, drive accountability across teams, and contribute to customer growth, operational efficiency, and business profitability.

3dc25409.title: Technical Program Manager, Google Search Platforms
3dc25409.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience leading technical program management initiatives and delivering infrastructure solutions.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of dedicated experience in a technical program manager role.
* Deep domain expertise in backend infrastructure, distributed systems, evaluation systems, or testing frameworks.
* Experience or strong interest in leveraging modern AI/ML capabilities, Large Language Models (LLMs), and agentic workflows to modernize Technical Program Manager (TPM) functions (e.g., automated dependency tracking, predictive risk modeling, and operational streamlining).
* Proven track record of driving cross\-functional alignment, managing distributed teams across multiple time zones, and prioritizing complex workstreams amidst ambiguity.


**About The Job**
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
   

  

 The Search Serving Infrastructure (SSI) team is at the heart of Google Search. Our mission is to provide a reliable, highly efficient, and performant serving framework that powers the Search ecosystem handling billions of queries a day. We address massive\-scale engineering challenges, from reducing latency and CPU/TPU capacity footprints to driving large\-scale architectural simplification efforts (like deprecating legacy monolithic servers in favor of modern, scalable services).
   

  

 In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Scope, shape, and lead large\-scale programs spanning multiple engineering tracks. Co\-develop strategies, goals, and success metrics for the broader organization.
* Perform technical assessments to evaluate engineering scope, establish milestones, define timeframes, and assess resourcing needs. Demonstrate technical judgment equivalent to a practicing Software Engineer in the infrastructure domain.
* Identify, anticipate, and manage risks, deliverables, and interdependencies across different Search Platforms and partner teams. Build mechanisms to optimize governance and information flow.
* Drive continuous optimizations in operational cadence, tooling, and communication, minimizing process friction while fostering development velocity and quality.
* Advocate alignment across disparate teams with differing objectives. Guide and influence cross\-functional peers, driving consensus for technical directions and prioritizing features against constraints.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

We're also committed to providing transformational opportunities for our own employees by investing in their growth. We aspire to create a culture that's built on trust, care, inclusion, and fun – where everyone can succeed.
   

  





 Join us to transform the way the world works.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 At LinkedIn, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, clarity, and the evolving needs of our business. The work location of this role is hybrid, meaning it will be performed both from home and from a LinkedIn office on select days, as determined by the business needs of the team.
   

  





 We're looking for a Staff Technical Program Manager to drive the strategy, planning, and execution of large\-scale, cross\-functional programs across Talent Enterprise Engineering and other org partners. In this role, you'll lead cross\-functional projects, and partner closely with engineering, product, data science, and design to deliver high\-impact initiatives that shape how LinkedIn members and enterprise customers experience career mobility.
   

  





 At the Staff level, you are expected to independently own ambiguous, complex programs, influence technical and product direction, and raise the bar for program management practices across the org.
   

  





 Responsibilities:
   

  




* Lead and drive end\-to\-end delivery of multiple concurrent, high\-complexity AI\-driven engineering programs across Talent Enterprise Engineering and LinkedIn — from scoping and roadmap planning through launch and post\-launch measurement.
* Champion AI\-native program management by using AI/LLM\-based tools — for status synthesis, risk detection, meeting summarization, and roadmap drafting — to run leaner, faster program operations, and model this behavior for other TPMs in the org.
* Partner with engineering on AI system design trade\-offs — model selection, latency/cost/accuracy balance, data pipelines, and evaluation frameworks — and translate those decisions into program risk and timeline impact.
* Own AI\-specific program rigor, including responsible\-AI review checkpoints, model evaluation and testing cycles, and compliance/privacy review gates that fall outside standard software launch checklists.
* Own the delivery of large, highly cross\-functional programs by developing detailed plans with clear milestones and goals, leveraging technical depth to identify and mitigate risks, resolve dependencies, remove impediments, and ensure timely, smooth launches.
* Partner with engineering leads, architects, and product leaders to identify technical dependencies, risks, and critical path, and drive resolution across teams.
* Define and own program operating rhythms: planning cadences, milestone tracking, cross\-team sync structures, and executive reporting.
* Drive bi\-annual roadmap and resource planning, and lead teams through execution of roadmaps, releases, and backlogs.
* Drive alignment across orgs and stakeholders on scope, priorities, timelines, and trade\-offs, and keep everyone informed on status, risks, and mitigation plans.
* Anticipate and proactively mitigate risks; surface gaps, unblock issues, and escalate blockers with clear, actionable recommendations.
* Foster a collaborative environment built on transparency, shared understanding, autonomy, innovation, and continuous learning.
* Coach and mentor others in modern technical program planning and execution best practices.
* Bring business\-strategy understanding and strong product intuition to program decisions.


**Qualifications**

 Basic Qualifications:
   

  




* 6\+ years of full time technical program management experience within an engineering or technical team
* B.S degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience
* 4\+ years of hands\-on software engineering development experience



 Preferred Qualifications:
   

  




* 8\+ years of full time technical program management experience
* Demonstrated success managing multiple major and concurrent projects/programs
* Demonstrated success driving the development program of world\-class online products
* Significant experience working with software engineering leadership, technical teams, individual contributors and external clients
* Knowledge of complex technical ecosystems and adequate technical depth
* Ability to build collaborations and create a community of leadership
* Be a thought leader; someone who can help advance strategy and challenge others in the organization to make important improvements
* Demonstrated conflict resolution skills combined with strong negotiation ability delivered with a high level of influence and professionalism
* Agile coaching and practitioner experience (Scrum, Kanban) with multiple teams.
* Experience in managing all phases of end\-to\-end product development
* Knowledge of Internet client/server social networking applications and systems
* Hands\-on software development experience
* Experience working on ATS integrations



 Suggested Skills:
   

  




* Program Management
* Agile Project Management
* Cross\-functional team leadership
* Risk Management


**Additional Information**

0ad5bab0.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Multichannel Commerce and Fulfillment, Amazon Supply Chain Services
0ad5bab0.description:
**Description**
 Amazon has spent years building one of the world’s most efficient and optimized supply chains. The Supply Chain Services Team, part of Santos org, will build on that foundation and continue to innovate end\-to\-end supply chain capabilities for merchants to conduct their off\-Amazon business.
   

  

 Our vision is to enable every entrepreneur in the world to reach every customer in the world through every channel they can imagine. The Supply Chain Services team is in exciting next step in our mission/vision to help merchants of all sizes grow their business beyond Amazon by using Amazon’s optimized and efficient supply chain network and services.
   

  

 As we rapidly scale to serve our off\-Amazon customers, we need a Senior Technical Program Manager (Sr.TPM) who can work across our organization and stakeholders, with both strategic and tactical vision. We are building products that are fundamental to Amazon’s future, and we are tackling some of the world’s most intriguing problems involving software architecture design, customer experience, and business strategy.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will be responsible for identifying, scoping, and delivering end to end deliverables. You will apply both business and technical acumen in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and innovative environment. You thrive through building consensus and driving teams towards results. You will anticipate bottlenecks, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs, and balance the business needs versus technical constraints. An ability to take large, complex projects and break them down into manageable pieces to deliver them in a successful and timely manner, maturity, high judgment, negotiation skills, ability to influence, analytical talent and leadership are essential to success in this role.
   

  

 You will join a highly technical and entrepreneurial culture defining and building the next generation of a fulfillment solution for 3rd party merchants and brand owners.
   

  

**Key Job Responsibilities**
* Develop and execute project plans with an impact across teams.
* Demonstrate the ability to provide both structured and creative thinking in a dynamic, evolving, multi team\-based environment
* Demonstrate the ability to communicate effectively at multiple levels of management, building trust across the organization, and demonstrating discretion with sensitive information
* Show ownership and leadership skills in coordinating projects across multiple teams, driving them to successful conclusion while building strong, lasting relationships with both internal and external customers
* Be comfortable working in a fast\-paced, ever\-changing environment while driving teams to complete goals
* Demonstrate the ability to break abstract goals into attainable, measurable work items
* Manage a cross\-functional process to translate the desired customer experience into a logically sequenced and optimized product roadmap and product releases


**Basic Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3\+ years of software development experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi\-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. a1577d4e.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
a1577d4e.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**What You’ll Do**
* Own end\-to\-end execution of CCaaS\-wide programs: scoping, milestone planning, dependency and risk tracking, and crisp status reporting to senior leadership
* Drive cross\-team initiatives spanning product modules, platform and cloud engineering, security, and SRE, including alignment where teams have competing priorities on shared production infrastructure
* Run operational cadences: weekly reviews, incident and RCA follow\-through, action item closure, launch and rollout readiness
* Build lightweight utilities, scripts, and AI agents that pull data from source systems (Jira, cloud billing, monitoring, Git) to automate tracking, dashboards, and reporting
* Translate engineering detail into executive\-ready narratives: dollar impact, risk, and timelines
* Maintain a single source of truth for program state so progress and blockers are visible without anyone having to ask.


**What Makes You Qualified?**
* 3\+ years in technical program management, or a mix of engineering and program roles, in cloud infrastructure, platform, or SaaS product environments
* Working knowledge of cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) fundamentals: compute and instance families, autoscaling, storage tiers, and cost levers; able to follow an infra design review or RCA discussion and ask the right questions
* Scripting ability (Python or similar) and comfort with APIs; you have built your own tools to collect data or automate reporting, not just configured off\-the\-shelf dashboards
* Strong stakeholder management: a track record of driving outcomes across teams you don't control, including navigating disagreement and escalating with judgment
* Structured tracking discipline: dependencies, risks, decisions, and action items don't fall through the cracks on your programs
* Clear written communication that works for both engineers and executives
* Hands\-on exposure to large\-scale distributed systems or real\-time data infrastructure
* Experience running FinOps or cloud cost\-optimization programs
* Experience applying LLM tooling or agents to workflow automation
* Background in contact center, CPaaS, or other real\-time communication platforms


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

c9d9a75d.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Data
c9d9a75d.description:
**Aliases** 
**:** 
 Project Manager, Program Manager, Product Manager, Data Operations Lead, Data Delivery Lead, Technical Delivery Lead, or Data Governance Lead.
   

  

**About Truveta**
 Truveta is the world's first health provider\-led data platform with a vision of Saving Lives with Data. Our mission is to enable researchers to find cures faster, empower every clinician to be an expert, and help families make the most informed decisions about their care. Achieving Truveta's ambitious vision requires an incredible team of talented and inspired people with a unique combination of health, software, and big data expertise who share our company values.
   

  

**This opportunity**
 Join the founding team of the Truveta India Development Center and play a pivotal role in shaping its future. As one of the early employees, you will help build and scale a high\-impact organization while contributing to the products and platforms that advance healthcare through data and AI. This is an unusual chance to influence both the technical direction and the culture of a growing global engineering hub.
   

  

 You will be the program owner for the Data Platform work carried out in India. That means the data\-source onboarding, the processing and quality programs, the governance and access work, and the release and adoption of what the team builds. It is a single, senior, hands\-off\-the\-keyboard role with real accountability and no direct reports.
   

  

**Who We Need**
 We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead complex, cross\-functional programs across data acquisition, data processing, data quality, governance, platform delivery, and data\-product adoption. You will work closely with engineering, data engineering, product, data science, operations, security, compliance, and business stakeholders to convert ambiguous data challenges into clear programs, measurable outcomes, and reliable production capabilities.
   

  

 You will have built systems and we expect you to read an architecture diagram without help, to follow a design review closely enough to ask the question everyone else missed, and to know from experience which risks are worth a week of the team's time and which are not. You will not have formal authority over the teams you depend on, so the job is done through clarity, technical credibility, and follow\-through.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 In this role you will:
   

  

* Own programs from problem definition and planning through delivery, adoption, and post\-launch measurement.
* Build and maintain roadmaps, milestones, dependency maps, risk registers, decision logs, and the delivery mechanisms that keep them useful.
* Partner with engineering and data teams on architecture, technical constraints, sequencing, and delivery risk, at a depth that lets you challenge the plan rather than only record it.
* Coordinate data\-source onboarding, ingestion, transformation, normalization, enrichment, and validation programs.
* Drive resolution of data\-quality issues, operational defects, and recurring pipeline failures, including the root\-cause work that stops them recurring.
* Coordinate data governance, access control, privacy, security, metadata, lineage, and compliance initiatives.
* Identify cross\-team blockers and drive them to resolution without relying on formal authority.
* Facilitate technical reviews and ensure major decisions, trade\-offs, assumptions, and risks are written down where people will find them.
* Coordinate launch readiness, release management, operational support, and post\-launch reviews.
* Prepare clear written updates and recommendations for engineering and business leadership across India and Seattle.
* Improve program management practice, reporting automation, delivery predictability, and operational maturity at the site.


**Required Qualifications**
 The experience requirement is 11\+ years in total, composed of 7\+ years in a hands\-on individual\-contributor technical role and 4\+ years in a technical program or project management role. The two are counted separately and added; a year spent doing both is counted once.
   

  

* At least 11 years of professional experience in total.
* At least 7 years in a hands\-on individual\-contributor in technical roles such as software engineering, quality assurance, data engineering, analytics engineering, systems engineering, or platform engineering.
* At least 4 years in a technical program management or technical project management role, owning delivery across engineering teams.
* Experience delivering programs involving data platforms, data pipelines, data governance, analytics infrastructure, or distributed systems.
* Working knowledge of data ingestion, ETL and ELT, batch and streaming pipelines, APIs, databases, cloud platforms, and data quality.
* Ability to read architecture diagrams and hold a substantive conversation with engineers about designs, trade\-offs, dependencies, and operational risk.
* Experience managing dependencies across multiple teams, driving requirements, delivery plans, risk management, release readiness, and adoption.
* Strong written communication, including executive status reporting and written recommendations that carry out a decision.
* Ability to operate in ambiguity and influencing teams.
* Familiarity with Agile development, release processes, incident management, and production operations.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, mathematics, or equivalent practical experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
 The following skill sets would be good to have:
   

  

* SQL or equivalent data\-querying ability used in practice rather than in principle.
* Hands\-on background with Kafka, Spark, Flink, Airflow, dbt, Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Databricks, AWS Glue, or comparable platforms.
* Experience with data governance, metadata, data lineage, access control, privacy, security, or compliance programs.
* Experience with external data suppliers, healthcare data, financial data, or other regulated datasets.
* Experience operating data platforms against measurable uptime, freshness, accuracy, completeness, latency, and cost targets.
* Experience managing distributed programs across India and the United States.
* Experience standing up program management practice at a new site or in a new platform area.
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Aha, Linear, Asana, Smartsheet, or equivalent tools.

 Principal Program Manager— Level T4

 Engineering / Program Management — EDA Software Development

 We are looking for a seasoned Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex, high\-stakes initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams in the context of
 **Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software development** 
 . You will be the central orchestrator ensuring delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and continuous innovation across the full EDA product lifecycle.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Multi\-team coordination: Drive alignment across cross\-functional teams (engineering, QA, design, operations, business) to ensure seamless execution and on\-time delivery of EDA software projects.
* Customer project ownership: Manage end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-facing EDA projects, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring commitments are met with quality.
* High\-stakes project leadership: Lead critical, high\-visibility programs with significant business or technical impact, managing risks proactively and escalating appropriately.
* Structured planning: Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans using rigorous methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid).
* Innovation facilitation: Champion new approaches and continuously explore emerging tools — including AI\-assisted project management (intelligent scheduling, risk prediction, automated reporting, and AI\-driven decision support) — to improve team efficiency and project outcomes.
* Status reporting: Provide clear, concise, and accurate communication to all stakeholders — from engineers to senior leadership.
* Team collaboration: Foster a strong team spirit, removing blockers and ensuring every contributor feels supported and empowered.


**Required Profile**
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-team programs in a technical or software development environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to adapt messaging for both technical and executive audiences.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and structured in approach.
* Collaborative mindset with genuine team spirit — you succeed when the team succeeds.
* Comfortable operating under pressure and navigating ambiguity on high\-stakes deliverables.
* Experience with project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent).
* Understanding of EDA tools and the semiconductor design flow is a strong plus — familiarity with the domain (simulation, synthesis, place \& route, verification, etc.) enables faster ramp\-up and more credible engagement with engineering teams.
