**What We Value**
 You are not just a process enforcer — you are a builder of bridges between teams, a guardian of commitments to customers, and a driver of a culture where quality and innovation go hand in hand. You embrace AI as a force multiplier to manage smarter, not just harder — and you bring enough EDA domain awareness to speak the language of the engineers you serve.
   

  

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

 Who is Mastercard?
   

  

 Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.
   

  

 Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.

 The Data Collection and Enineering Program is looking for a Senior Techincal Program Manager to drive our core data ETL strategy forward by consistently innovating and problem\-solving.  Role

1eda3c57.title: Technical Program Manager
1eda3c57.description:
**Who are we?**
 Smarsh empowers its customers to manage risk and unleash intelligence in their digital communications. Our growing community of over 6500 organizations in regulated industries counts on Smarsh every day to help them spot compliance, legal or reputational risks in 80\+ communication channels before those risks become regulatory fines or headlines. Relentless innovation has fueled our journey to consistent leadership recognition from analysts like Gartner and Forrester, and our sustained, aggressive growth has landed Smarsh in the annual Inc. 5000 list of fastest\-growing American companies since 2008\.
   

  

 In this role, you will own and drive strategic technical programs assigned by the Engineering organization. Program assignments will shift over time based on where the business requires delivery leadership — you may lead a single large, multi\-quarter initiative or a portfolio of smaller related efforts. In all cases, the programs you own will be funded, executive\-sponsored initiatives that advance our technology strategy, architectural direction, and/or company strategic plan. You will be expected to ramp quickly on new domains, establish the operating cadence and reporting for the programs you inherit, and transition mature programs into a sustainable business\-as\-usual state.
   

  

**How will you contribute?**
**How will you contribute?**
* Understands the system architecture within program domain. Knows how to make sure dependencies are not broken by development changes and that program systems are not broken by upstream changes.
* Able to consider the larger picture (e.g., efficiency, availability, operability, scalability, business goals, customer experience, etc.) and balance it against the needs of engineering teams who have to build, maintain and extend features for the life of the technology. Incorporates these requirements into project plans.
* See's patterns and discovers solutions; makes connections to improve project/process efficiency. Knows what solutions exist elsewhere and how they can be connected.
* Can convey detailed technical knowledge (verbally, in writing, and via diagram) to engineering team(s) (Q. Why did we build X? What business goal does it solve?).
* Knows how to assess engineering practices for testing, triage and maintenance and work with manager(s) to establish the right methods for effective project delivery.
* Multi\-disciplinary organizational skills with strong people and conflict management abilities.
* Analytical, design, problem solving skills towards customer success.
* Communication and collaboration skills.


**What will you bring?**
* As part of your project and program ownership, you know the larger business picture (i.e., customer experience, organization goals, opportunities, and/or problems) and you deeply understand the technical requirements of the solutions being built (i.e., architecture, dependency impacts, efficiency, performance, availability, operability, etc.).
* You also take the time to understand the needs of engineers (who have to build, maintain, and extend features for the life of the system) to make appropriate trade\-offs.
* You remove blockers and impediments that impact the team. Organize the team to provide productive, consistent and steady output.
* You partner effectively with technical managers to secure resources, scope engineering efforts, set project priorities, milestones, and drive delivery.
* You provide status reporting to senior leadership and C\-staff on your program.
* You help teams determine where to iterate to make improvements.
* You determine if success metrics are in place, and if not work to define them.
* Bachelors/Masters or equivalent.


**About Our Culture**
 Smarsh hires lifelong learners with a passion for innovating with purpose, humility and humor. Collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. We work closely with the most popular communications platforms and the world’s leading cloud infrastructure platforms. We use the latest in AI/ML technology to help our customers break new ground at scale. We are a global organization that values diversity, and we believe that providing opportunities for everyone to be their authentic self is key to our success. Smarsh leadership, culture, and commitment to developing our people have all garnered Comparably.com Best Places to Work Awards. Come join us and find out what the best work of your career looks like.

073407fe.title: Manager - Business Solutions & Presales
073407fe.description:
Posting Start Date: 24/09/2026
Job Description:
**Job Description**
-------------------


We are a technology\-led healthcare solutions provider. We are driven by our purpose to enable healthcare organizations to be future\-ready. We offer accelerated, global growth opportunities for talent that’s bold, industrious, and nimble. With Indegene, you gain a unique career experience that celebrates entrepreneurship and is guided by passion, innovation, collaboration, and empathy. To explore exciting opportunities at the convergence of healthcare and technology, check out www.careers.indegene.com Looking to jump\-start your career? We understand how important the first few years of your career are, which create the foundation of your entire professional journey. At Indegene, we promise you a differentiated career experience. You will not only work at the exciting intersection of healthcare and technology but also will be mentored by some of the most brilliant minds in the industry. We are offering a global fast\-track career where you can grow along with Indegene’s high\-speed growth. We are purpose\-driven. We enable healthcare organizations to be future ready and our customer obsession is our driving force. We ensure that our customers achieve what they truly want. We are bold in our actions, nimble in our decision\-making, and industrious in the way we work.
**Must Have**
-------------


Indegene is looking for a Pre\-sales Consultant who can play a vital role in the selling and business development process in collaboration with sales leaders. The person should be a self\-starter and is responsible for understanding what the clients need, develop an initial view of the solution, then tailor the proposition to meet what the client needs, articulate this solution to the sales / client, helps to close the deal and handshakes with delivery to ensure that the delivery team actually provides the intended solution. The person will play dual role in terms of supporting proposals across both the BUs and will work in close collaboration with senior leadership in crafting responses, holding together solution and bringing innovative ideas through continuous research of what is happening in the market space.
  

* Creation of the propositions \& collaterals – overall, practices aligned and account aligned
* Ability to conduct market research and build thought leadership/ PoVs on commercial and medical Solutions
* Work in close collaboration with Service line presales team or work independently for specific proposal depending upon the nature of proposal
* Creation of the RFI \& RFP responses
* Creation of the Proactive proposal responses
* Creation of the business model and commercials in collaboration with operations/sales teams
* Statement of Work creation and coordination for legal review
* Track all the deals in the pipeline and their closure
* Work with account teams to mine information, identify stakeholders and opportunities in collaboration with sales teams
* Conducting Customer presentations \& anchor geo\-based client visits
* Handshake with Delivery teams on proposal reviews and to capture the effort
* estimations
* Collaboration with Practices \& Verticals to align solutions \& pitches with a domain flavor
* Working with an eco\-system to align new go\-to\-market Solutions

Personal Attributes:
  

* You find ways to make complicated tasks easy. You take pride in eliminating things that
* aren’t valuable.
* You have a proven, demonstrable track record of success in presales
* Able to network with the verticals, presales and other support functions
* You are self\-driven and deeply motivated to bring in new business to Indegene iON
* You have excellent analytical thought process and ability to build innovation led solutions \& business models
* Excellent communication \& presentation skills
* Willingness to travel on need basis
* Preferably an MBA with a technology or engineering degree
* 5 to 8 years of experience with at least 3\+ years in presales
* Fluent with digital areas in Pharma, basic understanding of analytics, Pharma Lifesciences (Good to have)

**Good to have**
----------------


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**
---------------------


Indegene is proud to be an Equal Employment Employer and is committed to the culture of Inclusion and Diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, sex, colour, age, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, physical ability, or any other characteristics. All employment decisions, from hiring to separation, will be based on business requirements, the candidate’s merit and qualification. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristics.

7a39133e.title: Presales Consultant- Infra
7a39133e.description:
**Responsibilities:**  

* To work closely with Sales / Channel Team in approaching new engagements/prospects to find out and document the requirements and key findings. Perform solution mapping and relay requirements to Pre\-Sales Team for demonstrations.
* To conduct product demonstrations with focus in either Data Center infrastructure domain, Networking Networking Security domain or Data Analytics, Cognitive IoT domain.
* To provide assistance to the Sales / Channel Team in preparing Presentation Slides, Solution Proposals, solution BOM, Response to RFP and Tenders.
* To work closely with the Sales / Channel Team to ensure prospects requirements are fulfilled with and without the inclusion of 3rd party products other than what the Company distributes.
* To perform research on respective solution domain technologies (Eg, DC infra, Netsec, DCI) and how it can enhance solution or product positioning. If there are other technologies that can value add to the position, it should also be incorporated.
* To work closely with the Sales / Channel Team and Post\-Sales Team in preparing Scope of Work (SOW) whereby you will be the final owner of the SOW.
* To assist and jointly execute a hand\-over meeting upon successful win to the Post\-Sales Team with the Sales / Channel Team and Pre\-Sales Team.
* To be updated with latest changes or new product introduced by principals and/or 3rd party vendors.
* To fulfill and undergo product certification trainings asrequired.
* To understand and execute company’s marketing strategies and understand competitors’ products, services and strategies, feedback to management on plans and strategies.
* Participate in exhibitions to showcase products/solutions, capture leads, network with audiences to be closely updated with industry trends and needs.
* To ensure that you execute and deliver the target allocated for the Presales team or based on your line card.
* Any other duties as and when assigned from time to time.
* Validates pre\-sales solutions design andsizing.
* Coaches and mentor pre\-sales team
* Leads the technical discussion with suppliers on newinitiatives.
* Responsible for cross solutions bundles.
* Attends QBR sessions withsales.


**Knowledge, Skills and Experience:**  

* Bachelors degree in information technology/computer science or equivalent experience certifications preferred.
* Minimum of 4 years relevant working experience, ideally in IT multinational environment.
* At the minimum 5 years of solid work\-related experience, if does not possess a degree.
* Track record on the assigned line Cards experience is an added advantage.
* IT Distributor and/or SI experience would also be an added advantage.
* Have good communication in English, on the job understanding and problem\-solving skills.
* Proven ability to work independently, effectively in an off\-site environment and under high pressure.

002f9dd0.title: Solution Architect - Presales
002f9dd0.description:
**Lyzr, in a minute**
**Lyzr is an enterprise software company that helps large organisations put AI agents — software that handles real tasks on its own — to work in their everyday operations. Most companies’ AI projects never move past the pilot stage; Lyzr provides the platform that takes them into dependable, day\-to\-day use. Today, 500\+ enterprises build on Lyzr, more than 1,000 agents run live in production, and 85% of Lyzr projects reach production against an industry average of roughly 30%. Customers include Accenture, WTW, Hitachi, and Verifone, and the company recently raised $100M at a $500M valuation.**
**Our Presales team is where enterprise leaders decide that AI agents are worth serious investment. This role shapes that decision.**
**The role**
**Lyzr’s largest enterprise deals are won on business cases, not feature lists. As Solution Architect \- Pre\-sales , you will partner with our sales and solution teams on major enterprise opportunities — building the value case, quantifying business impact, and working directly with CFOs, COOs, and other business leaders to shape how AI agents fit their strategy. You will carry real influence over enterprise strategy, go\-to\-market, and how customers structure delivery and cost around AI.**
* Team: Presales
* Level: Senior
* Work mode: Hybrid


**What Will Make You Win This Role**
**These are the core requirements — the substance of the job.**
* 8\+ years of strong business solutioning background. You turn a customer’s business problem into a structured, quantified solution narrative.
* Executive\-level communication. You have worked with and reported to CTOs/ CIOs and business leaders and you are credible in that room.
* Value engineering and business transformation. Value generation, business consulting, and transformation work are your core toolkit, not adjacent skills.
* Strategy and go\-to\-market shaping. You have contributed to enterprise strategy, investor communications, and go\-to\-market decisions.
* Delivery and cost optimisation. You have optimised cross\-functional delivery and cost structures, and can bring that lens to customer conversations.


**Life at Lyzr**
* Benefits. Zomato meal allowance, an extensive PTO policy, and company\-paid subscriptions to leading AI tools — you work with the same tooling our customers rely on.
* Hybrid structure. Office days for collaboration and team problem\-solving; remote days for deep, uninterrupted work.
* An exceptional team. You will work alongside genuinely strong engineers and operators — the kind of colleagues who raise the level of everyone around them.
* Autonomy and ownership. We hire people who think like founders. You are given a problem and the space to drive your own outcomes — and with them, your own growth.
* Everybody is a visionary. Ideas are evaluated on merit, not seniority. You lead projects, make decisions, and shape what Lyzr becomes.


**Lead technical discovery with enterprise buyers and partner teams, mapping use cases to Lyzr Solutions
   

  

 Design reference architectures for customer VPC, multi\-cloud and air\-gapped on\-prem deployments, including integration with existing data, identity and security stacks.**
**Build and deliver tailored demos and scoped POCs that prove value within a fixed timeline.**
**Own the technical response on RFPs, security questionnaires and architecture reviews**
**Enable GSI and consulting partner architects through workshops, solution blueprints and joint deal support.**

5d7217aa.title: Presales Life
5d7217aa.description:
**Role Purpose:\-**
 The Life \& Pension PreSales Manager is a specialist role within Sapiens’ Insurance Practice, responsible for supporting the preparation and delivery of compelling, tailored demonstrations of the Sapiens Life Platform and CoreSuite for Life \& Pension (L\&P). Working closely with regional Sales teams and the broader Insurance Practice, this role plays a critical part in driving new business acquisition across APAC by translating prospect requirements into powerful platform demonstrations and proof\-of\-concept engagements.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:\-**
**Demo Preparation \& Delivery**
* Lead the preparation and delivery of tailored demonstrations of the Sapiens Life Platform and CoreSuite for L\&P to prospective clients across APAC.
* Configure the CoreSuite demo and presales environment to reflect individual prospect requirements and use cases, including product types (life, pension, annuity, protection).
* Develop and maintain scenario\-based demonstration scripts aligned to common L\&P market challenges and buyer personas.
* Support Proof\-of\-Concept (POC) engagements, including scoping, configuration, delivery, and documentation of outcomes.
* Ensure demo environments are current, stable, and reflect the latest product releases; coordinate with R\&D and Product teams on environment readiness.


**Bid \& RFx Support**
* Collaborate with Sales, Insurance Practice, and R\&D to produce high\-quality, differentiated bid responses within required timelines.


**Solution Architecture \& Discovery**
* Participate in and support Discovery and Blueprint engagements, helping to define the scope of the Sapiens solution to meet prospective or existing customer needs.
* Define and document proposed solution architectures for L\&P prospects, incorporating the Sapiens Life Platform, CoreSuite, and relevant ecosystem components.
* Support the estimation process for commercial scoping, ensuring that proposed solutions are technically feasible and commercially sound.
* Provide input into product solutions designed to meet specific market or regulatory requirements, working collaboratively with R\&D and Insurance Practice colleagues.


**Sales Enablement \& Regional Alignment**
* Act as the presales technical resource for L\&P opportunities across assigned regions, partnering closely with regional Sales Managers and Account Executives.
* Support regional sales alignment by attending and contributing to pipeline reviews, opportunity qualification, and customer\-facing engagements.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of presales assets, including demo scripts, use case libraries, capability matrices, and standard presentation materials.
* Provide internal guidance and training to Sales colleagues on L\&P product capability and demonstration best practices.


**Proposition \& Product Input**
* Provide structured feedback from prospect and customer interactions to inform the product roadmap and R\&D prioritisation.
* Participate in design reviews and approval processes for new R\&D roadmap developments relevant to the L\&P market.
* Collaborate with the Insurance Practice and Product teams to define functional capabilities required to support the strategic direction of the Sapiens L\&P proposition.


**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience:\-**
**Essential**
* Demonstrable experience in a presales, solution consulting, or technical sales role within the insurance software or insurtech sector.
* Strong working knowledge of Life \& Pension insurance products, operations, and technology platforms – including policy administration systems (PAS).
* Proven ability to configure, prepare, and deliver high\-quality software demonstrations to senior insurance executives.
* Demonstrate ability to leverage AI tools and platforms to develop and articulate compelling value propositions for AI\-driven strategies within life insurance administration solutions, translating complex capabilities into measurable business outcomes for clients and stakeholders.
* Experience supporting RFI/RFP processes.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; confident engaging with C\-suite, business, and technical stakeholders.
* Ability to translate complex business requirements into clear, structured solution narratives.
* Self\-motivated, organised, and able to manage multiple concurrent presales engagements.


**Desirable**
* Experience in working in a Life and Pensions Insurer, possibly in an operational capacity.
* Hands\-on experience with Sapiens CoreSuite for L\&P or Sapiens Life Platform.
* Familiarity with insurance regulatory frameworks across EMEA and APAC markets.
* Experience working within a global or matrix organisation.
* Exposure to Wealth, Retirement, or Protection product lines.
* Knowledge of insurance ecosystem components including digital engagement, reporting, and analytics platforms.


**Key Competencies:\-**
**Customer Focus**
 Understands and anticipates customer needs; builds credibility in presales engagements.
   

  

**Solution Thinking**
 Able to connect prospect requirements to platform capability in a compelling way.
   

  

**Collaboration**
 Works effectively across Sales, Practice, Product, and R\&D teams.
   

  

**Commercial Awareness**
 Understands the sales cycle and contributes actively to pipeline progression.
   

  

**Adaptability**
 Comfortable operating across multiple geographies, cultures, and prospect contexts.
   

  

**Attention to Detail**
 Delivers accurate, high\-quality presales content and documentation.
   

  

**About Sapiens International:\-**
 Sapiens International Corporation is a leading global provider of software solutions for the insurance industry. Sapiens’ CoreSuite for Life \& Pension is a market\-leading policy administration platform deployed by insurers and pension providers across EMEA and APAC. The Insurance Practice drives the presales, proposition, and consultancy capability that supports Sapiens’ growth strategy in the L\&P sector.

**Location: India (Remote)**

Limelight is a **fast\-growing FP\&A software company** transforming how finance teams plan, forecast, and report. We empower CFOs, controllers, and analysts with **dynamic, connected, and scalable financial models**—all in a platform that feels as familiar as Excel, but without the risks.

As a Senior FP\&A Consultant, you’ll work hand\-in\-hand with our **Project Managers** to design and deliver the financial models, templates, and reports our customers depend on. You’ll be more than an implementer—you’ll be a problem\-solver, a trusted advisor, and a partner in helping finance teams do their best work.

* Ensure projects stay on track—managing timelines, deliverables, and client expectations.
* Train finance teams, share best practices, and make sure they get value from Limelight.
* Partner with internal teams (Product, Success, Sales) to continuously improve outcomes for clients.

### **Qualifications:**

* **5\+ years’ experience** in FP\&A, financial consulting, or financial software implementation.
* Strong knowledge of **financial planning cycles** (budgets, forecasts, variance analysis, reporting).
* Advanced **Excel and financial modeling skills**—you know how to structure and present numbers that tell a story.
* Familiarity with tools like **NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Adaptive, Planful, or other FP\&A platforms** is a plus.
* Excellent communication skills and confidence working with senior finance leaders.
* A **problem\-solving mindset**—you don’t just deliver what’s asked, you suggest what’s needed.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to a **fast\-paced SaaS environment**.
* CPA, CFA, or PMP certification is a bonus.

### **You’ll Thrive at Limelight If You:**

* Love helping finance teams work smarter with better tools.
* Enjoy combining **finance, consulting, and technology** in your career.
* Take pride in seeing a project through from idea to impact.
* Want to be part of a modern SaaS company where your work directly helps customers succeed  

  

**Why Join Limelight?**  

  

At Limelight, you won’t just implement software—you’ll help finance teams transform how they work. You’ll be part of a growing company with the **best UI, best modeling, and best value** in the FP\&A space, and you’ll have the chance to grow your skills in consulting, finance, and technology.

203d4a3a.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.
* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.


**About The Job**
 The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem\-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross\-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
   

  

 As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre\-sales agreement shaping and post\-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
   

  

 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long\-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise\-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code\-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real\-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer\-facing teams.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

8a805c46.title: Solution Architecture - HCL Commerce
8a805c46.description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We embrace a dynamic and inclusive culture. Here you will collaborate with multi\-national teams, contribute to a myriad of innovative projects that deliver the most creative and cutting\-edge solutions, and have an opportunity to continuously learn and grow. No matter where you are located, you will join a dedicated, creative, and diverse community that will help you discover your fullest potential.*


We're looking for a seasoned **Solution Architect** with HCL Commerce expertise to drive the design and evolution of a multi\-tier B2B commerce platform, steering architecture decisions across legacy Commerce systems, Spring Boot services, and modern Next.js storefronts.

**Responsibilities**

* Establish and maintain target and transitional architecture for multi\-tier B2B commerce, covering WCS store, business logic, Commerce tools, Spring Boot APIs, and Next.js / React storefront
* Direct the design of dual\-run / strangler patterns, deciding which journeys stay on WCS and which move to Next.js and services, while ensuring routing, session, catalog, cart, and order consistency, and establishing cut\-over and rollback procedures
* Create and review solution designs, sequence/integration diagrams, and interface contracts (REST/SOAP), flagging reusability, performance, security, and operability issues before build
* Collaborate with product, delivery leads, QA, DevOps, and enterprise/integration teams on requirements, data conversion, integration testing, and cut\-over activities
* Set coding and design standards for Commerce customization, Spring Boot services, and Next.js storefront to keep squads aligned
* Oversee integration with back\-end systems (ERP, payments, search, CMS, punchout / customer purchasing systems), keeping a clear separation between Preview (authoring) and Runtime (customer\-facing) Commerce environments
* Assess designs and pull requests across Commerce, services, and storefront layers, tracking down complex cross\-layer defects to their root cause
* Provide guidance on capacity planning, caching strategies, search, and failure modes for a high\-traffic B2B storefront
* Coach senior engineers and leads, and document architecture decisions with context, options, and consequences to preserve continuity
* Spot key barriers and use structured problem\-solving methods for complex, multi\-system challenges

**Requirements**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* 12\-20 years in professional software engineering, including at least 5 years as an architect or in an equivalent principal/staff design capacity on large\-scale commerce or comparably complex multi\-tier systems
* At least 8 years working with HCL Commerce and/or IBM WebSphere Commerce (WCS) 8\.x, spanning store customization, commands/tasks, tools, catalog/order/user/organization flows, and back\-end integration
* At least 8 years of experience in Java / J2EE and object\-oriented design on large IT systems, with a strong preference for WebSphere Application Server background
* At least 5 years working with Spring / Spring MVC, with hands\-on experience architecting Spring Boot solutions, including service boundaries, APIs, resilience, and authentication
* At least 5 years working with REST and SOAP web services, with the capability to define contracts for other teams to build against
* Hands\-on production architecture experience with Next.js and React, covering routing, data fetching, BFF/API integration, and storefront performance, with TypeScript knowledge preferred
* At least 5 years using source control systems, with required Git proficiency
* Preferred background in designing B2B commerce architecture, including punchout functionality, organizational/user models, and contract/pricing complexity
* Familiarity with Agile delivery methods using Atlassian tooling (Jira, Bitbucket/Git, Confluence)
* Strong written and verbal communication abilities suited to both technical and non\-technical audiences

**Nice to have**

* Familiarity with headless/composable commerce concepts (API\-first storefronts, BFF, packaged capabilities) and MuleSoft or comparable iPaaS platforms
* Exposure to search technologies (Solr or similar), caching solutions (Redis or similar), and CMS\-driven storefronts (Optimizely or similar) working alongside a commerce engine
* Hands\-on experience with cloud platforms (GKE/Kubernetes or similar) for storefront and Spring Boot deployment, plus WAS/IHS knowledge for Commerce
* Working knowledge of security practices, PCI\-adjacent payment flows, and session/identity management spanning legacy and modern storefronts
* Prior involvement in dual\-run setups or large\-scale commerce migration initiatives

**We offer**

* Opportunity to work on technical challenges that may impact across geographies
* Vast opportunities for self\-development: online university, knowledge sharing opportunities globally, learning opportunities through external certifications
* Opportunity to share your ideas on international platforms
* Sponsored Tech Talks \& Hackathons
* Unlimited access to LinkedIn learning solutions
* Possibility to relocate to any EPAM office for short and long\-term projects
* Focused individual development
* Benefit package:
	+ Health benefits
	+ Retirement benefits
	+ Paid time off
	+ Flexible benefits
* Forums to explore beyond work passion (CSR, photography, painting, sports, etc.)

* Mentor and guide delivery teams on best practices and architectural standards.
* Ensure integration of Kinaxis with ERP, MES, and other enterprise systems.
* Drive continuous improvement and optimization of planning processes.
* Manage client expectations and provide executive‑level status reporting.

* Deep expertise in Kinaxis RapidResponse, including demand and supply planning modules.

* Strong background in solution authoring and configuration management.
* Hands‑on experience with rapid‑response scenario modeling and analytics.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to lead cross‑functional delivery teams and mentor junior staff.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Supply Chain, or related field (Master’s preferred).
* Relevant certifications (e.g., Kinaxis RapidResponse, TOGAF, PMP) are a plus.

 Bristlecone is ranked among the top ten leaders in supply chain services by Gartner. We are headquartered in San Jose, California, with locations across North America, Europe and Asia, and over 2,500 consultants. Bristlecone is part of the $19\.4 billion Mahindra Group.

e74ef81e.title: Solution Architect
e74ef81e.description:
**Company Description**
 Vialto Partners is a market leader in Global Mobility Services. Our purpose is to “Connect the World.” We are unique and the only stand\-alone global mobility business. This presents a rare opportunity for our clients, stakeholders and colleagues.
   

  

 Our teams help companies streamline and effectively manage their global mobility programs in a cost\-efficient and compliant manner. Our services focus on providing cross\-border compliance and risk assessment for tax, immigration, business travel, rewards and compensation, and remote work.
   

  

 Working at Vialto Partners is about getting the chance to be part of a global and dynamic team. Globally, Vialto Partners has over 8,000 staff worldwide and continues to grow. You will work with clients from a range of industries and different geographical locations. We believe in connecting the world and supporting our colleagues to do the same in their careers by undertaking assignments and opportunities globally that broaden their skills and ultimately benefit our clients.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are hiring a hands\-on Solutions Architect to design, build, and operate complex, regulated, global solutions across payroll, tax, and immigration domains. This role is technical\-first: you will own the end\-to\-end architecture for a product or suite of products and contribute directly to implementation (spikes, reference services, critical\-path features), while partnering with a global, cross\-functional team to drive delivery, deployments, and production support across time zones. You will also lead the adoption of AI\-powered development practices—including spec\-driven development and agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex)—and design AI\-enabled solutions using Azure OpenAI APIs and intelligent agents to automate business process flows.
   

  

**What You’ll Do (Hands\-On)**
* Architecture \+ Build: Produce architecture designs and implement key components (reference implementations, platform libraries, integration adapters, critical workflows).
* Distributed Systems: Design and build event\-driven services (messaging, async workflows, idempotency, retries, backpressure, eventual consistency), including well\-defined event contracts and versioning strategies.
* Azure Solution Design: Build using Azure PaaS services and patterns (identity, networking, storage, messaging, API management, monitoring), with practical tradeoffs across cost, scalability, resilience, and latency. Design and integrate AI capabilities using Azure OpenAI APIs (GPT, embeddings, assistants) to enable intelligent features and agent\-driven automation within business process flows.
* Front\-End Architecture: Architect and ship large Next.js/React applications (routing, state strategy, data\-fetching patterns, performance, accessibility, modularization, micro\-frontend considerations where relevant).
* Integration Architecture: Define secure integration patterns (REST and event\-based), build connectors/adapters, and establish operational runbooks for partner/client integrations.
* Security by Design: Implement secure SDLC practices—threat modeling, secrets management, encryption, least\-privilege access, audit logging, and secure defaults aligned to regulated environments.
* Authentication \& Authorization: Implement end\-to\-end authn/authz using OAuth2/OIDC, SSO, and token\-based access. Design RBAC/ABAC/ReBAC, tenant\-aware authorization, API scopes/claims, and service\-to\-service identity (e.g., managed identities).
* Operational Readiness: Own observability and reliability patterns (structured logging, metrics, tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident response) and participate in troubleshooting production issues.
* Documentation that Ships: Create actionable architecture artifacts (ADRs, sequence diagrams, domain flows, deployment diagrams, runbooks) that teams can execute against.

913cabeb.title: Principal Technical Architect
913cabeb.description:
**About Workato**
 Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission\-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com.
   

  

**Why join us?**
 Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a
 **flexible, trust\-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles** 
 . We are driven by
 **innovation** 
 and looking for
 **team players** 
 who want to actively build our company.
   

  

 But, we also believe in
 **balancing productivity with self\-care** 
 . That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.
   

  

 If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!
   

  

**Also, Feel Free To Check Out Why**
* Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”
* Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world
* Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America
* Quartz ranked us the \#1 best company for remote workers


**About The Role**
 Workato is looking for a Principal Technical Architect, AI to join as a Field Specialist operating at the intersection of applied AI engineering and customer\-facing technical strategy. This is a dual\-mandate role with an approximately equal split:
   

  

**Mandate 1 – AI Field Specialist (Customer\-facing):** 
 You will work directly with enterprise customers and prospects in pre\-sales and post\-sales engagements to define and architect their AI strategies on Workato. This includes designing agentic automation solutions, advising on the latest approaches and best practices, scoping AI agent implementations, and helping customers move from proof\-of\-concept to production\-grade autonomous systems.
   

  

**Mandate 2 – Agentic CS Platform (Internal initiative):** 
 You will be a core architect and developer on Workato's autonomous Customer Success agent initiative, a production\-grade system that captures complete customer context to support reasoning, and compounds intelligence over time. You will own the agent and memory architecture, evals and learning loop, and autonomy framework that power this system.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who builds agentic systems to orchestrate LLMs into reliable, auditable, enterprise\-grade agent architectures, and who can articulate that vision to a customer CIO and technical leaders as fluently as they can implement it in code.
   

  

 Workato has a positive, diverse, and collaborative culture; we look for people who are curious, inventive, smart, hardworking, and who work to be a little better every day.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 AI Field Specialist
   

  

* Support as an expert AI architect in strategic enterprise engagements: roadmapping customer AI agent use cases and delivering technical deep\-dives that demonstrate Workato's agentic capabilities.
* Lead architecture workshops with enterprise customers to define their AI automation strategy, including agent design, integration patterns, and governance frameworks.
* Advise customers on applied AI best practices: prompt engineering and agent orchestration patterns, evaluation and testing strategies for agent systems, confidence calibration, human\-in\-the\-loop design, and continuous learning loops.
* Build reusable technical assets, such as reference architectures, solution blueprints, demonstration environments, and best\-practice documentation, that enable the broader field team to position AI solutions.
* Develop and deliver technical collateral: architecture white papers, webinars, blog posts, conference talks, etc. that establish Workato's thought leadership in agentic automation.
* Partner with Product and Engineering to feed field insights back into the platform roadmap, ensuring customer\-facing AI capabilities evolve based on real deployment patterns.
* Support global strategic accounts across the US, EMEA, and APAC geographies as needed for critical engagements.
* May require up to 20% global travel.


 Agentic CS Platform
   

  

* Architect and implement core subsystems of the autonomous CS agent platform, including memory layers, the agent orchestration layer, and the decision trace architecture.
* Design and build a Customer Knowledge Graph as a structured, semantic network that models customers, users, policies, decisions, and operational artifacts as interconnected entities and relationships, enabling queryable representation of contextual states, and policy evaluations for governance, traceability, and decision optimization.
* Implement the confidence\-based autonomy framework, including precedent matching, confidence scoring (precedent match, pattern recognition, data completeness, policy clarity), and policy\-governed escalation routing.
* Define and design infrastructure architecture to ensure optimal performance and latency.
* Take scalable technology selection decisions.
* Establish evaluation frameworks: define metrics for decision quality, context accuracy, and learning velocity (autonomous threshold increases month over month).


**Requirements**
 Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

* B.Tech/BE or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 15\+ years of total relevant experience in enterprise software architecture, design, and implementation.
* 8\+ years of hands\-on experience with Integration Platforms (MuleSoft, TIBCO, Oracle SOA, webMethods, or similar). Deep familiarity with iPaaS architecture patterns is essential.
* 2\+ years of applied AI/Agents engineering experience, specifically in building systems that leverage LLMs and agent frameworks, orchestrating them into production applications.


 Applied AI \& Agent Architecture (Must\-Have)
   

  

* Hands\-on experience designing and building AI agent systems: multi\-step reasoning pipelines, tool\-use orchestration, and autonomous execution frameworks.
* Working knowledge of Python agent frameworks such as LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, or equivalent. LangGraph experience with persisted state and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns is strongly preferred.
* Experience with graph database design and implementation: entity modeling, relationship extraction, graph querying, and using graph structures for contextual retrieval. Neo4j/NetworkX equivalent experience is a plus.
* Practical experience with RAG architectures, vector databases, embedding strategies, and hybrid retrieval (vector \+ structured \+ graph).
* Understanding of evaluation and testing for AI systems: building evals, measuring agent quality, confidence calibration, A/B testing of prompts/pipelines, and regression testing for non\-deterministic outputs.
* Familiarity with prompt engineering at production scale: structured prompting, chain\-of\-thought patterns, output parsing, retry/fallback strategies, and prompt versioning.
* Experience with observability for LLM systems: tracing, token/cost monitoring, and latency profiling. Familiarity with Langfuse, LangSmith, Phoenix, or similar tools.
* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) standards for LLM\-to\-system integration.


 Integration \& Enterprise Architecture (Must\-Have)
   

  

* Strong expertise in enterprise integration patterns: event\-driven architectures, microservices orchestration, pub/sub messaging, and data synchronization.
* Deep working knowledge of APIs: RESTful, SOAP, webhooks, and data formats (JSON, XML).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud\-native services (Lambda/Functions, DynamoDB, Kafka/Kinesis, S3\).
* Familiarity with enterprise applications: Salesforce, ServiceNow, SAP, Workday, NetSuite, or similar. Understanding how these systems participate in agentic workflows.
* Understanding of enterprise security and governance requirements: OAuth, SSO, data residency, SOX compliance, audit trails, and role\-based access control.


 Nice\-to\-Have
   

  

* Background in Customer Success platforms (Gainsight, ChurnZero) or CRM architecture.
* Prior experience in a customer\-facing technical role (Solutions Architect, Field CTO, Technical Account Manager, or Pre\-Sales Engineer) at a SaaS or platform company.
* Contributions to open\-source AI/agent projects or published technical content in the applied AI space.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Exceptional ability to communicate complex AI and architecture concepts to diverse audiences: from engineering teams to C\-level executives: adapting depth and vocabulary to the room.
* Strong consultative instinct: able to listen to a customer's business problem, decompose it into architectural components, and propose a credible path forward in real\-time.
* Entrepreneurial mindset with comfort operating in ambiguity: this role spans an internal build and an external advisory function, and requires someone who can context\-switch and self\-prioritize.
* Collaborative by default: able to work across Product, Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Marketing without needing formal authority.
* Excellent written communication: able to produce architecture documents, white papers, and technical briefs that are clear, precise, and persuasive.
* Fast learner who stays current with the rapidly evolving AI agent ecosystem and can distill emerging patterns into practical guidance.

At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. Brief leadership with clarity, candour and a clear ask; report honestly including bad news; and hold alignment across function heads, plant and market leadership, finance, procurement, HR and partner executives who do not report to you. Surface resistance early and distinguish genuine business objection from turf protection .

* **Multi\-vendor ecosystem leadership –** run consortia of consultants, system integrators, OEMs and specialist partners under different commercial constructs. Own RFP to award, SOW/NFA, SLA and penalty frameworks, milestone\-linked invoicing and change control. Eliminate seams between vendors, hold each to outcomes rather than effort, and act decisively – including descoping or exiting a non\-performer mid\-program
* **A** **doption, not just deployment –** define adoption metrics up front and be judged on them: usage, process compliance, data quality, cycle time and cost outcomes after go\-live. Own the change architecture – communication, leadership cascades, champion networks, training, hypercare and sustainment \& **Governance and financial control –** run a disciplined review rhythm with owner\-and\-date closure; control budgets, phased fund release, commitment\-versus\-spend and forecast\-at\-completion; enforce a single source of truth and auditable decision trails
**Your Profile**
----------------

* 14–20 years overall, with at least two enterprise transformation programs personally led end to end – typically ₹100 crore\+ in value, 18–36 months, enterprise\-wide impact \& Five or more delivery partners running concurrently, with ownership of the commercial and performance relationship.
* Sustained exposure to CXO and board forums – not through a sponsor, but as the person in the room answering the questions \& Delivery across multiple cultures – multi\-country, post\-merger integration, or a genuinely diverse multi\-state Indian footprint spanning corporate, plant and field
* Scope extending well beyond IT – process, organisation, commercial and behavioural change explicitly owned \& Accountability for a business number – cost, working capital, cycle time, service level or revenue – with evidence of delivered versus promised

-----------------------------------------

With its strong over 55\-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. The TAM works closely with customer System Administrators and internal teams to understand business processes, ensure effective system configuration, and help customers maximize value from the platform.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Named Technical Contact**
* Serve as the dedicated technical resource for assigned customer accounts
* Partner with customer System Administrators to understand business processes, workflows, and system configurations
* Maintain deep familiarity with each customer’s environment, priorities, and use cases55


**Product Expertise \& Consultation**
* Act as a product expert, providing guidance, best practices, and technical consultation
* Translate customer business needs into system configuration and optimization recommendations
* Support customers in understanding platform capabilities, limitations, and tradeoffs


**Issue Facilitation \& Support Oversight**
* Provide oversight and coordination for customer support tickets
* Own or directly manage highly technical or complex issues as needed
* Effectively escalate critical and urgent issues, partnering with Support, Engineering, and Product teams to drive resolution
* Analyze support trends and proactively address recurring issues


**Readiness \& Enablement Management**
* Ensure customers are prepared for and leveraging new product features
* Conduct Release Readiness Reviews to prepare customers for upcoming releases, including testing, configuration changes, and process impacts
* Partner with customers to drive feature adoption aligned to their business goals


**Trusted Advisor \& Relationship Management**

+ Open workstreams and initiatives
+ Support ticket status and analysis
+ New questions and technical needs
+ Open and prioritized issues
+ Action items and next steps

* Serve as a trusted consultant, ensuring alignment between customer goals and platform usage
* Advocate for customer needs internally and provide feedback to Product and Engineering teams


**You will do well in this role if you…**
* become a trusted advisor to customers, hyper\-focused on quality and successful adoption
* always strive to provide exceptional customer experience
* are technical\-focused with analytical and problem\-solving skills while able to describe technical configurations to non\-technical audiences
* build positive relationships with peers while working remotely with others across geographies and cultures
* listen continuously, learning from others and leveraging input
* possess unquestionable integrity, credibility, and character proactively demonstrating high moral and ethical behavior
* constantly improve your own work methods
* commit to the sustainability/scalability of Legion solutions
* work well as a self\-starter in a fluid work environment with limited resources
* are a career driven individual looking to grow in a fast paced startup


**Requirements and Qualifications**
* 3\+ years Technical Account Management or other relevant experience such as implementing and configuring workforce management solutions
* Experience in managing multiple stakeholders and projects with competing priorities
* Strong root cause diagnostic capabilities to assess customer reported problems and determine whether it’s a software, configuration, or user error

* Possess exceptional interpersonal and English communication skills including verbal, written presentation and listening
* Technical understanding of integration platforms such as Workato, Dell Boomi, Jitterbit,


 SnapLogic (Workato preferred)5
   

  

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills**
* Workforce management (WFM) consulting and integration experience
* 3\+ years Technical Account Management or other relevant experience such as implementing and configuring workforce management solutions
* Proven ability to manage changes for business growth minimizing disruption
* Experience in operating environments in retail, hospitality, restaurant or other industries to understand and identify labor challenges that Legion solves
* Exposure to agile software development leveraging toolsets (e.g. Jira, GitHub, Jenkins)


**ABOUT LEGION**
 Join Legion's mission to turn hourly jobs into good jobs. We're a mission\-driven team seeking exceptional talent to propel this vision. Embrace a culture that's collaborative, fast\-paced, and entrepreneurial. With us, you'll grow your skills, work closely with experienced executives, and contribute significantly to our mission.
   

  

 Our award\-winning AI\-native workforce management platform is intelligent, automated, and employee\-centric and proven to deliver 13x ROI. We help labor\-intensive organizations maximize labor efficiency and employee engagement simultaneously.
   

  

 Legion has earned recognition for its innovation, including spots on the Inc. 5000 list, Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, and awards for our AI technology. Backed by leading investors such as Norwest Venture Partners, Stripes, First Round Capital, XYZ Ventures, Webb Investment Network, Workday Ventures, and NTT DOCOMO Ventures, we're making real change.
   

  

 If you're ready to make an impact and grow your career, Legion is where you belong. Join us in making hourly work rewarding and fulfilling.
   

  

**BACKGROUND AND OPPORTUNITY**
 There are almost 75 million hourly workers in the United States, representing more than half of the entire workforce. Historically, managing hourly employees has been difficult due to high attrition (average of 60%) and high replacement costs (average of $3,200 per employee in retail). The ongoing labor shortage and competition from the gig economy, make it more difficult to attract and retain hourly employees. The top reasons hourly employees leave their jobs are a lack of schedule empowerment, poor communication with employers, and an inability to get paid early. Gen Z and the millennial workforce demand gig\-like flexibility, modern technology, and compelling work options. Legion’s mission is to turn hourly jobs into good jobs, serving the hourly workers who make up the majority of the US workforce. We believe in empowering employees and helping employers be efficient and innovative by enabling intelligent automation powered by Legion’s Workforce Management platform to optimize labor efficiency and enhance the employee experience simultaneously.
   

  

 Legion WFM was built for the cloud with AI at the core and is designed to handle the complexity of modern businesses and meet the needs of today’s hourly employees. Our team is composed of dedicated individuals from all backgrounds and experiences, globally distributed across all time zones.
   

  

 For more information, visit https://legion.co

 Peloton Consulting Group has the vision and connected global capabilities to help organizations envision, implement, and realize the benefits of digital transformation. Our team has the best practices, knowledge, industry expertise, and know\-how. We make digital transformation a reality by leveraging AI, Enterprise Performance Management (EPM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Supply Chain Management (SCM), Human Capital Management (HCM), Customer Experience (CX), Analytics, and Data Management for the cloud. Through connected capabilities, we bring people, processes, and technology together. We help organizations go further faster. That is the Peloton way!
   

  

 What truly sets us apart is our people. We are team players. We are energetic and entrepreneurial. We are problem solvers and innovative thinkers who believe the best outcomes are built together. We believe in quality, appreciate creativity, recognize individual contributions, and place trust in every member of our team. If you bring strong business or technical expertise and want to do meaningful work alongside people who are equally passionate about getting it right, we think you'll feel right at home here.
   

  

 This role requires a balance of client relationship management, operational oversight, and strategic thinking to ensure services are delivered efficiently and aligned with evolving client business needs.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**

 The consultant will work as part of the Application Managed Services (AMS) / Support team, providing ongoing functional and technical support for Oracle ARCS (Account Reconciliation Cloud Service) and related EPM Cloud applications. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors including but not limited to skills, experience, qualifications, business needs, and geographic location. Peloton also offer bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package including

db7a57ad.title: Principal Program Manager
db7a57ad.description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Job Description: Project Manager (T4\)**

**Position:** Principal Program Manager— Level T4  

**Function:** Engineering / Program Management — EDA Software Development

**Role Overview**


We are looking for a seasoned Project Manager to lead and coordinate complex, high\-stakes initiatives across multiple engineering and business teams in the context of **Electronic Design Automation (EDA) software development**. You will be the central orchestrator ensuring delivery excellence, stakeholder alignment, and continuous innovation across the full EDA product lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Multi\-team coordination:** Drive alignment across cross\-functional teams (engineering, QA, design, operations, business) to ensure seamless execution and on\-time delivery of EDA software projects.
* **Customer project ownership:** Manage end\-to\-end delivery of customer\-facing EDA projects, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring commitments are met with quality.
* **High\-stakes project leadership:** Lead critical, high\-visibility programs with significant business or technical impact, managing risks proactively and escalating appropriately.
* **Structured planning:** Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and resource plans using rigorous methodologies (Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, or hybrid).
* **Innovation facilitation:** Champion new approaches and continuously explore emerging tools — including **AI\-assisted project management** (intelligent scheduling, risk prediction, automated reporting, and AI\-driven decision support) — to improve team efficiency and project outcomes.
* **Status reporting:** Provide clear, concise, and accurate communication to all stakeholders — from engineers to senior leadership.
* **Team collaboration:** Foster a strong team spirit, removing blockers and ensuring every contributor feels supported and empowered.

**Required Profile**

* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-team programs in a technical or software development environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to adapt messaging for both technical and executive audiences.
* Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and structured in approach.
* Collaborative mindset with genuine team spirit — you succeed when the team succeeds.
* Comfortable operating under pressure and navigating ambiguity on high\-stakes deliverables.
* Experience with project management tools (Jira, Confluence, MS Project, or equivalent).
* **Understanding of EDA tools and the semiconductor design flow is a strong plus** — familiarity with the domain (simulation, synthesis, place \& route, verification, etc.) enables faster ramp\-up and more credible engagement with engineering teams.
* **PMP certification (Project Management Professional) is a strong plus** — it demonstrates mastery of globally recognized PM standards and a commitment to the discipline.

**What We Value**


You are not just a process enforcer — you are a builder of bridges between teams, a guardian of commitments to customers, and a driver of a culture where quality and innovation go hand in hand. You embrace AI as a force multiplier to manage smarter, not just harder — and you bring enough EDA domain awareness to speak the language of the engineers you serve.

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**
-------------------------------------------------------------------

bef37080.title: Senior Technical Program Manager II
bef37080.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future
   

  

**Job Description**
**Strategic Mandate**
 As the Technical Program Manager (Associate) for Data \& AI Platforms, you sit at the delivery interface between Nielsen's Databricks\-based Data Platform and AI/Data Engineering teams and the stakeholders who build on them — internal consumers such as Finance, HR, Product, Analytics, and Data Science, as well as external partners, vendors, and clients involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives. You understand the platform well enough to read its dependencies: Unity Catalog access gates, Delta Lake/DLT pipeline sequencing, compute and governance constraints. You translate those technical realities into program plans, risk registers, and status reporting that keep every initiative leveraging the platform moving — tracked, unblocked, and visible to leadership
   

  

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**
* Technical Program Coordination: Coordinate delivery of initiatives that depend on the Databricks Lakehouse — Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Databricks Workflows — translating technical dependencies, sequencing, and architecture decisions into program plans and risk registers.
* Agile Delivery Cadence: Run Agile/Scrum or Kanban ceremonies (planning, standups, retros) across initiatives to keep delivery cadence consistent.
* Technical Stakeholder Liaison: Partner directly with the Data Platform Lead, the Lead Data and AI Engineer, and Architecture to understand platform capabilities and constraints (compute, governance, cost), and represent them accurately to consumer stakeholders.
* External Stakeholder \& Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external parties involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives — technology vendors (e.g., Databricks), system integrators, data partners, and consumer stakeholders — aligning on scope, timelines, technical interfaces, and data\-sharing or contractual milestones.
* Technical Risk \& Dependency Management: Maintain a technical RAID log capturing platform\-level risks (e.g., Unity Catalog access blockers, compute capacity limits, governance sign\-off delays) and drive resolution across engineering and business teams.
* Release \& Readiness Coordination: Coordinate technical readiness activities — environment provisioning, access/governance approvals, CI/CD release windows — for initiatives going live on the platform.
* Technical Reporting \& Governance Cadence: Translate engineering status (sprint burndown, pipeline health, platform incidents) into program\-level status reports and steering committee materials that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* Change \& Technical Adoption Support: Support rollout of new platform and AI capabilities (e.g., emerging Databricks Genie or AI features) by coordinating technical enablement sessions, documentation, and stakeholder readiness.
* Post\-Implementation Review: Facilitate post\-implementation reviews and retrospectives after major rollouts, capturing lessons learned and feeding continuous\-improvement actions back into the program.
* Process \& Tooling Discipline: Own PMO tooling (Jira, Confluence) configured to reflect technical workflows — epics and stories mapped to pipelines, environments, and governance gates — not just generic task tracking


**Qualifications**
**Expertise \& Technology Stack**
* Core Experience: 6\+ years coordinating technical programs or projects, ideally within AI/Data engineering, platform, or cloud environments.
* Platform Technical Fluency: Working knowledge of data platform architecture concepts — Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, core Spark concepts, and CI/CD — sufficient to read architecture docs, follow technical design discussions, and ask informed questions.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Familiarity with GenAI/AI enablement concepts (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie) to coordinate initiatives that leverage them.
* Technical Delivery Tooling: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet, including engineering\-adjacent artifacts like burndown/velocity charts, dependency maps, and technical RAID logs.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate between engineering language (architecture, dependencies, technical debt) and business language (timelines, risk, value) for varied stakeholders.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify technical dependencies and risks across concurrent initiatives and know when and how to escalate them.
* Vendor \& External Partner Coordination: Experience coordinating with external vendors, system integrators, or data partners on technical delivery timelines, contractual milestones, and statement\-of\-work (SOW) tracking


**Additional Information**
**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Experience: 6\+ years in a Technical Program/Project Management, technical PMO, or technical business analyst role, preferably supporting data, cloud, or platform engineering initiatives.
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred: PMP, CAPM, or a Scrum/Agile certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be comfortable participating in technical design discussions as well as business stakeholder updates, and translating clearly between the two.


 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

104684ee.title: Program Manager
104684ee.description:
**Overview**
**Program Manager – Job Description**
 We are seeking an accomplished Program Manager to lead large\-scale, complex IT services programs spanning cloud, data, platform, and enterprise application landscapes. This role carries end\-to\-end ownership of program outcomes — balancing hands\-on delivery execution with strategic portfolio alignment across multiple concurrent engagements for internal stakeholders and external clients. The ideal candidate brings both program governance rigor and a
 **product engineering mindset** 
 — understanding the technical architecture underneath delivery, not just the schedule on top of it.
   

  

 Program Manager
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Program Leadership \& Delivery**
* Own end\-to\-end delivery across scope, schedule, cost, and quality — consistently meeting client satisfaction and business outcome targets.
* Establish and govern Agile/hybrid program frameworks, metrics, and tooling (Jira, executive dashboards, status reporting) across multiple concurrent workstreams.
* Provide oversight across multi\-vendor, cross\-geography teams, ensuring consistent delivery standards and accountability.


**Product \& Technical Ownership**
* Apply a product development mindset to program delivery — thinking in terms of releases, technical debt, platform scalability, and long\-term maintainability rather than just milestone dates.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to understand system design trade\-offs (cloud infrastructure, data pipelines, integration architecture) well enough to make informed scope, sequencing, and risk calls.
* Own technical roadmap alignment — ensuring program plans reflect realistic engineering constraints (CI/CD maturity, environment readiness, tech debt, dependency mapping across microservices/platforms).
* Drive quality engineering practices across programs — test automation coverage, release readiness gates, defect leakage, and production stability metrics.
* Guide build\-vs\-buy and platform modernization decisions (e.g., cloud migration, data platform re\-architecture) in collaboration with technical leadership.
* Champion DevOps and SDLC maturity — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/CloudFormation), observability, and automated deployment practices across program teams.
* Maintain working fluency in the technology stacks in play (cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP, data platforms like Snowflake/Databricks, integration/API layers) sufficient to challenge estimates, de\-risk technical dependencies, and speak credibly with client engineering teams.


**Strategic \& Portfolio Management**
* Drive strategic planning and portfolio prioritization, aligning programs with organizational goals and client transformation roadmaps.
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and clients, translating business objectives into executable, outcome\-driven program roadmaps.
* Shape enterprise\-scale program governance structures, risk management frameworks, and escalation mechanisms.


**Financial \& Commercial Governance**
* Own financial governance across program budgeting, forecasting, revenue assurance, and margin optimization.
* Oversee contract execution, including SOW compliance, change management, commercial negotiations, and cross\-vendor dependencies.


**Stakeholder \& Client Management**
* Own client communication at executive and steering committee levels — proactively managing expectations, risks, and escalations.
* Build and sustain trusted relationships with client and internal leadership, serving as the primary point of accountability for program health.


**Generative AI \& Innovation**
* Define and drive enterprise adoption of Generative AI for program governance, predictive risk analysis, intelligent status reporting, and data\-driven decision\-making across delivery portfolios.
* Evaluate and pilot AI\-assisted engineering tools (code generation, automated testing, agentic workflows) to improve delivery velocity and quality across programs.
* Establish responsible AI usage standards within program management practices and mentor delivery teams on effective, scaled adoption.


**Team Leadership**
* Lead, mentor, and develop cross\-functional and matrixed delivery teams, fostering a high\-performance, accountable delivery culture.
* Build organizational capability by coaching program and project managers on governance best practices, technical literacy, and stakeholder management.

**About The Role**
 We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Mainframe Infrastructure Architect to join our dynamic team. This pivotal role will be responsible for providing technical leadership and strategic guidance throughout the presales cycle, focusing on mainframe solutions and modernization initiatives. The ideal candidate will possess deep technical knowledge of mainframe environments, coupled with exceptional communication and presentation skills to articulate complex solutions to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including C\-level executives.

* Solution Design \& Architecture:
+ Lead the design and definition of overall mainframe infrastructure solutionframeworks for mainframe components within client proposals and bids.
