 at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000\+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector \& small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
   

  

**Job Family Definition**
 Responsible for architecting solutions that will achieve customer business outcomes either within a specific technical domain, or across the broader company portfolio (hardware, software, services, and as a service offerings) in combination with all necessary third\-party components (e.g. software and integration). Develops and articulates compelling, accurate, and relevant proposals and ensures customer's business and technical requirements are met. Can be aligned to a specific area of technical expertise (e.g., products, solutions, services). Provides technical expertise to sales teams and customers (through sales presentations, product/solution demonstrations, etc.) aimed at gaining the customer mindshare within their domain. These jobs focus on technical selling to customers/partners. May be aligned to specific accounts based on business priority.
   

  

**Management Level Definition**
 Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross\-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**What you’ll do:**
* Demonstrates in\-depth knowledge in one or more solution domains, company products, services, and solutions as well as the customer’s technical and business environment.
* Develops compelling customer proposals and critically reviews them, manages the expectations of internal stakeholders and customers, ensuring the meeting of customer’s business and technical requirements are met.
* Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long\-term business objectives.
* Provides input to all global business units to address IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.
* Translates outcome\-based solutions into a functional solution design that aligns to the customers business needs, and then translates that functional design into a technical design and architecture that can be scaled to accommodate growth.
* Communicates how the solution value propositions addresses customer business needs.
* Tracks leading\-edge and emerging technologies.
* Contributes to industry development for one or more domains through conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support) and industry events, while also monitoring social media.
* Incorporates an understanding of technology trends within the IT industry, as well as the customer’s industry.
* Actively gathers and applies competitive intelligence as a critical component of account support.
* Drives the Account Business Planning process, leveraging knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.
* Participates in deep\-dive discussions and partners with the account team to build customer relationships at all levels by advocating and presenting technical strategies for a customer's transformation.
* Produces in\-depth comparative analysis of alternative approaches to meet solution requirements.
* Develops, configures, and right sizes an optimal workload solution, balancing cost, scope, scale, boundaries, and benefits to deliver superior value and increase the win rate.
* Leverages deep knowledge of partner products and services and adjusts strategies to leverage the relationship between the service provider/partner and the customer.
* Successfully transfers knowledge to external partners to deliver effective solutions to customers.
* Proactively builds the pipeline by identifying opportunities (e.g., enhancements, unmet or unrecognized needs, up\-selling, and cross\-selling opportunities) within the account.
* Monitors the account pipeline and nurtures active deals from the opportunity to close.
* Uses pipeline insights to help prioritize activities in a way that ensures time, and resources are invested wisely in pursuit of deals with the highest potential.
* Actively participates in sales forecast meetings and provides feedback to accelerate the sales lifecycle.
* Documents ongoing work (activities, tasks) throughout the sales cycle using specific tools and resources and sharing best practices with peers and partners to collaborate more effectively.
* Builds strong professional relationships with customer key executives across the business and industry.
* Proactively shares knowledge with peers and helps develop more junior team members.


**What You Need To Bring**
***Education and Experience:***
* First\-level university technical degree or equivalent technical qualifications. Advanced degree in technology preferred.
* 8–12 years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling
* Knowledge\-based as well as 1\+ experienced\-based relevant industry certifications very strongly preferred.
* Enterprise architecture frameworks and project management methodologies and certifications are helpful, but not required.


**Knowledge And Skills**
* Advanced experience participating in and leading solution configurations and the creation of demos and proofs\-of\-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.
* Advanced understanding of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, adjacent solution domain(s), and how they can be combined to address customer needs.
* Advanced ability to translate aaS and complete ecosystem, differentiated value, solutions, and workloads and ability to prioritize aaS offerings and consumption models that will achieve the customer’s outcomes and greatest return.
* Advanced understanding of aaS business model variations.
* Advanced ability to collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure consistency of output and meet aaS strategic goals.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, and the ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages as needed to perform job requirements.
* Demonstrates advanced discussion and persuasion skills used to support company point\-of\-view, while respectfully questioning and challenging proposed solutions.
* Advanced business and financial acumen—sales cycle, pipeline growth, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage— with an understanding of functional responsibilities of various customer business roles, including typical KPIs important to, CxOs and line\-of\-business (LOB) executives; knowledgeable about TCO/ROI concepts and calculations, financial models, and understand how customers generate revenue.
* Advanced consultative/value selling skills, including, whiteboarding, objection handling, and closing skills to proactively help customers make business decisions.
* Advanced company business knowledge, technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems and tools.
* Advanced resource management skills, including how and when to effectively engage SMEs/specialists.
* Hands on experience with one or more products, solutions, tools, or services aligned to respective job responsibility.
* Ability to design and develop a playbook for demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service.
* Ability to deliver live demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service to customers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Advanced project and time management knowledge or experience with excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills, including appropriate due diligence.
* Advanced knowledge of partner offerings and how/when to leverage them for deals within an area of specialization, understanding of the company's go\-to\-market strategy.
* Advanced understanding of Geo application of company’s go\-to\-market strategy as it relates to partners; has broad knowledge of partner offerings, along with how/when to leverage them for deals.
* Advanced strategic planning and account planning skills, as well as being an expert at using business and technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems.

 HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.
   

  

 Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.
   

  

**What We Can Offer You**
**Health \& Wellbeing**
 We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.
   

  

**Personal \& Professional Development**
 We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.
   

  

**Unconditional Inclusion**
 We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

 **our platforms and customers.**

 We are growing fast, and so are our technical challenges.
 



 We need someone who can simplify systems, make smart technology decisions, and keep our software, infrastructure, and hardware scalable and maintainable. 
 



 This role extends beyond our internal platforms. You'll also work directly with customers through nobleconsul.com, helping organizations evaluate technologies, understand trade\-offs, and develop practical technology strategies that solve real business problems.

* Review existing systems and identify what should be kept, improved, simplified, or removed.
* Prioritize technical work based on business value, impact, cost, and speed.

 to understand their requirements and business goals.
* **Help customers determine what they actually need,** 
 not just what they ask.

* Occasionally get involved in implementation, troubleshooting, and technical delivery.
* Continuously improve internal systems, processes, and automation.
* Keep solutions simple, practical, and effective.

 * **Excellent communication skills in English.**
* **Requires hands\-on experience reviewing the full infrastructure and assessing whether it makes sense.**
* **Hands\-on engineering experience (especially in Linux, LLM, and AI Agent).**
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills.
* Able to evaluate multiple options and explain trade\-offs clearly.
* Experience designing software systems, infrastructure, or cloud solutions.
* Comfortable speaking with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Strong ownership mentality.
* Practical mindset focused on results rather than unnecessary processes.


 Current Technologies
 1. AI Agent orchestrations

 Compensation
 * Base salary.
* Additional commission for customer consultation and successful project engagements.

21f4debf.title: FHIR Integration Architect
21f4debf.description:
**About the Role** 

  
 





 We're building an independent FHIR R4 interoperability layer that lets our CRM's clinical workflows starting with provider launch directly from inside the EHR, beginning with Oracle Health (Cerner) PowerChart. We need someone who can do both halves of this job well: design and personally validate the technical architecture, and lead the engineers full\-stack, AI, and QA who build it. This is not a design\-and\-handoff role. You'll be in the SMART on FHIR launch flow when it breaks, in the code review when a mapping rule is wrong, and in the room when the team needs a call made.
 

  
 




  





**What You'll Own** 

  
 




**Architecture \& Solution Design** 

  
 



* **Own** 

 the end\-to\-end architecture of the FHIR layer — SMART on FHIR launch and OAuth2, the canonical data model, the EMR adapter framework, tenant isolation, and event\-driven orchestration — and keep it extensible to future EMRs (Epic, athenahealth) and formats (HL7v2, X12\) beyond the Cerner pilot.
* **Make** 

 build\-vs\-buy and vendor decisions (self\-hosted HAPI FHIR vs. a managed FHIR store; Keycloak vs. a commercial identity provider; build vs. adopt an interface engine) and can defend the reasoning to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders.
* **Design** 

 the architecture against HIPAA\-grade security and auditability requirements from day one — encryption, least\-privilege access, audit trails — not as a pre\-launch retrofit.
* **Validate** 

 the architecture against real constraints: Oracle Health/Cerner's actual FHIR R4 conformance, US Core and Da Vinci PAS implementation guides, and the operational realities of a live, EHR\-embedded launch — not just a reference diagram.



  





**Technical Leadership \& Delivery** 

  
 



* **Lead** 

 a cross\-functional engineering pod — full\-stack engineers, AI/ML engineers, and QA engineers — setting technical direction, running code and design reviews, and removing blockers day to day.
* **Translate** 

 the solution architecture into a sequenced, phased delivery plan (proof of concept → pilot → multi\-client scale) and hold the team accountable to it.
* **Own** 

 technical risk — surfacing integration blockers, vendor API gaps, and compliance findings early, and driving them to resolution rather than escalating and waiting.



  





**Integration, Standards \& Compliance** 

  
 



* **Lead** 

 the Cerner/Oracle Health integration end to end: SMART App Launch (EHR launch, OAuth2/OIDC, fhirUser claims), Ignite APIs registration, and coordination with the client health system's Cerner administrators.
* **Define and enforce** 

 conformance testing (ONC Inferno, US Core / Da Vinci PAS validation) before any integration is called production\-ready.
* **Partner with** 

 compliance and security stakeholders on HIPAA Security Risk Assessments, BAAs, and audit\-trail requirements.



  





**Required Qualifications** 

  
 



* 8\+ years in healthcare interoperability or integration engineering, including 3\+ years in an architect or technical lead capacity.
* Deep, hands\-on FHIR R4 experience — resource modeling, RESTful FHIR APIs, and at least one implementation guide (US Core at minimum).
* Direct experience implementing SMART App Launch (EHR and/or standalone launch), OAuth2/OIDC, and at least one major EHR's FHIR API — Cerner/Oracle Health experience specifically preferred given Phase 1 scope.
* Hands\-on experience with HAPI FHIR or an equivalent FHIR server — server customization and multi\-tenant partitioning are a strong plus.
* Cloud architecture experience on AWS or equivalent: containers, managed relational databases, event\-driven services (queues/event buses), and core identity/security services.
* Proven experience leading or managing engineers — running reviews, setting direction, and being accountable for a team's delivery, not only your own.
* Working knowledge of healthcare data exchange beyond FHIR — HL7v2, X12, CDA — sufficient to plan for future extensibility.
* Solid understanding of HIPAA technical safeguards and healthcare data compliance requirements.



  





**Strongly Preferred** 

  
 



* Direct, hands\-on experience with Oracle Health (Cerner) Millennium / Ignite APIs and PowerChart SMART app registration — or the Epic App Orchard equivalent.
* Experience with Keycloak or another open\-source identity provider, including custom extension/SPI development.
* Familiarity with Da Vinci implementation guides (PAS, CRD, DTR) and FHIR\-based prior authorization workflows.
* Experience in patient support programs, prior authorization, or healthcare CRM domains.
* Experience standing up a healthcare integration function from near\-zero on a small team, not only operating within an already\-mature enterprise integration group.
* Familiarity with applying AI/ML to healthcare data mapping, document generation, or clinical NLP — relevant given the AI engineers on this team.



  





**Tech Stack You'll Work With** 

  
 




**Layer** 

  
 




**Technologies**

0648357c.title: Associate Manager - Brand Solutions & Client Servicing
0648357c.description:
**About Ampverse DMI** 




  





 Ampverse, Asia’s largest ecosystem of gaming and entertainment communities and IPs, has joined forces with DMI Group in India, forming a strategic joint venture. The primary objective of this partnership is to bolster the esports and gaming ecosystem in the country and create a dedicated platform to nurture and promote college esports talents. Leveraging Ampverse’s expertise in building esports and gaming communities and DMI Finance’s financial prowess, the joint venture aspires to revolutionize the gaming ecosystem in India. They plan to achieve this by developing a series of Gaming IPs including a national collegiate Esports platform, hosting on\-ground activations, forging partnerships with influential gaming figures, and establishing mentorship programs to nurture up\-and\-coming college Esports talent. The first co\-developed IP, College Rivals \- Esports Series was launched in August 2023\. Central to their mission is the idea of fostering inclusivity, diversity, and excellence within the Indian Gaming community. They aim to provide opportunities to a wide range of talents, irrespective of backgrounds or identities, with the goal of empowering the gaming community as a whole. The decision to focus on India is backed by the rapid growth of Gaming within the country as well as the revolutionary growth of the Creator's Economy. 
 



  





**About Rivals** 




  





 Ampverse DMI Rivals is a full\-service, next \-generation marketing agency powered by Ampverse DMI, revolutionising how brands and new\-gen audiences connect in the rapidly expanding and ever\-changing gaming space across Southeast Asia, India, and MENA. Through leveraging 1st party premier gaming media assets, top influencers, and creative talent, Ampverse DMI Rivals drives growth for leading game publishers and global brands such as Garena, Tencent, EA Sports, Coca\-Cola, Nestle, Huawei, Burger King, and Red Bull. Rivals pushes the boundaries of engagement and innovation, shaping the future of brand performance and success.
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a Brand Solutions \& Client Servicing professional who can sit at the intersection of brands, creativity, gaming and execution.
 



 The role will involve understanding client objectives, developing innovative solutions around Ampverse DMI’s gaming and esports IPs, building compelling pitches, and managing client relationships from the initial conversation through execution.
 



 You will work closely with Sales, Marketing, Creative and Esports Operations teams to turn brand objectives into engaging campaigns that connect with gaming and Gen Z audiences.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 




  





**Brand Solutions \& Strategy** 




  




* Develop creative and strategic solutions that align brand objectives with Ampverse DMI’s IPs, esports teams and gaming platforms.
* Understand client objectives, target audiences and brand positioning to develop relevant gaming and esports\-led activation ideas.
* Research brands, categories and market trends to identify potential partnership opportunities and develop customized solutions.
* Create detailed, client\-specific pitch decks that clearly communicate the campaign idea, proposed IP/platform, audience proposition, activation strategy and expected outcomes.
* Develop innovative engagement concepts across gaming, esports, content, creators, events and other relevant platforms.
* Stay updated on emerging trends across gaming, esports, digital media, entertainment and Gen Z culture and translate these trends into actionable opportunities for brands.



  





**Client Servicing \& Relationship Management** 




  




* Act as a key point of contact for clients throughout the campaign lifecycle, from initial discussions through execution and closure.
* Understand client requirements, timelines and expectations and translate them into clear internal briefs.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, agencies and brand stakeholders.
* Lead regular client communication, campaign updates, feedback discussions and status meetings.
* Proactively identify client needs and opportunities for deeper engagement, repeat campaigns and potential upsell/cross\-sell opportunities.
* Ensure timely resolution of client queries and coordinate with internal teams to keep projects on track.
* Manage client expectations while balancing creative ambition, timelines, budgets and operational feasibility.



  





**Cross\-Functional Execution** 




  




* Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Creative and Esports Operations teams to ensure seamless execution of campaigns.
* Coordinate internal stakeholders and ensure that campaign deliverables, timelines and responsibilities are clearly defined.
* Support campaign execution by ensuring the final output remains aligned with the approved client strategy and objectives.
* Track project progress, flag potential risks or delays proactively and drive teams towards timely closure.
* Participate in post\-campaign reviews and use client feedback and campaign learnings to improve future solutions.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 3–6 years of experience in Brand Solutions, Client Servicing, Branded Content, Integrated Marketing, Media, Advertising, Sponsorships or a similar role.
* Strong understanding of brand marketing and client requirements, with the ability to translate business objectives into creative solutions.
* Experience in developing pitch decks, campaign proposals and brand activation concepts.
* Strong client\-facing and relationship\-management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and projects simultaneously.
* Strong communication, presentation and storytelling skills.
* A proactive approach with strong ownership and attention to detail.
* Ability to work collaboratively with creative, sales, marketing and operations teams.
* Strong understanding of digital media, content, gaming, esports and/or youth culture would be an advantage.



  





**Who Would Be a Great Fit?** 




  





 Someone who can move comfortably between strategy, creativity and execution — understanding what a brand wants, figuring out how gaming can help deliver it, pitching the idea convincingly, and then making sure the client has a great experience from pitch to campaign completion. If you're someone who enjoys building ideas, presenting to brands, solving client problems and bringing campaigns to life, we'd love to hear from you.

25106f7a.title: Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) Specialist
25106f7a.description:
### **Job Information**


* Date Opened 09/23/2026
* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Work Experience 5\+ years
* Remote Job
### **Job Description**


This is a remote position.


Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) Specialist  

  

  

Job Details
  

* **Employment Type:** Contract
* **Work Mode:** Remote
* **Location:** Offshore
* **Total Experience Required:** 4 to 7 years
* **Relevant Experience Required:** 3\+ years of dedicated implementation experience with Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
* **Mandatory Certification:** Salesforce Certified Financial Services Cloud Consultant

  

Job Summary
  

We are seeking a **Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC) Specialist** to design, customize, and optimize our institutional financial operations platform. The ideal candidate will bridge institutional financial requirements with native Salesforce architecture, configuring advanced customer wealth profiles, relationship matrices, policy frameworks, and strict regulatory compliance controls.  

  

  

Key Responsibilities
  

* **Configure and customize core FSC data models**, implementing Person Accounts, Financial Accounts, Assets and Liabilities, and Financial Holdings.
* **Map complex relational hierarchies** using Actionable Relationship Maps (ARC) and Householding models to provide a unified Customer 360 view for advisors and agents.
* **Build automated operational workflows** tailored to financial verticals, including client onboarding, mortgage application pipelines, and policy servicing requests.
* **Configure Action Plans and Life Events modules** to automate high\-touch advisor tasks and track critical client milestones dynamically.
* **Implement strict data governance and regulatory compliance layers**, establishing Compliant Data Sharing (CDS) rules to secure sensitive financial records.
* **Design integration touchpoints** between Salesforce FSC and core banking systems, portfolio management tools, insurance engines, or external credit bureaus.
* **Develop declarative automation scripts** via advanced Salesforce Flows while collaborating with programmatic engineers on Apex integrations and Lightning Web Components (LWC).

  

  

  

  

### **Requirements**


* **4 to 7 years** of core Salesforce configuration experience, with **3\+ dedicated years** actively designing and deploying solutions on the Financial Services Cloud (FSC) platform.
* **Strong domain knowledge** of financial verticals, such as retail banking, wealth management, commercial lending, or insurance structures.
* **Deep mastery** of core platform features (Flows, Security Sharing Architecture, Custom Objects) alongside native FSC objects and data packages.
* **Mandatory certification:** Salesforce Certified Financial Services Cloud Consultant.

  

Preferred Qualifications
  

* **Salesforce Certified Sales Cloud Consultant**, **Service Cloud Consultant**, or **Platform App Builder** certification.
* **Prior consulting or enterprise experience** implementing FSC across global multi\-currency institutional environments with complex legal entity boundaries.

**Eaton’s EITC division is currently seeking a Program and Delivery Manager \- AI and Data Delivery.**
**What You’ll Do**
 This position leads the delivery of data and artificial intelligence products for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions. The role owns the portfolio from demand intake through design, build, deployment and adoption, and is accountable for the scope, schedule, cost and quality of every initiative within it. It is a new role, created to give these functions a dedicated delivery leader as the demand for data and AI capability continues to grow.
   

  

 The leader manages the HR, Legal and Corporate Development delivery team and acts as the primary point of contact for functional leadership. Working closely with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security, the role ensures that solutions handling sensitive employee and legal information meet Eaton architecture, privacy and security standards. The position also serves as secondary owner of the AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition process for ideas raised by these functions.
   

  

* Lead end\-to\-end data and artificial intelligence delivery for the HR, Legal and Corporate Development functions, covering demand intake, prioritization, execution, deployment and value realization.
* Own the delivery roadmap and release plan for every product in the portfolio, and hold delivery teams accountable to committed scope, schedule, cost and quality.
* Lead engagement with senior functional stakeholders to identify business priorities, shape demand into fundable initiatives, and secure agreement on outcomes and success measures.

* Act as secondary owner for AI Navigator idea\-to\-disposition for ideas originating in HR, Legal and Corporate Development, ensuring each idea is assessed, dispositioned and tracked to closure.
* Build and manage the financial plan for the portfolio, including annual budget, project and run forecasting, platform consumption, contractor cost control and variance reporting.
* Partner with the System Architect, Enterprise Architecture and Cyber Security so that solutions comply with architecture guardrails, data privacy obligations and information security standards applicable to employee and legal data.
* Establish and operate delivery governance, covering status reporting, risk and issue management, dependency management, change control and steering reviews.
* Drive adoption of Agile delivery practices and improve predictability, cycle time and quality through objective delivery metrics.
* Manage supplier and partner relationships, including statements of work, resource onboarding and performance against agreed service levels.
* Champion organizational change management and user adoption for AI products, and ensure realised benefits are measured and communicated to stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor degree in a technical discipline such as B.E. / B.Tech / MCA, or B.S. in Computer Science, Mathematics or Engineering. A master degree or MBA is preferred.
* 14 or more years of relevant industry experience in information technology delivery.
* 8 or more years leading program or project delivery for data, analytics or application products in a global organization.
* 4 or more years of direct people leadership of engineering teams that include employees and contract resources.


**Skills**
* Project or program management certification such as PMP, PgMP, Scrum Master or SAFe is preferred.
* Experience delivering technology for HR, Legal or Corporate Development functions, including work with confidential employee or legal data, is preferred.
* Working knowledge of data engineering and analytics platforms, including data pipelines, data warehousing and reporting on Microsoft Azure.
* Practical understanding of artificial intelligence and generative AI solution patterns, including large language models, retrieval augmented generation, prompt design and accuracy evaluation.
* Strong command of program and portfolio management disciplines covering scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality and benefits management.
* Experience running Agile delivery at scale using Scrum, Kanban or SAFe, with hands\-on use of Azure DevOps or equivalent tooling.
* Understanding of enterprise application integration, application programming interfaces and workflow automation.
* Familiarity with data privacy, records retention and information security requirements that apply to employee, legal and corporate development data.
* Financial management capability covering budgeting, forecasting, vendor contracting and cost control.
* Executive communication and stakeholder management, with the ability to translate technical work into business outcomes.
* Ability to lead through influence across a matrixed, global organization and across time zones.
* Proven capability in coaching, developing talent and building inclusive, high\-performing teams.
* Structured problem solving and sound decision making in conditions of ambiguity.
* Customer focus, solution orientation and a strong drive for results.


 All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.

386e2b48.description:
**About the Role**
==================


TELUS Digital is launching a company\-wide Net Promoter Score (NPS) program across our Customer Experience, Trust \& Safety, and AI Data Solutions accounts. We are looking for a Senior Program Manager to own this program in its entirety; defining the strategy and operating approach, leading the launch, and driving the insight and action agenda that follows.


This is a senior, high\-ownership role. You will set the direction for how TELUS Digital listens to its clients at scale: shaping the program's design, strategy and governance, aligning operations, commercial, AI, and data teams behind it, owning executive\-level reporting, and converting client feedback into strategies that drive measurable improvement. You will be the recognized owner of the program with significant executive attention, trusted to lead from the front and make the calls that keep it moving.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Own the NPS program end to end, its strategy, operating approach, and governance across CX, Trust \& Safety, and AI accounts, from design and launch through recurring quarterly cycles.
* Define and continuously evolve the program's methodology, survey approach, and roadmap, setting the standard for how TELUS Digital captures and acts on client sentiment at scale.
* Lead and influence cross\-functional teams ie operations, commercial, AI, data, and survey platform. Driving alignment and decision\-making across senior stakeholders rather than simply coordinating execution.
* Own executive engagement and reporting: shape the narrative for senior leadership, lead launch\-window updates, and set the cadence and content of recurring performance reporting.
* Direct the analysis of survey results by identifying the themes that matter, interpret trends, and translate insights into global action plans, holding teams accountable for follow\-through and measurable outcomes.
* Act as the senior point of accountability for commercial and operations primes across all in\-scope accounts, setting expectations for detractor response, response\-rate performance, and client escalation handling.
* Establish and govern the program's operating model, data integrity standards, and documentation, ensuring it is repeatable, auditable, and trusted by leadership.
* Champion automation and AI\-enabled workflows, shaping how technology is leveraged to scale the program, accelerate insight generation, and increase its strategic value over time.
* Anticipate risks and remove blockers proactively, making decisions independently to keep a complex program on track.

**Qualifications \& Experience**
================================

* 8\+ years of experience in program or project management, with a track record of driving execution across complex, multi\-team programs.
* English Level: B1 high or above
* Excellent verbal and written communication, including experience crafting and delivering executive\-level narratives, updates, and presentations.
* Proven experience leading programs or large\-scale projects end to end, ideally in customer experience, insights, operations, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading and influencing cross\-functional teams to drive alignment and decision\-making in a complex, multi\-stakeholder environment.
* Strong analytical judgment, with the ability to turn survey and feedback data into clear strategic insight and action.
* Track record of managing and earning the confidence of senior and executive stakeholders.
* Familiarity with survey and BI tooling and the broader feedback/CRM ecosystem (e.g., AskNicely, Looker, Salesforce, Google Workspace).
* Able to work core **North American business hours**.

**Core Competencies**
=====================


We are seeking a Senior Program Manager who can lead independently and manage stakeholder relationships with confidence. The following competencies are essential:

* Structures ambiguity into clear plans; analyzes data and feedback to surface the themes and actions that matter most.
* Communicates clearly and tailors messaging to the audience and anchors it to clear asks and deadlines.

74d0cf27.title: Associate, Client Solutions
74d0cf27.description:
**Job Title** – Associate, Client Solutions

Associates are the engine driving GLG's Insight Network – the world's largest and most varied source of first\-hand expertise. The Associate role involves fast\-paced communication, working directly as thought partners with leading professionals across industries for client deliverables.



Associates should have a natural curiosity, strong critical thinking skills, and a competitive spirit to win for clients. * Recruiting new experts to join GLG's insight network through targeted lead generation and timely outreach by phone, email, and other methods.

* Collaborating closely with client\-facing team members to expand projects and rescope of recruiting populations to drive successful client outcomes.
* Building your understanding of client strategies, various industry sectors, and value chains to identify and vet the best experts for client projects.
* Learning and upholding our compliance policies and procedures to protect the integrity of client engagements.
* Proactively engaging with GLG's Network Members to understand their expertise and gauge their fitment for client projects.

* Excel in a phone based and highly challenging environment that demands attention to detail and prioritization of various workflows and execution on multiple projects at the same time.

* Develop strong, transferable business skills, including communication, time management, negotiating, problem solving, project management, research and the ability to achieve monthly/quarterly targets.
* Collaborate with colleagues on and across both regional and global teams to contribute to revenue and broader commercial success.
* Mentor future GLG Associates as you become tenured and proficient in your role.


**Ideal Candidates Have**


* Bachelor's degree or higher (required)
* 0\-2 years of work experience in recruitment, internet/market research, outreach, partnership, client\-facing, sales, or account management roles
* Excellent communication skills and fluency in written English
* Confident and strong communication (oral and written), interpersonal \& problem\-solving skills and motivation to work on the phone daily with Network Members and potential recruits.
* Eagerness to learn about new topics, industries, and companies.
* Desire to work in a fast\-paced, collaborative, team environment where we strive to provide an excellent experience for experts and clients.
* Hustle and tenacity to work responsibly and manage multiple, simultaneous tasks and prioritize effectively, given that client priorities shift quickly at GLG.
* High motivation to exceed personal weekly, monthly, and quarterly commercial targets.
* Willingness to work flexible and extended hours (including evenings and some holidays) based on client needs and expectations
* Demonstrate the ability and initiative to handle increasing responsibility over time

 **About GLG / Gerson Lehrman Group**



GLG is the world's leading platform for trusted human expertise. We connect global decision\-makers—from hedge fund managers and private equity partners to strategy leaders at Fortune 500s—with the specific, authoritative voices required to answer their most critical questions.



At GLG, you are an extension of our clients' core teams. You will work at the intersection of industries and global markets, navigating high\-stakes challenges across the full spectrum of their strategic initiatives. Operating within the industry's most trusted research environment, you'll help our clients capture the nuanced perspectives that drive smarter, faster business outcomes.



We are a global team of pragmatic problem\-solvers who mirror the intensity of the markets we serve. If you are driven by intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action, join us in reinventing the industry we invented.



Gerson Lehrman Group, Inc. ("GLG") is an equal opportunity employer and will not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of age, race, religion, color, marital status, disability, gender, national origin, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

b2491c14.title: Technical Program Manager – Infrastructure Engineering
b2491c14.description:
**Role Description**
**Client Job Title: Technical Program Manager – Infrastructure Engineering**
**Who We Are**
 At UST, we help the world’s best organizations grow and succeed through transformation. Bringing together the right talent, tools, and ideas, we work with our client to co\-create lasting change. Together, with over 30,000 employees in over 25 countries, we build for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process. Visit us at UST.com.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As an Infra Engineering TPM you will be the connective tissue between SRE, Platform Developers, Architects, and the broader engineering organization. You will own planning, execution, and communication for infrastructure programs—ensuring work aligns to product priorities and is delivered on time with high quality. You’ll support the Head of Infrastructure to turn strategic priorities into actionable roadmaps and to unblock teams operating in a fast\-moving start\-up environment.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Program leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end technical programs across infrastructure domains (GPU orchestration, cluster management, networking, storage, telemetry, provisioning pipelines).
* Align program scope, milestones, dependencies, success metrics, and delivery timelines.
* Drive program rituals: kickoff, sprint alignment, risk reviews, and postmortems.
* Cross\-team coordination \& stakeholder management
* Proactively support the Head of Infrastructure in setting priorities, sequencing work, meeting coordination, and driving execution across teams.
* Serve as the coordinator within infrastructure organization: SRE, Platform Developers, Architects.
* Proactively surface and manage dependencies, blockers, and risks across teams.
* Communicate program status, trade\-offs, and timelines to the Head of Infrastructure and other stakeholders.


**Delivery and process**
* Manage roadmaps and release plans for multi\-team infrastructure initiatives; work directly with the Head of Infrastructure to align execution with strategic goals and adjust priorities as needed.
* Implement scalable program management practices (OKRs, milestones, RACI, risk logs, SLAs).
* Ensure engineering deliverables meet performance, reliability, security, and cost targets.


**Technical grounding \& decision support**
* Maintain a strong technical understanding of GPU infrastructure, ensure architecture and program decisions align with NVIDIA NCP (NVIDIA Cloud Platform) reference architecture and best practices where applicable — including hardware configurations, networking/topology, telemetry, and security recommendations.
* Facilitate architecture reviews and help translate architecture into executable work for platform engineers and SREs.


**Reliability \& operations enablement**
* Coordinate SRE\-driven reliability initiatives (SLOs, incident response playbooks, SOP).
* Help prioritize reliability work vs. feature work and plan operational runbooks, testing, and rollout strategies.


**Metrics \& continuous improvement**
* Define and track key KPIs (uptime, mean time to recovery, provisioning latency).
* Use data to drive prioritization and continuous improvement cycles.


**Requirements Minimum**
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of technical program management experience at an infrastructure\- or platform\-oriented organization (start\-up experience strongly preferred).
* Strong technical background with hands\-on familiarity in at least one of: GPU compute stacks, Kubernetes, cluster orchestration, or cloud infrastructure.
* Demonstrated experience coordinating across SRE, platform engineering, and architecture teams to deliver complex multi\-quarter programs.
* Proven track record of delivering projects with multiple engineering teams and external dependencies.
* Excellent written and verbal communication—able to summarize technical trade\-offs and program status for executive stakeholders.
* Strong organizational skills: roadmaps, dependency mapping, risk management, and prioritization.
* Data\-driven: experience defining, monitoring, and improving KPIs and SLAs.
* Comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change in a start\-up environment.
* Experience with incident management, postmortems, and on\-call processes.


**Nice\-to\-haves**
* Direct experience with GPU orchestration tools (Device Plugin, MIG, NCCL, CUDA drivers), Kubernetes GPU scheduling frameworks, or custom scheduler implementations.
* Experience with on\-prem/cloud deployments.
* Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code, CI/CD, and observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
* Prior experience at a GPU\-focused company, ML infrastructure team, or HPC environment.


**What We Believe**
 We’re proud to embrace the same values that have shaped UST since the beginning. Since day one, we’ve been building enduring relationships and a culture of integrity. And today, it's those same values that are inspiring us to encourage innovation from everyone to champion diversity and inclusion and to place people at the centre of everything we do.

 We will listen, learn, be empathetic and help selflessly in our interactions with everyone.
   

  

**Humanity:** 
 Through business, we will better the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves.
   

  

**Integrity:** 
 We honour our commitments and act with responsibility in all our relationships.
   

  

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**
 UST is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We believe that no one should be discriminated against because of their differences, such as age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender identity and expression, religion, or sexual orientation. All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, colour, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. UST reserves the right to periodically redefine your roles and responsibilities based on the requirements of the organization and/or your performance.
   

  

* To support and promote the values of UST.
* Comply with all Company policies and procedures

a0ea95b7.title: Staff Technical Program Manager

We are fueled by a moral imperative to advance mankind, and it all begins with our people, our product, and our purpose. Passion isn’t something we turn on and off; it’s woven into everything we do. If you thrive in high\-challenge environments, are inspired by exceptional teammates, and are driven to grow beyond what you thought possible, MX is where you belong.
   

  

 Come build the future with us. Join an award\-winning company that isn’t just shaping the financial industry, but transforming it in ways that create meaningful, lasting impact for millions of people.

 We are looking for a strong program leader and strategic operator who can autonomously execute complex enterprise initiatives in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. You will wear multiple hats (Technical Program Manager, Agile Coach, Process Designer, Storyteller, and Systems Thinker) to drive critical Financial Product initiatives at MX while partnering with engineering and product leadership to align on high\-impact outcomes and scalable architectures.
   

  

 From day one, you will influence both product strategy and technical execution to help us build and improve our platform while scaling the organization itself. You will bring expertise in best\-in\-class frameworks for work intake, prioritization, SDLC optimization, team management, and decision\-making, along with the ability to navigate technical trade\-offs, increase developer velocity, and create clarity across ambiguous problems.
   

  

 If you are a creative problem\-solver with a passion for optimizing processes, scaling businesses through analytical and general management skills, and building through sane, compassionate collaboration, this role is for you.
   

  

****Responsibilities****
* Program Leadership \& Delivery: Communicate goals, roles, and outcomes; drive delivery on time, within scope, and on budget. Own performance, scalability, and reliability targets for releases. Manage multiple simultaneous initiatives with time\-sensitive constraints. Demonstrate financial acumen in budget planning, resource allocation, and P\&L awareness.
* Requirements \& Strategic Planning: Translate high\-level business needs into actionable technical roadmaps and API contracts. Develop program\-level and product/technology roadmaps that align cross\-functional dependencies. Inform executive decisions with data\-backed resource and risk analysis.
* Risk, Transparency, \& Governance: Establish proactive risk detection frameworks using RAID logs and mitigation strategies. Track and publish program health dashboards, including executive summaries and detailed drill\-downs. Drive data\-informed decision reviews and OKR/KPI governance.

Simplify complex challenges into pragmatic plans and tell compelling program narratives that align diverse stakeholders. Navigate matrixed\-management environments with empathy and influence.

Mentor teams on software delivery best practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Waterfall). Facilitate technical design reviews and partner on architectural trade\-offs between scalability and speed\-to\-market. Lead structured change rollouts and drive adoption. Develop and coach technical program managers to elevate the TPM discipline across the organization.
* Tools \& Systems Mastery: Establish Atlassian Suite governance and drive best practices in Jira Software, JPD, and JSM. Create data visualizations that translate complex information for executive and team audiences. Identify and implement AI\-assisted automation to increase team efficiency in reporting, insights generation, and documentation, while staying current on emerging workflows.


****Qualifications****
* 10\+ years of Technical Program Management experience leading large\-scale software delivery in a New Product Development environment.
* 3\+ years of experience leading or mentoring other technical program managers.
* Proven track record of managing end\-to\-end SDLC for complex distributed systems.
* Atlassian Suite expertise, ideally having served as a global administrator.
* Expertise in the Scrum framework, with a proven track record of scaling and tailoring agile practices to an organization's maturity level to drive engineering velocity and sprint health.
* Comfort operating in high\-ambiguity environments with rapidly evolving priorities.
* Strong bias toward action, with the ability to unblock teams autonomously and make decisions with incomplete information.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across matrixed teams and build trust with peers at all levels.
* Proven ability to rapidly absorb and synthesize complex technical information, allowing for deep engagement in architectural discussions.


****Advanced Requirements (Optional)****
* Experience with personal financial management or wealth management tools.
* Experience managing AI/ML product development and deployment.
* Ability to navigate technical ambiguity and resolve blockers during zero\-to\-one builds.
* Systems\-thinking mindset with experience in long\-term technical strategy and tech debt reduction.
* Analytical skills to utilize engineering metrics for decision\-making and product insights.
* Bias toward building automated inspection mechanisms and technical governance processes.
* 3\+ years of direct experience in a technical role (SWE, SRE, DevOps, or Systems Architect).
* Experience leading systemic change management within an engineering organization.
* PMP and CSM certifications.


**Compensation**
 The expected earnings for this role could be comprised of a base salary and other forms of cash compensation, such as bonus or commissions as applicable.
   

  

 This pay range is just one component of MX’s total rewards package. MX takes a number of factors into account when determining individual starting pay, including job and level they are hired into, location, skillset, peer compensation.
   

  

* Please note applicants applying for this position must have the legal right to work in India without the need for sponsorship. We are unable to provide work sponsorship for this role, and candidates should be able to verify their eligibility to work in the country independently. Proof of eligibility to work in India will be required as part of the hiring process.


**Work Environment**
 In this role, a significant aspect of the job involves working in the office for a standard 40\-hour workweek. We believe that the collaborative nature of our work and the face\-to\-face interactions among team members are essential for fostering a dynamic and productive work environment. Being present in the office enables seamless communication, facilitates quick decision\-making, and encourages spontaneous collaboration that contributes to the overall success of our projects. We value the synergy that comes from having our team members physically together, allowing for immediate problem\-solving, idea exchange, and team building.

73c90107.title: Senior Technical Program Manager II (PMO)
73c90107.description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future
   

  

**Job Description**
**Strategic Mandate**
 As the Technical Program Manager (Associate) for Data \& AI Platforms, you sit at the delivery interface between Nielsen's Databricks\-based Data Platform and AI/Data Engineering teams and the stakeholders who build on them — internal consumers such as Finance, HR, Product, Analytics, and Data Science, as well as external partners, vendors, and clients involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives. You understand the platform well enough to read its dependencies: Unity Catalog access gates, Delta Lake/DLT pipeline sequencing, compute and governance constraints. You translate those technical realities into program plans, risk registers, and status reporting that keep every initiative leveraging the platform moving — tracked, unblocked, and visible to leadership
   

  

**Core Goals \& Responsibilities**
* Technical Program Coordination: Coordinate delivery of initiatives that depend on the Databricks Lakehouse — Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, and Databricks Workflows — translating technical dependencies, sequencing, and architecture decisions into program plans and risk registers.
* Agile Delivery Cadence: Run Agile/Scrum or Kanban ceremonies (planning, standups, retros) across initiatives to keep delivery cadence consistent.
* Technical Stakeholder Liaison: Partner directly with the Data Platform Lead, the Lead Data and AI Engineer, and Architecture to understand platform capabilities and constraints (compute, governance, cost), and represent them accurately to consumer stakeholders.
* External Stakeholder \& Vendor Coordination: Coordinate with external parties involved in AI and Data Engineering initiatives — technology vendors (e.g., Databricks), system integrators, data partners, and consumer stakeholders — aligning on scope, timelines, technical interfaces, and data\-sharing or contractual milestones.
* Technical Risk \& Dependency Management: Maintain a technical RAID log capturing platform\-level risks (e.g., Unity Catalog access blockers, compute capacity limits, governance sign\-off delays) and drive resolution across engineering and business teams.
* Release \& Readiness Coordination: Coordinate technical readiness activities — environment provisioning, access/governance approvals, CI/CD release windows — for initiatives going live on the platform.
* Technical Reporting \& Governance Cadence: Translate engineering status (sprint burndown, pipeline health, platform incidents) into program\-level status reports and steering committee materials that non\-technical stakeholders can act on.
* Change \& Technical Adoption Support: Support rollout of new platform and AI capabilities (e.g., emerging Databricks Genie or AI features) by coordinating technical enablement sessions, documentation, and stakeholder readiness.
* Post\-Implementation Review: Facilitate post\-implementation reviews and retrospectives after major rollouts, capturing lessons learned and feeding continuous\-improvement actions back into the program.
* Process \& Tooling Discipline: Own PMO tooling (Jira, Confluence) configured to reflect technical workflows — epics and stories mapped to pipelines, environments, and governance gates — not just generic task tracking


**Qualifications**
**Expertise \& Technology Stack**
* Core Experience: 6\+ years coordinating technical programs or projects, ideally within AI/Data engineering, platform, or cloud environments.
* Platform Technical Fluency: Working knowledge of data platform architecture concepts — Databricks Lakehouse, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, core Spark concepts, and CI/CD — sufficient to read architecture docs, follow technical design discussions, and ask informed questions.
* AI/GenAI Literacy: Familiarity with GenAI/AI enablement concepts (LangChain, vector databases, Databricks Genie) to coordinate initiatives that leverage them.
* Technical Delivery Tooling: Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and Smartsheet, including engineering\-adjacent artifacts like burndown/velocity charts, dependency maps, and technical RAID logs.
* Technical Communication: Ability to translate between engineering language (architecture, dependencies, technical debt) and business language (timelines, risk, value) for varied stakeholders.
* Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify technical dependencies and risks across concurrent initiatives and know when and how to escalate them.
* Vendor \& External Partner Coordination: Experience coordinating with external vendors, system integrators, or data partners on technical delivery timelines, contractual milestones, and statement\-of\-work (SOW) tracking


**Additional Information**
**Requirements \& Qualifications**
* Experience: 6\+ years in a Technical Program/Project Management, technical PMO, or technical business analyst role, preferably supporting data, cloud, or platform engineering initiatives.
* Education/Certification:
* Required: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* Preferred: PMP, CAPM, or a Scrum/Agile certification.
* Communication: A "Bottom Line Up Front" (BLUF) communication style. You must be comfortable participating in technical design discussions as well as business stakeholder updates, and translating clearly between the two.


 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

a54ff544.title: Senior Presales Engineer
a54ff544.description:
The Role
 



  





 We are seeking a Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer to serve as the technical backbone of our enterprise sales efforts. You will partner closely with Account Executives to drive complex, high\-value AI opportunities from qualification through to close – translating capabilities into compelling, customer\-specific solutions. This is a highly visible role that demands both deep technical expertise and the ability to communicate confidently at every level, from hands\-on IT architects to C\-suite executives.
 



  





 What You’ll Do
 



  




* Act as the technical lead throughout the sales cycle, partnering with Account Executives to drive enterprise opportunities from qualification to close.
* Develop and maintain a strong perspective on how AI – including large language models, agentic architectures, and RAG\-based solutions – can drive measurable business value across verticals and functions.
* Understand customer pain points in adopting and implementing AI solutions, and position as the trusted partner to address them.
* Deliver compelling technical presentations and demos showcasing GenAI, Agentic AI, RAG, and LLM\-based capabilities tailored to each prospect’s context.
* Build and deliver custom demos and proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) to validate business value and technical feasibility.
* Conduct discovery sessions with key business and technical stakeholders to uncover needs, pain points, and desired outcomes.
* Translate business requirements into AI solution architectures that leverage Uniphore’s capabilities, collaborating closely with product and engineering teams.
* Respond to RFPs and RFIs with detailed technical responses and well\-reasoned solution designs.
* Advise clients on AI adoption strategies, integration with multi\-modal data platforms, and industry best practices.
* Share market intelligence and competitive insights with the wider team to sharpen our regional go\-to\-market approach.
* Contribute to a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, and continuous innovation.
* Build and maintain deep expertise in AI trends, competitor offerings, and the evolving landscape of agentic and enterprise AI adoption.



  





 What We’re Looking For
 



  




* Minimum 10 years of experience in pre\-sales, solution engineering, or technical consulting – preferably within enterprise SaaS, AI, or automation platforms.
* Hands\-on understanding of AI concepts including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), prompt engineering, Agentic AI architectures, AI security and governance, and ethical AI.
* Experience designing or selling AI platforms, data orchestration, or enterprise automation solutions.
* Demonstrated expertise in major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including core services such as compute, storage, networking, and serverless functions, particularly as they relate to deploying and scaling enterprise AI and SaaS solutions.
* Practical experience with API integration and security: designing, integrating, and securing API connections between AI platforms and business applications (e.g., CRM, ERP, data warehouses), with knowledge of protocols (REST, GraphQL) and authentication mechanisms (OAuth 2\.0, API keys).
* Data and network architecture acumen – ability to discuss and propose solutions around data governance, network segmentation, and enterprise security when deploying cloud\-native or hybrid AI solutions.
* Strong ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences, from technicians to C\-suite executives.
* Proven track record supporting enterprise sales cycles and contributing to the close of large, multi\-stakeholder deals.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills with confidence at all levels of a large enterprise.
* Strong problem\-solving and storytelling skills – able to connect AI capabilities to strategic business outcomes.
* Familiarity with one or more of priority sectors – banking and financial services, media and telecom, retail and CPG, government, or energy and utilities – is a strong advantage.
* Ability to travel as needed for client engagements.

716e7da0.description:
**About Jade Global:** 




 Jade Global is seeking a seasoned ServiceNow Presales \& Solution Lead to drive the technical scoping, architectural design, and ultimate closure of enterprise\-scale opportunities within our Enterprise Service Management (ESM) practice. This is a strategic, client\-facing leadership position designed for an expert practitioner who can seamlessly bridge complex business problems with cutting\-edge ServiceNow platform architecture.
 



  





 The ideal candidate will be responsible for leading high\-impact technical presales engagements, architecting multi\-workflow solutions, owning rigorous effort scoping/SOW development, and cultivating critical ServiceNow alliance relationships. This leader will carry a personal bookings/pipeline conversion quota and will serve as the primary authority on aligning customer business outcomes with ServiceNow capabilities.

**Technical Pre\-Sales \& Pipeline Conversion** 



* Lead complex discovery workshops, executive technical presentations, and deeply tailored solution demonstrations to uncover customer pain points and define future\-state architectures.
* Engage C\-suite executives (CIO, CTO, COO, CFO) on digital transformation roadmaps, articulating the value of platform consolidation, AI\-enabled service management, and hyper\-automation.

* Serve as the primary domain expert during high\-value sales cycles, effectively neutralizing competitor technical objections and proving Jade Global’s superior technical execution capabilities.

* Own the end\-to\-end technical solutioning process for complex, multi\-module ServiceNow pursuits, including architectural blueprints and integration ecosystems.

* Govern the transition from sales to implementation, conducting thorough technical handoffs to Delivery and Practice teams to ensure customer expectations are perfectly executed.



  





**ServiceNow Alliance \& Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Cultivate deep technical and co\-sell alignment with ServiceNow field sales, solution architects, and partner enablement managers to accelerate pipeline growth.
* Represent Jade Global’s technical prowess at premier ServiceNow ecosystem events, including Knowledge, partner forums, and executive roundtables.
* Unlock referral and co\-sell opportunities by demonstrating deep domain expertise to ServiceNow account teams, positioning Jade as the go\-to delivery partner for complex workflows.



  





**Qualifications \& Experience Required** 



* 12–15\+ years of progressive experience in IT consulting, enterprise solution architecture, or technical presales, with a minimum of 6–8 years dedicated exclusively to the ServiceNow platform.
* Deep architectural mastery across the full scope of ServiceNow workflows, specifically ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM/SecOps, WSD and other modules of ServiceNow with platform features like Now Assist / Movework / Creator Workflows.

* Active ServiceNow Certifications: Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in core modules, Certified Application Developer (CAD), or Certified Technical Architect (CTA) / Certified Master Architect (CMA).
* Vertical Expertise: Proven experience solutioning for complex regulatory or operational environments like Healthcare \& Life Sciences, Manufacturing, High Tech, or Financial Services.

**Success Metrics** 



* Achieve assigned ESM pipeline contribution and closed\-won bookings quota.
* Maximize technical win\-rates on critical, highly competitive RFPs and enterprise proposals.
* Expand the Jade Global co\-sell pipeline via proactive collaboration with ServiceNow technical and account field teams.
* Maintain high estimation accuracy, ensuring scoped deals transition smoothly into profitable, on\-time delivery executions.

**vConstruct**, a Pune\-based Construction Technology company is seeking an Associate Data Architect for its AI Engineering team, a close\-knit group of analysts and engineers supporting all data aspects of the business. You will work closely with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, architects, and business teams to design solutions that integrate and organize data from various sources, enabling business insights, analytics, and AI use cases.  

**Responsibilities*** Provide technical leadership for the end\-to\-end architecture and design of scalable, high\-performance enterprise data platforms, pipelines, and data solutions aligned with enterprise architecture principles and data engineering best practices.
* Define and evolve enterprise data architecture, including conceptual, logical, and physical data models, ensuring consistency and interoperability across business domains and source systems.
* Design architecture for complex data integration workflows involving structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data across cloud, SaaS, and on\-premises environments.
* Define reusable architectural patterns and standards for real\-time, batch, and on\-demand data integration, including observability, monitoring, alerting, scalability, and automated error handling.
* Partner with data engineers, analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to design reliable data models and semantic structures that support analytics, reporting, AI/ML, and enterprise data products.
* Establish data architecture standards for data quality, metadata management, lineage, security, governance, retention, and lifecycle management across enterprise data platforms.
* Collaborate with platform, DevOps, security, and enterprise architecture teams to design secure, reusable, and CI/CD\-enabled data solutions aligned with enterprise technology standards.
* Define and enforce architectural and engineering best practices for source control, development standards, testing automation, deployment, performance optimization, and maintainability of data solutions.
* Lead architecture and design reviews for critical data initiatives, identifying architectural risks, technical dependencies, scalability concerns, and opportunities for platform simplification and reuse.
* Evaluate data technologies, integration approaches, and platform capabilities, and provide recommendations based on scalability, performance, security, maintainability, cost, and business requirements.
* Create and maintain detailed architecture documentation, including data architecture diagrams, data models, data flows, integration patterns, reference architectures, and technical design specifications.
* Lead discussions with business, engineering, and technology teams to understand data requirements, translate business needs into scalable architecture, prioritize initiatives, and contribute to the enterprise data platform strategy and roadmap.


**Qualifications*** 10 to 12 years of hands\-on experience in data engineering\-related roles, with demonstrated experience in designing and architecting large\-scale, production\-grade data platforms and enterprise data models.

 Job Description: Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer Role (BMS \& Fire Systems)
   

  

 We are looking for a professional with a minimum of 15 years of experience in Building Management Systems (BMS) and Fire Alarm Systems (FAS). The candidate must have an Associate Degree in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering.
   

  

 This role will be based in India, providing pre\-sales engineering support to regional teams, with close collaboration with local country experts for site\-specific, regulatory, and commercial inputs.
   

  

 The role of a Senior Pre\-Sales Engineer involves the following responsibilities:
   

  

* Conducting both preliminary and detailed pre\-sales engineering to assess project suitability, understand requirements, and quantify scope for BMS and Fire Alarm tenders, including service, retrofit (A\&A), and system migration projects
* Reviewing tender documents, site information, and available as\-built drawings to identify system requirements, HVAC equipment, fire alarm systems, field devices, and interface points
* Reviewing sequence of operations and fire cause \& effect, identifying gaps in specifications related to I/O summary and system requirements
* Preparing key deliverables such as RFIs, equipment summaries, data point schedules, loop/device schedules, and bills of material, including:
* Selection and sizing of BMS devices (sensors, valves, actuators, controllers)
* Selection and configuration of fire alarm systems (detectors, modules, panels – e.g., Sinteso EN)
* Definition of system interfaces and licenses
* Developing BMS and Fire system architecture, including integration with existing and third\-party systems
* Producing technical compliance statements aligned with project specifications
* Working closely with local country experts to:
* Validate local fire code and regulatory compliance
* Incorporate actual site conditions and operational constraints
* Define scope boundaries and interfaces with other systems
* Supporting cost development by:
* Structuring and defining scope packages for subcontractors and suppliers
* Working with local teams, who will engage subcontractors and obtain budgetary quotations for relevant portions of the works
* Consolidating technical scope and cost inputs into the overall solution
* Recognising that supplier and subcontractor coordination, including quotation requests and commercial engagement, will be led by local country teams
* Identifying and mitigating technical and operational risks (e.g., legacy systems, live environment constraints), while capturing opportunities during tendering
* Preparing accurate project cost estimates, considering site constraints, phasing, and migration strategy
* Performing thorough quality checks on all deliverables prior to submission


**The Candidate Should Possess The Following Skills And Knowledge**
* Strong knowledge of BMS, HVAC (ACMV), Electrical systems, and Fire Alarm Systems
* Understanding of fire system design principles, including cause \& effect, zoning, and fail\-safe operation
* Ability to work in a regional support model, collaborating effectively with local teams responsible for site validation, authority compliance, and supplier coordination
* Excellent communication, problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Understanding of basic instrumentation and control loops
* Ability to interpret single line diagrams, fire schematics, and floor plans (including incomplete as\-built drawings)
* Knowledge of BACnet, Modbus, M\-Bus, KNX, and system integration interfaces
* Proficiency in MS Office, Bluebeam, and AutoCAD/Groundplan tools
* Knowledge of Revit and BIM will be an added advantage
* Additional knowledge in IT networking, cybersecurity, and industry compliance practices is advantageous
* Experience in service/retrofit environments or regional/global project support will be an added advantage.


 This role is based in Chennai, where you’ll get the chance to work with teams impacting entire cities, countries – and the shape of things to come.
