3bb1511c.title: Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)
3bb1511c.description:
Hi,

Hope you are doing well. My name is Chandrika, and I’m reaching out from Engineering Square — an IT consulting and outsourcing company that helps businesses find the right tech talent quickly.

Please take a look at the job description below. If it looks like a good fit for you, just reply with your updated resume and your expected salary.

Salesforce Tech Lead — Lending, Experience Cloud and Integrations (Offshore)

Delivery leadership · Experience Cloud partner portals · Consumer lending on Salesforce · Salesforce ↔ NetSuite integration · Offshore

ABOUT ENGINEERING SQUARE

Engineering Square LLC is a Fremont, California–based enterprise consulting firm delivering Salesforce, integration, and AI engineering for US enterprise clients. Our engineers embed directly with client teams — their tools, their ceremonies — with E2 engagement management and a named backup behind every seat.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Lead the offshore pod supporting a US solar manufacturer and its consumer\-financing affiliate. This is a full\-time Engineering Square role placed with the client. You own the solution design within the client's architecture across two Salesforce orgs, run code review and release discipline, and act as the pod's day\-to\-day coordination point with the client's delivery leads — daily standups, work tracked on the client's boards, and a modern CI/CD pipeline. The strongest signal we are hiring for is a lead who has shipped an Experience Cloud partner portal end to end, has led delivery on Salesforce in a lending business, and has owned an ERP integration — and who still writes Apex and LWC on the hardest stories.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Own the design: own the solution design and integration architecture within the client's landscape across both orgs — cross\-org integration, shared partner data, and one\-way data hand\-offs built on custom objects alongside the managed lending package, never inside it

Lead the Experience Cloud portal work: partner and customer sites — self\-registration and onboarding, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing, federated login, LWC and page development; set the portal standards the developers build to

Lead the lending\-platform build: application intake, status visibility, document and e\-signature steps on the origination platform; design the post\-origination processes — funding, disbursement and servicing hand\-off — on custom objects alongside the managed package

Own the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration: the lead backlog item — customer/account, product and pricing sync; opportunity → sales order; invoice and payment status back\-sync; reconciliation of Salesforce, ERP and warehouse data. Own the design, the error handling, retries, idempotency and monitoring

Design partner APIs with monitoring: externally consumed APIs for installer and channel partners, with authentication, versioning, logging, alerting and replay built in from the first release

Run code review and release discipline: lead code reviews; hold the release checklist; enforce unit\-test coverage, PMD static analysis and Confluence design notes and runbooks; nothing ships without QA sign\-off

Mentor the pod: set the pod's engineering standard; mentor the senior developer and the developer; run the E2 round\-1 technical screen for new pod members

Be the coordination point with the client: join the client's daily standup inside the overlap window; report status, risks and the coming week's plan directly to client stakeholders — business, product and platform owners; send the Friday written summary; raise risks early, never late

CONTEXT YOU WILL WORK IN

Two Salesforce orgs. The manufacturer runs a Sales, Service and Experience Cloud org with an installer partner portal (self\-registration, knowledge, support). Its consumer\-financing affiliate runs a separate org on a Salesforce\-native loan and lease origination managed package, with its own installer partner portal (login federated to an external identity provider). Around both sit NetSuite (ERP — the Salesforce ↔ NetSuite quote\-to\-cash integration is the lead backlog item), Snowflake (financing and credit\-risk analytics), an AWS integration layer (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS) and an integration platform. Work spans both orgs: cross\-org integration, shared partner data, one\-way data hand\-offs alongside the managed package.

MUST\-HAVE SKILLS

Experience Cloud — partner portals: has implemented at least one Experience Cloud partner portal end to end — site build (LWR or Aura), self\-registration and onboarding flow, sharing and guest\-user security, partner user licensing. Candidates who have shipped a partner portal go to the top of the list

Lending domain: Salesforce in financial services or consumer lending — origination lifecycle, borrower and partner (dealer / installer) journeys

Loan\-origination package: hands\-on with a Salesforce\-native loan/lease origination managed package. Q2 Cloud Lending / Symphonix experience strongly preferred

Delivery leadership: has led a delivery team of engineers on at least one client\-facing Salesforce implementation — owned the solution design, ran code review and releases, and was accountable to the client for the outcome; has owned the integration on at least one ERP\-connected implementation

Salesforce core: Apex, LWC, Flows, SOQL, asynchronous Apex, Platform Events; Named Credentials; Salesforce CDC, Bulk and Streaming APIs; hands\-on on the hardest stories

APIs and integrations: REST, GraphQL and SOAP; API design — contracts, versioning, auth, error semantics; an integration platform of the Workato / MuleSoft / Boomi class; AWS Lambda, API Gateway and SQS

NetSuite integration (hands\-on): SuiteTalk (REST/SOAP) or RESTlets; quote\-to\-cash and order\-to\-cash object flows between Salesforce and NetSuite

Snowflake and data reconciliation (hands\-on): Salesforce CDC or batch extraction into Snowflake; reconciling platform data against ERP and finance

Delivery tooling: SFDX, Git, GitHub Actions CI/CD, PMD; release checklists; Jira and Confluence

Communication: camera\-on meetings, direct stakeholder communication in clear English; written status a client can act on; raises risks early, never late; works the US business calendar and US federal holidays

Experience: 8\+ years on the Salesforce platform, including tech\-lead experience running a delivery team and hands\-on delivery on at least one lending or portal\-heavy implementation

NICE TO HAVE

Portal login federated to an external identity provider (OIDC / SAML single sign\-on for Experience Cloud users); multi\-org or org\-consolidation experience

Sales, Service and Financial Services Cloud breadth; Einstein and Agentforce; AI\-assisted engineering workflows on masked or synthetic data only

Event\-driven architecture — Kafka or Azure Event Hubs; AWS S3 and Step Functions

Solar\-financing, renewable\-energy or fintech domain; prior work with US enterprise clients from offshore

CERTIFICATIONS

Required: Salesforce Platform Developer I

Preferred: Platform Developer II and Integration Architect; Experience Cloud Site Consultant; Application Architect a plus

Pay: ₹24,683\.02 \- ₹108,778\.66 per month

Work Location: On the road

 OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. **AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.**
 At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
   

  

**Your Impact**
 An OpenText Content Server Cloud Support Specialist is responsible for the technical delivery of the CS (Content Server) Platform based solutions. This role has administration emphasis, combined with the consultative skills required to promote the impression of quality and excellence actively fostered within the Customer Success Services.

The nature of work may include supporting full application lifecycle activities right from development, deployment/provisioning, testing, migration, decommissioning and ongoing run \& maintain (upgrades, patching etc.) support of the cloud deployments.

**What The Role Offers**

* Participate in the day to day administration of the systems, including Incident \& Problem Management
* Participate in execution of new implementations, upgrades and patching activities.
* Participate in the advanced configuration of CS software components, in line with project and customer time scales.
* To co\-ordinate project delivery through multiple teams that may include 3rd party suppliers, partners and client resources.

* Actively use and contribute to the project management standards and quality checks used within OpenText Cloud Services.

* Prepare, maintain and submit activity/progress reports and time recording/management reports in accordance with published procedures. Keep project managers informed of activities and alert of any issues promptly. Provide inputs as part of engagement closure on project learnings and suggest improvements
* Manage expectations and responsibilities for all client and internal stakeholders.

GEMBA CONCEPTS
   

  

* TECHNOLOGY DIVISION
* JOB DESCRIPTION


 Technical Delivery Manager – Services LOCATION Bengaluru (Hybrid) ABOUT GEMBA CONCEPTS EXPERIENCE 5–8 years REPORTS TO Chief Technology Officer TYPE Full\-time Gemba Concepts helps manufacturers and enterprises improve how their operations run. Our technology division builds and runs Gemba Connect, a suite of enterprise SaaS products spanning warehouse management, logistics, ERP, and applied AI/ML, deployed across 30\+ active client accounts in manufacturing, pharma, FMCG and retail.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for a technical leader to own Gemba's services business end to end: delivery, people, commercials and reporting. You'll run every client implementation and custom development engagement, build and manage the team that delivers them, and be the single point of accountability to clients and leadership for how services perform. You've written production Java code, can read a Spring Boot service and a SQL execution plan, and have since hired, reviewed and led delivery teams. The product roadmap stays with product leadership; everything we deliver to clients runs through you.
   

  

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN Services Business Ownership**
* Own the health of the services portfolio: delivery, client satisfaction, billing milestones and account growth.
* Run post\-sale SOW execution. Ensure milestones are hit and billed on time, and follow up with finance and clients on receivables.
* Grow accounts by converting change requests and enhancements into scoped, priced, billable work.
* Track effort, utilisation and margin by account; act when an engagement turns unprofitable. Delivery
* Run multiple concurrent client implementations, owning scope, timeline, cost and quality.
* Plan and run sprints with Tech Leads: grooming, estimation, capacity planning, reviews and retros.
* Own go\-lives (UAT, cutover, data migration, hypercare) and post\-go\-live support SLAs.
* Maintain RAID logs and delivery dashboards; flag risk early, with a proposed fix. Requirements and change control
* Be the single intake point between consulting teams, clients and engineering; convert requirements into user stories with testable acceptance criteria.
* Baseline scope and run a formal change\-request process. Every change is priced in effort, cost and date before it's accepted.
* Make sure what's agreed is documented before it's built. People and hiring
* Plan services headcount against the delivery pipeline and run hiring end to end (role definition, interviews, closing) at a high bar.
* Run goal\-setting, regular 1:1s and performance reviews for the services team; give input on promotions, compensation and performance plans.
* Grow Tech Leads and senior engineers into people who can own accounts independently.
* Own team retention and morale. Know who's at risk before they resign. Gemba Concepts
* Technology Division Page 1GEMBA CONCEPTS
* TECHNICAL DELIVERY MANAGER – SERVICES Reporting
* Publish monthly services MIS to leadership: revenue billed, collections, on\-time delivery, SLA adherence, utilisation, hiring and attrition.
* Contribute the services section to quarterly board reporting.
* Run monthly or quarterly business reviews with key client stakeholders. Technical oversight
* Work with Tech Leads on design reviews, integrations (ERP, WMS, third\-party systems) and non\-functional requirements.
* Lead incident triage and root\-cause reviews on client escalations; track corrective actions to closure.
* Coordinate with DevOps on environments, CI/CD and release windows.
* Uphold security and compliance controls (e.g., SOC 2\) across delivery. Improving how we deliver
* Drive adoption of AI\-assisted development and testing tools, and measure whether they actually raise throughput per engineer.
* Tighten estimation accuracy, definition of done and release discipline across the services team. MUST\-HAVES
* 5–8 years in software, including 2\+ years as a hands\-on Java developer and 2\+ years in delivery or project management.
* 1\+ year leading a team of 5\+ directly, including hiring and performance reviews.
* Strong working knowledge of Java and Spring Boot. You can review a PR, understand how a service is structured, and challenge an estimate.
* Solid SQL: schema design, writing and debugging queries, and understanding of indexing, transactions and production issues such as slow queries and connection pool exhaustion (SQL Server/Azure SQL, PostgreSQL or MySQL).
* Hands\-on exposure to cloud platforms (Azure preferred, AWS/GCP acceptable).
* Working experience with the commercial side of client engagements: SOWs, milestone billing and change orders. Margin tracking is a plus.
* Track record of delivering enterprise B2B software to external clients across multiple parallel engagements.
* Proficiency with Jira or Azure DevOps, Confluence and Git\-based workflows.
* Clear communication. You can present to a client CXO, write a board\-ready MIS, and give an engineer hard feedback. GOOD TO HAVE
* Domain experience in manufacturing, supply chain, warehousing, logistics or ERP.
* Background in an IT services firm or the services arm of a product company.
* Familiarity with microservices, REST API design and message queues.
* Experience delivering AI/ML features.
* Exposure to SOC 2 or ISO 27001 audits.
* Certifications (PMP, CSM, PMI\-ACP) are welcome but won't substitute for a delivery and team\-building track record. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE IN YOUR FIRST 6 MONTHS
* 85%\+ of implementations go live on the committed date.
* Billing milestones are invoiced on time, and receivables ageing is visibly down.
* Every active account has baselined scope, a live RAID log and a change log.
* Services hiring is on plan, with near\-zero regretted attrition.
* Leadership gets a monthly services MIS without having to chase it. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITH The services delivery team (engineers, Tech Leads, BAs, QA), product squads, DevOps, consulting teams, finance and client stakeholders.


**WHY JOIN Own** 
 a real business line with direct access to leadership. Build the team and operating model your way. Work on enterprise products in active growth, including applied AI.
   

  

 Skills:\- Project Management, Delivery Management, Java, Spring Boot, Windows Azure, Client Management, Team Management, Agile/Scrum, Requirements management, CI/CD, Stakeholder management, confluence, RESTful APIs and Product Management

3fd868ca.title: Senior Salesforce Technical Architect
3fd868ca.description:
**Role Overview**
=================


CUBE84 is looking for an experienced and highly skilled Senior Salesforce Technical Architect to lead the technical architecture, solution design, and implementation of enterprise\-scale Salesforce solutions. This role is responsible for defining scalable, secure, and high\-performing technical architectures while providing technical leadership throughout the project lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have deep expertise across the Salesforce platform, strong integration experience, excellent stakeholder management skills, and a proven track record of leading development teams within a consulting environment. They will work closely with Solution Architects, Project Managers, Product Owners, Business Analysts, and clients to deliver robust, future\-ready Salesforce solutions.


**Key Responsibilities**
========================


**Technical Architecture \& Solution Design**
---------------------------------------------


* Design scalable, secure, and maintainable Salesforce technical architectures.
* Translate business requirements into technical solutions aligned with Salesforce best practices.
* Define solution architecture for Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, and custom Salesforce applications.
* Lead architecture discussions and technical discovery workshops with clients.
* Evaluate technical trade\-offs and recommend optimal solutions.

**Salesforce Development Leadership**
-------------------------------------


* Provide technical leadership to Salesforce development teams across multiple projects.
* Review technical designs, code quality, and solution implementations.
* Establish development standards, governance, and best practices.
* Mentor Senior Developers and Lead Developers.
* Drive adoption of reusable components and scalable development patterns.

**Integration \& Enterprise Architecture**
------------------------------------------


* Design integrations between Salesforce and enterprise applications.
* Architect API\-based integrations using REST, SOAP, Platform Events, Middleware, and ETL tools.
* Guide data migration, synchronization, and master data management strategies.
* Ensure security, authentication, and performance considerations are incorporated into integrations.

**Platform Governance**
-----------------------


* Define application architecture standards and coding guidelines.
* Ensure solutions comply with Salesforce governor limits and platform best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews and technical risk assessments.
* Drive technical debt reduction and continuous platform optimization.

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
------------------------------------


* Serve as the primary technical advisor during client engagements.
* Present solution approaches and architecture recommendations to technical and business stakeholders.
* Support pre\-sales activities, solution estimation, technical proposals, and RFP responses.
* Collaborate with Solution Architects, Delivery Managers, and Product teams throughout project execution.

**Delivery Support**
--------------------


* Guide technical teams throughout project implementation.

The Senior Solution Architect role at CUBE84 is a key position that requires exceptional expertise in Salesforce and strong leadership skills. As a senior solution leader, you will operate across the full deal spectrum, from small engagements to large, complex enterprise pursuits, and bring the strategic depth, commercial instinct, and platform breadth to handle whatever a deal demands.


You will work with the Sales Executive as a strategic partner, influencing how deals are positioned, how risks are managed, and how CUBE84 differentiates in competitive situations. You will read enterprise\-level complexity, manage multi\-stakeholder dynamics, and build the kind of credibility that moves large organisations to make decisions.

* Deep, expert\-level solutioning capability across the full Salesforce core, including complex configurations, advanced automation, and integration\-heavy architectures.

* Able to craft and deliver proposals and presentations that influence enterprise\-level decisions.

### **Responsibilities**


* Lead all pre\-sales activities as the senior solution voice across deals of any size and complexity, from quick\-turn SMB opportunities to long\-cycle enterprise pursuits.
* Partner with the Sales Executive at a strategic level, contributing to deal strategy, competitive positioning, and how the engagement is structured and priced.
* Lead discovery across multi\-stakeholder, multi\-workstream engagements, managing complexity and ensuring nothing critical is missed.
* Architect end\-to\-end solutions for the most complex deals, multi\-cloud, heavily integrated, or technically challenging, with the confidence to stand behind every recommendation.

* Build long\-term trusted advisor relationships with senior client stakeholders.
* Mentor and develop Associate Solution Architects, reviewing their work and providing structured guidance on discovery, solutioning, and proposal skills.
* Contribute to CUBE84's solutioning approach, proposal standards, and pre\-sales best practices.
* Bring market and product intelligence back into the team from client interactions and industry developments.

a767bf3b.title: Solutions Architect - GFS, AWS Industries India
a767bf3b.description:
**Description**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web \& mobile applications with data store technologies.
   

  

 AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. Our customer solutions usually involve many of these at once. AWS Solutions Architects are expected to have at least one technical areas of depth, but also need to be capable of leading discussions across most of these areas.
   

  

 Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee\-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and we host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon diversity conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
   

  

 Our team also puts a high value on work\-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well\-balanced life—both in and outside of work.
   

  

 Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better\-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Solutions Architect, you will provide architectural and technical leadership to a portfolio of customers who are looking to leverage AWS services at scale. You will be the domain expert guiding architectural design decisions, while demonstrating customer obsession to ensure high availability and performance of the customers applications. You’ll have the opportunity to learn and be curious while evangelizing the latest innovations and best practices in infrastructure, engineering and application design. You will mentor peers and customers while growing your knowledge.
   

  

 As a core member of the account team, you will drive revenue growth across a specific customer. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help organizations understand and implement advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a strategy to build knowledge and broad use of AWS. You will also need to be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as services teams, marketing, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

 As a Customer Delivery Architect, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, leading the strategy, design, and implementation of sophisticated Data Center and networking solutions that directly accelerate business outcomes. You will own end\-to\-end delivery of high\-impact engagements, translating customer business requirements into scalable architectures while influencing technology transitions at the highest levels. Responsible for the creation and sharing of intellectual property (content, training) including digital intellectual property (e.g., scripts, software assets) in the most productive manner for various audiences, customers. Mentorship that brings positive impact to the CX technical communities.
   

  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Experienced in customer\-facing roles including pre\-sales and/or service delivery roles.
* Any Data Center related certification(CCIE, CCNP VCP, etc.) with a strong drive for continuous learning.
* Inspiring leader who can showcase the value, Cisco solutions and services bring to Customer business and ensure adoption.
* Ability to develop high\-level migration and delivery strategies, driving decisions and seeing it through execution effectively and in an efficient manner.
* Strong Nexus 2K/5K/7K/9K platform knowledge and experience.
* Experience in designing Data Center solutions from traditional DC standalone Nexus design to VXLAN Fabric\-based SDN solutions demonstrating Single\-Site Fabrics, ACI MultiPod \& Multisite Fabric architectures.
* Has technical understanding \& experience in solutions involving network services appliances (Firewalls, IPS load balancers, WAN optimizer appliances) from a network integration perspective.
* Knowledgeable and experience in cloud computing, building multi\-cloud and hybrid\-cloud solutions involving multiple cloud providers like AWS, Azure, Google.
* Knowledge on Python, Ansible etc.


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiar with virtualization and container environments (VMware, Microsoft, Cisco CVIM, RHOSP, Kubernetes) and have technical exposure in integrating ACI with virtualization platforms through VMM integration.
* Possess extensive technical knowledge of at least two technology domains plus "one mile wide and one\-inch deep" knowledge of other technical, operational \& enterprise architecture domains following a 'T' shape model.
* Proven ability to mentor and develop Senior engineers, with experience leading high\-visibility strategic consulting engagements
* Can work in sophisticated or unstructured environments.


**Why Cisco?**
 At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
   

  

 Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. **What you need to succeed:**

The consultant designs and governs hybrid integration patterns between on\-premises data centers and cloud platforms, ensuring secure, scalable, resilient, and cost\-effective infrastructure services. Working closely with Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure Engineering, Security, Application Teams, Operations, and Managed Service Providers, the role drives cloud transformation while maintaining operational stability and governance.

  

**Job Title: Principal Consultant – Data Center Infrastructure**

  

**Role Summary**
The Principal Consultant is responsible for designing, implementing, and managing enterprise on\-premises infrastructure environments. The role provides technical leadership in data center operations, Linux platform administration, virtualization, infrastructure automation, and operational excellence. The consultant will drive infrastructure modernization, standardization, automation, and lifecycle management while ensuring high availability, security, and performance of enterprise systems.  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise on\-premises data center infrastructure.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives across compute, virtualization, storage, and operating system platforms.
* Architect and support highly available Linux\-based environments.
* Administer and maintain Linux operating systems, including:
	+ SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES)
	+ Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
	+ CentOS
* Provide technical leadership for enterprise server infrastructure and virtualization platforms.
* Develop and implement infrastructure standards, operational procedures, and best practices.
* Implement and maintain automated operational processes, including:
	+ OS patch management
	+ Server provisioning
	+ Configuration management
	+ Compliance and lifecycle management
* Automate virtual machine provisioning using OneData Platform and ServiceNow.
* Manage server lifecycle activities, including installation, upgrades, decommissioning, and capacity planning.
* Perform operating system hardening and ensure compliance with enterprise security standards.
* Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues and provide Level 3 technical support.
* Collaborate with storage, backup, networking, security, and application teams to deliver integrated infrastructure solutions.
* Monitor infrastructure health, performance, and availability, and recommend continuous improvements.
* Mentor infrastructure engineers and provide architectural guidance for enterprise projects.
* Support disaster recovery planning, business continuity, and high\-availability solutions.
  

**Required Skills**  

**Infrastructure**

* Expertise in enterprise server hardware (HPE, Dell, Lenovo, Cisco UCS, or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of virtualization technologies (VMware vSphere, Hyper\-V, or KVM).
* Experience with SAN/NAS storage technologies.

	+ SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES)

	+ CentOS

* Package management, user administration, LVM, multipathing, and file systems.

**Automation**
* Experience implementing automated infrastructure operations.
* Automated OS patching and compliance management.
* VM provisioning through OneData Platform and ServiceNow.
* Scripting using Bash, Python, or Ansible.
* Infrastructure configuration management and automation.

**Operations**
* Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
* Performance tuning and capacity planning.
* Backup and recovery operations.
* Disaster Recovery (DR) implementation and testing.
* Infrastructure monitoring and health management.

* ServiceNow workflow integration.
* Monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Nagios, Prometheus, or Grafana.
* ITIL processes and enterprise operations.

* RHCSA/RHCE, SUSE Certified Administrator, or equivalent Linux certifications preferred.
* VMware VCP certification is an advantage.
* ITIL Foundation certification is desirable.

**Experience**

* Proven experience supporting large\-scale on\-premises environments.
* Strong background in virtualization, Linux platforms, infrastructure automation, and enterprise operations.

99c7e3b5.title: Sr. Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - HCLS
99c7e3b5.description:
**Description**
 AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small\- and mid\-market accounts to enterprise\-level customers including public sector.
   

  

 As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect in AWS Industries HCLS segment, you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud and AI architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in\-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
   

  

 You will partner some of the worlds largest companies, to craft highly scalable, flexible and resilient cloud and AI architectures that address customer business problems and accelerate the adoption of AWS services. In collaboration with account managers, you will assist in driving growth across a small set of global customers in your defined country. As a trusted customer advocate, the solutions architect will help organizations understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to the cloud. You will have the opportunity to help shape and execute a strategy to build mind\-share and broad use of AWS within enterprise customers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value is critical to a solutions architect. You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
   

  

**Here Are Some Other Qualities We Are Looking For**
 Enjoy working with large, global customers as an active contributor to a diverse team. You will have a passion for educating, training, designing, and building cloud solutions for a diverse and challenging set of enterprise customers.
   

  

 Have a strong understanding of large scale computing solutions. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones, so you can make strong contributions to deep architecture discussions. You will regularly take part in deep\-dive education and design exercises to create world\-class solutions built on AWS.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Ensure success in building and migrating applications, software and services on the AWS platform
* Architect AI\-ML and Generative AI solutions on AWS
* In partnership with the account management team, formulate and execute a strategy
* Educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
* Conduct one\-to\-few and one\-to\-many training sessions to transfer knowledge to customers considering or already using AWS
* Capture and share best\-practice knowledge amongst the AWS solutions architect community
* Author or otherwise contribute to AWS customer\-facing publications such as whitepapers
* Build deep relationships with senior technical individuals within customers to enable them to be cloud advocates
* Act as a technical liaison between customers, service engineering teams and support


 A day in the life
   

  

* Review customer requirements and technical challenges, focusing on opportunities to implement complex solutions architectures that can transform business outcomes also leveraging AI capabilities
* Develop proof\-of\-concepts that demonstrate how cloud solutions can transform business processes
* Influence service team leadership and product marketing on the future needs for customers, prioritizing roadmap features and GTM messaging
* Dedicate time to continuous learning about the latest advancements in AWS service capabilities
* Participate in knowledge sharing activities with colleagues, creating field enablement materials to help tech community understand how to integrate cloud solutions into customer architectures


**About The Team**
 The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud and AI journey and work backwards from their industry\-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
   

  

 The HCLS Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to accelerating AWS cloud adoption across strategic Healthcare and Life Sciences accounts. Our mission is to drive tangible business value through focused execution on strategic projects, while enabling scale by up\-skilling broader field teams. We work at the intersection of technology and industry\-specific transformation, partnering closely with account teams, technology specialists, and industry specialist teams to deliver comprehensive solutions.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data \& analytics) experience
* 3\+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
* 10\+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or experience in a professional field


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

5ebc56f9.title: P2-GP-SAP Service Delivery Manager
5ebc56f9.description:
**Job Description – SAP Service Delivery Manager**

 **About Us**



Atlas Systems Inc. is a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas provides a comprehensive range of solutions in the areas of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over two decades in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across multiple industry verticals.



For more information, please visit our website:  

https://www.atlassystems.com/

  

Please click on the link below to apply for this position:

  


https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/601

 **Job Title**


**SAP Service Delivery Manager**



Location: Bangalore, India



Work Model: Hybrid



Experience: 10–12 Years



Employment Type: Full\-time

 **Position Summary**



We are seeking an experienced SAP Service Delivery Manager to lead the delivery of SAP application services for strategic enterprise customers.



This role is responsible for ensuring consistent, high\-quality delivery across multiple SAP functional, technical, and enterprise application service areas while serving as the primary customer interface for service delivery, governance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.



The Service Delivery Manager will manage a portfolio of SAP managed services, enhancement projects, production support, and service transition activities across technologies including SAP S/4HANA, SAP PP/DS, SAP Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC), SAP Basis, SAP Security \& GRC, SAP Redwood, SAP Winshuttle (Evolve), SAP Enterworks, Centric PLM, and additional SAP technologies introduced as customer requirements evolve.



The ideal candidate will build trusted customer relationships, lead globally distributed delivery teams, ensure SLA and KPI compliance, optimize resource utilization, drive continuous improvement, and support the expansion of Atlas Systems' SAP service portfolio.

 **Key Responsibilities**


**Service Delivery Management**


* Own end\-to\-end delivery of SAP managed services for assigned customer engagements.
* Ensure compliance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and quality standards.
* Monitor service performance and proactively address operational issues.
* Lead operational reviews, service governance meetings, and executive status reviews.
* Serve as the primary point of escalation for delivery and customer issues.


**Customer Relationship Management**


* Build and maintain strong relationships with customer business and IT stakeholders.
* Understand customer priorities and translate them into effective delivery plans.
* Communicate service status, risks, mitigation plans, and improvement initiatives.
* Drive high levels of customer satisfaction through proactive engagement and responsive service management.


**SAP Service Portfolio Management**



Manage delivery across multiple SAP technologies and enterprise applications including:


* SAP S/4HANA
* SAP PP/DS
* SAP Advanced Variant Configuration (AVC)
* SAP Basis
* SAP Security \& GRC
* SAP Redwood
* SAP Winshuttle (Evolve)
* SAP Enterworks
* Centric PLM
* Additional SAP technologies and enterprise applications as customer requirements evolve.


Coordinate production support, enhancement requests, application maintenance, service improvements, and minor project execution across all service towers.


**Service Transition \& Governance**


* Lead transition of new SAP services into managed support.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer between customers, implementation partners, and Atlas delivery teams.
* Establish governance processes including RAID management, action tracking, reporting dashboards, and service reviews.
* Ensure successful delivery of enhancement initiatives with minimal business disruption.
* Coordinate dependencies across internal teams and third\-party vendors.


**Resource \& Delivery Management**


* Plan resource capacity based on customer demand and delivery commitments.
* Allocate SAP consultants across functional and technical workstreams.
* Support hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and competency development.
* Work closely with SAP Practice leaders to build future capabilities.
* Optimize resource utilization while maintaining delivery quality.


**Operational Excellence**


* Monitor SLA performance, backlog health, delivery metrics, and service quality.
* Drive automation, process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Establish reusable delivery assets, documentation standards, and knowledge management practices.
* Leverage AI\-powered productivity tools to improve planning, reporting, documentation, and operational efficiency.


**Financial \& Commercial Management**


* Monitor service financials, forecasts, resource utilization, and profitability.
* Support effort estimation, budgeting, demand planning, and capacity forecasting.
* Ensure contractual commitments and governance requirements are consistently achieved.

4f2d3dff.title: Enterprise Solutions Manager
4f2d3dff.description:
**The Role:**
 11:11 Systems is looking for a dynamic and experienced Enterprise Solutions Manager (ESM) who will lead and manage technical service delivery on large \& complex accounts. You will direct the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of 11:11 Systems’ solutions, leading a support team comprised of subject matter experts from multiple platforms, operating systems, storage and network technologies. As a trusted advisor, you will provide strategic business and technology support/counsel to your customer across both their production and recovery environments.
   

  

 As ESM, you will be responsible for relationship development and management across key internal and customer stakeholders and executives to help translate their business needs into action.
   

  

**Responsibilities:**
* Document and understand the customer’s current, future / desired state, business goals and challenges, capabilities, and IT investments.
* Based on this understanding provide technical and strategic direction from initial solution design to steady state, based on industry and 11:11 Systems best practices.
* Serve as the single point of ownership for technology solutions and coordinate resources globally to optimize customer and 11:11 Systems value.
* Implement and manage effective governance practices and procedures across contracted scope of responsibilities (including change, incident, request, event, problem, and vendor management).
* Develop highly productive customer relationships and become a Trusted Advisor by providing thought leadership to help shape and grow our value to the customer.
* Direct lifecycle management (LCM) activities to maintain up to date technical documentation, including production \& recovery configurations, application dependency maps, run books and procedures, patching schedules, overall solution architecture document, recovery strategies / plans and contract changes.
* Develop recovery strategies to meet customer RTO/RPO and conduct periodic testing to document recoverability
* Manage service / relationship risk areas and takes steps to mitigate.
* Contribute to securing renewals for expiring contracts by documenting and articulating our value to the customer.
* Participate in engineering efforts required to develop new capabilities to meet customer requirements, document results and sample deliverables.
* Identify sales opportunities and collaborate with Account Executives to grow revenue.
* Process customer self\-service sales requests when needed.
* Meet/Exceed SLA targets by driving service management disciplines around incident, change, and problem management.
* Develop content and effectively lead Monthly Service Reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other strategic client meetings requested by the customer.
* Work supportively with colleagues, operating in a manner that is consistent with 11:11’s Code of Business Ethics and Company Values.
* Responsibly receive, transmit, and handle company data and information per Company data handling agreements, work procedures and policies.
* Review and follow company policies and guidelines, data privacy practices, including annual compliance training certification and policy acknowledgements.
* Additional duties as assigned.


**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10\+ years of professional IT experience with at least 3 years of demonstrated experience related to Enterprise focused TAM role, Solution Architecture and Customer facing Service delivery experience within complex environments.
* Technology certifications preferred, such as MCSE, CCIE, RHCE, VCP, CCDP, Cloud etc.
* At least one professional certification (eg. ITILv3, TOGAF, PRINCE2 etc.), or equivalent demonstrable skills and experience.
* Windows Server.
* Virtualization; including VMWare \& Hyper\-Vs.
* Networking; including routing and switching, security, and firewalls.
* Storage \& backup services/administration.
* Database; Understanding of data models and data flows in complex multitier database and application environments.
* Unix/Linux.
* BCP \& DR scenarios/solutions.
* Knowledge of Multi\-Tier Application architecture design.
* Strong interpersonal skills, customer service skills and communication skills.
* Problem\-solving skills to be able to resolve technical issues.
* Ability to train customers to use systems and software.
* Must be legally eligible to work without visa sponsorship.


 To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
   

  

**Benefits:**
* Healthcare Insurance Plan
* Life Insurance
* Paid Vacation \& Holidays
* India Pension Scheme

50a1128d.title: Sr. Technical Account Manager, ES - INDIA
50a1128d.description:
**Description**
 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer\-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast\-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
   

  

 As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server\-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start\-ups to large enterprises.
   

  

 As a Senior Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business\-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
   

  

* You’ll build solutions, provide technical guidance and advocate for the customer
* Ensure AWS environments remain operationally healthy whilst reducing cost and complexity
* Develop trusting relationships with customers, understanding their business needs and technical challenges
* Using your technical acumen and customer obsession, you’ll drive technical discussions regarding incidents, trade\-offs, and risk management
* Consult with a range of partners from developers through to C\-suite executives
* Collaborate with AWS Solutions Architects, Business Developers, Professional Services Consultants, and Sales Account Managers
* With a bias for action, you'll proactively find opportunities for customers to gain additional value from AWS
* Provide detailed reviews of service disruptions, metrics, detailed pre\-launch planning
* Solve a variety of problems across different customers as they migrate their workloads to the cloud
* Uplift customer capabilities by running workshops, brown bag sessions, etc.


 Watch a short video about life as a Technical Account Manager here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=J\_Rm0QgWvQ8
   

  

 The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

 As a Senior TAM, you will help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers’ adoption and use of AWS services \- including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, Bedrock, SageMaker, and many more. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support, and risk management.
   

  

 You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 7\+ years of hands\-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Knowledge of of cloud based architecture, cloud services and experience in customer facing roles
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, math, or equivalent, or experience in a STEM field equivalent to a four year degree
* Experience in external enterprise customer\-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead
* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in one or more of the following areas: software design or development, content distribution/CDN, scripting/automation, database architecture, IP networking, IT security, BigData/Hadoop/Spark, operations management, service oriented architecture


 Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
   

  

  

**Company** 
 \- AWS India \- Karnataka

b17864e5.title: Managed Services Engineer
b17864e5.description:
Managed Services Engineer – Microsoft 365 \& Backup/DR
   

 Cobweb Ahmedabad Delivery Centre \| On\-site, Ahmedabad \| 4\+ years experience
   

  

 ABOUT THIS ROLE
   

  

 Cobweb MENA FZ LLC is a Microsoft Solutions Partner headquartered in Dubai, UAE, delivering managed IT services, NOC/SOC monitoring, Microsoft 365, Azure and AI\-enablement solutions to SMB and mid\-market clients across the MENA region.
   

  

 The Cobweb Ahmedabad delivery centre operates under the Cobweb MENA FZ LLC – Eccentric Business Intelligence Pvt Ltd associated partnership, extending Cobweb's engineering capability into India. Eccentric Business Intelligence is a cross\-border advisory and technology services firm headquartered in Ahmedabad, with operations across India, the UAE and the USA.
   

  

 This role is based full\-time at the Ahmedabad delivery centre, working as part of Cobweb's service delivery function on the MENA client portfolio. Functional reporting is to the Services Director, Cobweb MENA FZ LLC; site and day\-to\-day administration sit with the Ahmedabad delivery centre management.
   

  

 It is a client\-facing engineering role, not a back\-office ticket queue. You will prepare and present Quarterly Business Reviews directly to client stakeholders.
   

  

 WHAT YOU WILL DO
   

  

 Microsoft 365 tenant management
   

 • Administer multiple client Microsoft 365 tenants — Exchange Online, Entra ID, SharePoint/OneDrive, Teams, user and mailbox lifecycle, and licensing.
   

 • Configure and maintain conditional access, MFA, mail flow rules and baseline security policies across the tenant estate.
   

 • Lead tenant\-to\-tenant and Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migrations end to end, including mailbox, data, DNS and identity cutover.
   

 • Monitor tenant health and licence utilisation, and recommend optimisation proactively.
   

  

 Backup, business continuity and disaster recovery
   

 • Own day\-to\-day Acronis (or equivalent) backup operations: job configuration, monitoring, failure remediation and restore testing.
   

 • Support client Business Continuity Plans, including RPO/RTO definitions, backup schedules and retention policies.
   

 • Coordinate periodic DR and failover/restore testing, and document outcomes.
   

  

 Quarterly Business Reviews
   

 • Build QBR packs covering service performance, ticket trends, patching and compliance, backup/DR posture, security posture and recommendations.
   

 • Present QBRs directly to client stakeholders and follow action items through to closure.
   

  

 RMM, PSA and automation
   

 • Work daily in RMM tooling (N\-able, Datto, ConnectWise Automate or equivalent) to monitor, patch and remediate across managed endpoints and servers.
   

 • Log and manage tickets in PSA/ITSM tooling (ConnectWise Manage, Autotask, HaloPSA, ServiceNow or equivalent) with accurate time capture and SLA adherence.
   

 • Automate recurring tasks in PowerShell (Graph API and Azure CLI an advantage) and maintain runbooks and SOPs.
   

  

 General service delivery
   

 • Deliver Level 2/3 support on escalated incidents within agreed SLAs, following ITIL\-aligned incident, change and problem management.
   

 • Collaborate with the Dubai service delivery and NOC/SOC teams.
   

 • Contribute to new client onboarding, including discovery, documentation and tooling deployment.
   

  

 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
   

  

 • 4\+ years in an MSP, IT service desk or enterprise IT operations environment, with substantial hands\-on Microsoft 365 administration at scale.
   

 • Practical Acronis Cyber Protect or comparable backup platform experience, including restore and recovery operations.
   

 • Demonstrated experience leading tenant\-to\-tenant and Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 migrations.
   

 • Proven ability to build and confidently deliver QBRs or similar client\-facing service reviews.
   

 • PowerShell scripting proficiency and solid RMM/PSA working knowledge.
   

 • Clear spoken and written English, with the confidence to engage MENA\-based clients directly.
   

 • Willingness to align working hours with Dubai/MENA business hours.
   

  

 MANDATORY CERTIFICATIONS
   

  

 Applications will only be considered from candidates holding both:
   

 • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS\-102\) or equivalent, and
   

 • A Microsoft security certification — SC\-300, SC\-200 or the retired MS\-500\.
   

  

 NICE TO HAVE
   

  

 Azure administration (virtual machines, Intune, basic networking); Mimecast or Proofpoint; Exclaimer; prior MSP experience serving MENA or multi\-country client portfolios; NOC/SOC\-monitored environments; ITIL v4 Foundation, AZ\-900, Acronis or Mimecast certifications.
   

  

 EDUCATION
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
   

  

 WHAT WE OFFER
   

  

 • A diverse, multi\-country MENA client base as part of a growing Microsoft Solutions Partner.
   

 • A genuinely client\-facing engineering role, not a back\-office ticket queue.
   

 • Structured career growth across the Cobweb – Eccentric associated partnership, with close collaboration alongside the Dubai leadership and technical teams.
   

 • An established office environment and local engineering team at the Ahmedabad delivery centre.

 HOW TO APPLY
   

  

 Apply through LinkedIn with your CV. Please include your Microsoft 365 certification numbers and a brief summary of the largest migration you have led.

846f2d08.title: Engagement Manager
846f2d08.description:
**Engagement Manager**


Can you spot a revenue opportunity sitting inside a project that's already 80% delivered? Do you get as much energy from a well\-run QBR as you do from closing a new SOW? Can you hold a PM accountable for a slipping RAID log *and* negotiate an MSA renewal in the same week?

  

  

Then, our Engagement Manager role here at CUBE84 may interest you.


In this gig,


* **You turn happy clients into bigger contracts**
  

You're always scanning existing accounts for the next upsell, cross\-sell, or team\-extension opportunity — and you know the difference between a client who's ready for that conversation and one who isn't yet. You lead SOWs, RFP responses, and commercial pitches for account expansion, and you build relationships into new business units before anyone asks you to.

* **You're the person the VP calls first**
  

You're the primary escalation point and trusted advisor for senior client stakeholders — Directors, VPs, sometimes the C\-suite. You run the governance cadence that keeps everyone honest: MBRs, QBRs, and the kind of straight\-talk that catches a retention risk three months before it becomes a lost account.

* **You know exactly what the account is worth**
  

You own the commercial side of the relationship — margins, utilization, budget health — and you lead contract renewals, MSA negotiations, and pricing conversations without needing someone else to make the call.

* **You run a tight ship across the whole portfolio**
  

You partner with PMs and Tech Leads to keep milestones, SLAs, and quality on track, and you don't let "we'll document it later" become a habit. You mandate and audit RAID logs, RACI, change control, and milestone tracking across every engagement, and you enforce a real change control gate — no scope, timeline, or budget shift moves without a documented impact assessment and sign\-off. You standardize a portfolio\-wide health scorecard and review it on a fixed cadence, so nothing surprises you.

* **You pitch solutions, not features**
  

You take complex technical offerings — Cloud, DevOps, AI, custom software — and translate them into direct answers to a client's business problem. You're comfortable being the one in the room who can move a technical conversation into a commercial one.

* **You build a team people don't want to leave**
  

You lead people, not just projects. You run initiatives without someone standing over your shoulder, and your PMs know exactly what "good" looks like because you've shown them, not just told them.
**It'll be awesome if you...**


* Have 10\+ years of overall experience in IT professional services, tech consulting, or IT account management, with a proven track record of hitting expansion/upsell targets (this one's non\-negotiable)
* Have led SOWs, RFP responses, and commercial pitches that actually closed
* Have real financial acumen — margins, utilization models, contract negotiation, not just budget\-tracking
* Have run governance cadences (MBRs/QBRs) with senior stakeholders and walked away with the relationship stronger, not weaker
* Have held PMs accountable to delivery discipline — RAID, RACI, change control — across a multi\-account portfolio
* Are confident presenting to and influencing C\-suite stakeholders
* Have strong people management skills and can run initiatives independently, without hand\-holding

More awesome, if you have


* Salesforce knowledge
* Experience pitching Cloud, DevOps, or AI\-adjacent technical offerings

b8dacaf5.title: Manager Solutions and Presales
b8dacaf5.description:
Do you get restless when a deal is running but nobody can tell you why it's winning? Given a pile of discovery notes, can you spot the one thing that should shape the whole solution, before anyone's started writing it? Can you look at a live account and see the next deal sitting inside it, before Delivery even mentions it?

  

  

Then, our Manager, Solutions and Presales role here at CUBE84 may interest you.


**In this gig,**


* **(You Own The Deal, Not Just The Deck)**
  

You're accountable for the solution side of every deal, whether or not you personally build the artifact. You decide who works a lead, assign the solution architect before the first call is booked, make sure the lead research is good enough to walk in with, and stay on top of deal status long after the proposal goes out — even though Sales owns follow\-up.
* **(You Name The Reason We Win)**
  

Following process is the floor here, not the job. On every deal, you name the one reason this client should pick CUBE84 over whoever else is in the room, based on what discovery actually surfaced — then you make sure the proposal, the demo, and the calls all carry that theme. Win rate on your deals is how this role gets measured, not clean paperwork on a loss.
* **(You Work In AI, Not Around It)**
  

CUBE84 drafts lead research, proposals, and RFP responses with Claude, using skills already built for each. This isn't something you reach for when a deadline is tight — it's the job. You get better output from those skills than the team gets today, flag where a skill needs to change, and hold the team to working this way.
* **(You Build The Team That Builds The Deals)**
  

This is the larger half of the job. You assess each person on technical depth, client presence, and written work — then coach against their specific gap instead of running generic training. You assign work so no account depends on one person's memory, review everything before it reaches a client, and run the appraisal cycle, including the calls on who's ready for more.
* **(You Show Up For Delivery Too)**
  

This isn't a presales\-only seat. You work with delivery leads to name the right people for a project before it's sold, step in yourself (or lend someone from your team) when a delivery architect needs extended support, and help delivery leads size and write up the next phase of a live account.
* **(You Own The Process, Not Just Follow It)**
  

You enforce the presales process even when a deadline is tight, but you also track what's actually working, retire the steps that add nothing, and bring changes to the founder with the evidence behind them.
**It'll be awesome if you...**


* Have led a presales or solution consulting team at a senior level, owning the outcome and not just the process
* Have run deals end\-to\-end, from the first call through proposal and statement of work
* Have owned RFP or RFI responses — the bid decision, the section assignments, and the winning theme
* Have scoped and estimated consulting engagements, and then defended that estimate when someone pushed back
* Have Salesforce knowledge deep enough to challenge a design and catch a bad estimate before it goes out **(this one's non\-negotiable)**
* Can judge whether discovery actually produced enough to price and scope the work, rather than just enough to move to the next stage
* Have managed people — set standards, given hard feedback, run appraisals, made the call on who's ready for more
* Can hold a real pipeline conversation with sales leadership, backed by a view of your own from being on the calls
* Speak English a US client follows without effort, with a neutral accent **(this one's non\-negotiable)**
* Write clean enough that a proposal goes out the door without a rewrite
* Have worked across a founder, sales, a presales team, and delivery at the same time, without losing track of any of them

**More awesome, if you have**


* Hands\-on Salesforce architecture experience
* Nonprofit, healthcare, housing, education, or public sector exposure
* Some sales instinct already forming — this role will sharpen it, but a head start doesn't hurt

9b30bdd9.title: Program Manager – Automotive Parts & Accessories
9b30bdd9.description:
Overview:

The Accessory Program Manager will serve as the primary liaison between the Accessories team and Vehicle Teams, ensuring all accessory parts and programs are delivered on time, within budget, and in alignment with OEM standards. This role demands a strong blend of program governance, technical coordination, and stakeholder communication across the full product development lifecycle through Start of Production (SOP).


Responsibilities:
**Key Responsibilities**

**Program \& Timeline Management**

* Own end\-to\-end program tracking for accessory parts and systems, maintaining accurate and up\-to\-date timelines.
* Compile, manage, and report program schedules, identifying milestone risks proactively.
* Escalate late parts and programs to the appropriate stakeholders; support (but not necessarily lead) recovery plan execution.

**Liaison \& Communication**

* Act as the primary interface between Accessories and Vehicle Teams, ensuring alignment on program requirements and deliverables.
* Author, track, and coordinate responses to technical Bulletins issued to or from Vehicle Teams.
* Write, manage, and follow up on Engineering Requisitions (ERs) throughout the program lifecycle.

**Budget \& Economic Management**

* Compile and track budgets at vehicle, part, and system levels.
* Manage economic follow\-up covering engineering costs, tooling and means, and part pricing.
* Perform global synthesis of costs and risks; report critical financial risks to OEM management with a defined action plan.

**Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate all technical activities from program kick\-off through SOP, including technical specification, validation plan definition and follow\-up.
* Manage supplier engagement: selection, follow\-up, TKO (Tool Kick\-Off), and part approval processes.
* Oversee fitting instruction documentation and distribution to relevant teams.

**Risk, Governance \& Reporting**

* Drive project progress across accessory and service parts projects; proactively identify risks and issues.
* Define and implement mitigation strategies to protect program delivery commitments.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure project dependencies are delivered on time and in scope.
* Provide structured status reporting to internal leadership and client program teams.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Automotive, or related Engineering discipline (mandatory).
* 12\+ years of experience in automotive program management, preferably in accessories, service parts, or OEM delivery.
* PMP (Project Management Professional) certification is a strong added advantage.
* Prior exposure to OEM programs


Essential skills:
**Required Skills \& Competencies**

* + Strong program and project management skills, including timeline management, budget control, and risk mitigation.
	+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills – ability to work across OEM, supplier, and internal teams.
	+ Solid automotive engineering background with understanding of accessory and service parts development processes.
	+ Familiarity with Engineering Requisition (ER) processes, technical bulletins, and supplier management in an OEM environment.
	+ Experience managing cross\-functional technical teams and vendor/supplier coordination.
	+ Strong analytical skills for budget tracking, risk synthesis, and reporting.
	+ Proficiency in MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Project); PLM/PDM tools knowledge is an advantage.

  


Experience:
**Total Experience**  

12 TO 15 Years in Program Management
