527c5953.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
 **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience analyzing data and generating business insights.
* 7 years of experience developing operational process solutions, and working with cross\-functional teams to drive these changes.
* 7 years of experience in a customer or client\-facing role.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Demonstrated expertise in spreadsheet\-based financial modeling, resource planning, and building multi\-variable operational scenarios.
* Experience collaborating with and presenting to technical stakeholders (Product Managers, Engineers, and Executive leaders), including the ability to influence roadmap decisions and hold technical teams accountable to business outcomes.
* Familiarity with managing large\-scale global vendor operations, outsourced partner networks, or shared services environments.
* Proven ability to analyze complex operational metrics (e.g., Customer Handling Time, deflection, reopen rates, accuracy) to extract actionable insights.


**About the job** 
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
   

  

 As a Service Delivery Manager, you will sit at the intersection of operational delivery, AI\-first technology integration, and financial governance. In this role, you will lead the end\-to\-end operational strategy, budget planning, and tool\-readiness evaluations across a global partner network.
   

  

 You will be responsible for driving the transition of complex user journeys toward automated and agentic models, overseeing specialized quality and pre\-release testing operations, and conducting deep quantitative analysis to measure process efficiency.
   

  

 This role requires a proactive leader who can translate operational trends into technical inputs, manage an Operating Expenses (OpEx) budget, and partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to hold technical solutions accountable to real\-world performance metrics.
   

  

 Our core operations primarily follow standard business hours. However, ensuring a seamless customer experience across our global markets is central to our strategy. To solve for critical customer needs and to optimize resolution velocity, you may occasionally be aligned to alternative shifts schedules on a rotational basis. To fully support your well\-being, Google provides support for any non\-standard operational shifts.Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Drive the end\-to\-end operational strategy for Google's customer support models, with a specific focus on scaling automated and agentic solutions for designated user segments.
* Manage, track, and execute an annual operational expenditure budget. Design resource allocation models, evaluate multi\-variable operational scenarios, and manage partner staffing ramps or transfers in line with budget guidelines.
* Oversee minimum quality bar frameworks and dedicated partner teams focused on pre\-release testing, UAT, logic stress testing, and model tuning. Ensure all systems adhere to Google's core customer experience quality and safety standards.
* Design and execute quantitative studies to calculate and show the case of managing time savings of future tool and feature rollouts. Partner with Data Science and product teams to standardize measurement assumptions.
* Act as the liaison between scaled operations and technical teams.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Ensure AI solutions move from concept to pilot to scaled deployment, and ultimately to sustained adoption. Own delivery outcomes across initiatives, including scope, timelines, and measurable business impact.

**2\) Program \& Portfolio Delivery:** Lead a portfolio of AI use cases and programs across the enterprise. Establish and manage delivery discipline (prioritization, dependencies, timelines, risk mitigation). Ensure outcomes are tied to clear business value (e.g., productivity, growth, cost, risk). Drive integrated program plans, track KPIs and milestones, and proactively manage risks, dependencies, and execution challenges, escalating as needed.

Stay current on emerging AI capabilities and translate into practical application.

**5\) Adoption, Change \& Value Realization:** Drive business adoption of AI solutions, not just delivery. Define metrics and success measures and track realization of expected outcomes. Partner with HR / change / comms teams to support workflow integration and behavior change. Ensure value realization is clearly defined, tracked, and communicated, with a focus on measurable outcomes.

Support approval processes and risk assessments for AI deployments. Ensure alignment to the enterprise AI operating model, embedding best practices across data, technology, risk, talent, and change management.

bdcd0a9e.description:
**An Amazing Career Opportunity for Solutions Engineer
   

  

 Location: Remote Or Hybrid / Office
   

  

 Job ID: 49282**
**Profile Summary**
 HID Global’s Biometric Identity Technologies division is seeking a skilled Solutions Engineer with a strong presales orientation, capable of delivering compelling demonstrations, managing strategic tenders, and guiding customers—particularly national authorities such as Police forces, Ministries, and other government institutions—through complex solution evaluations.
   

  

 In this role, you will collaborate closely with Sales to understand customer challenges, shape technical requirements, and identify opportunities for HID’s hardware, software, and professional services. While a solid architecture and development foundation is required, the emphasis is on customer\-facing activities, including presentations, proof‑of‑concepts, and presales technical leadership.
   

  

 You will help articulate HID Global’s value, support technical aspects of the sales cycle, and ensure smooth transitions from presales engagement into project execution. The position is designed for a motivated professional who excels in remote/hybrid environments and thrives in a role that blends technical expertise with high\-impact communication.
   

  

 You will support Sales across Middle East and India regions, including travel for on‑site demonstrations, workshops, and government stakeholder engagements.
   

  

**Ideal Qualifications:**
* Proven experience designing end\-to\-end identity verification, biometric enrollment, adjudication, or credentialing workflows involving sensitive biometric and personally identifiable information (PII).
* Experience creating solution architectures for large government agencies involving identity management, biometric matching, data integration, case management, or digital identity platforms.
* Proven experience working on AADHAR and related projects for biometric identity solutions (such as STQC, MOSIP, etc…)


**Who are we?**
 HID Global Biometric Identity Technologies is trusted by governments and enterprises worldwide. We support everyday identity verification use cases where performance, accuracy and continuity are non\-negotiable. HID Global’s mission is to power the trusted identities of the world’s people, places, and things, allowing people to transact safely, work productively and travel freely. We are a high\-tech software company headquartered in Austin, TX, with over 4,000 worldwide employees. Check us out: www.hidglobal.com and https://youtu.be/23km5H4K9Eo
   

  

 LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/hidglobal/mycompany/
   

  

**Duties and Responsibilities include the following.** 
 Other duties may be assigned.
   

  

* Serve as a technical presales expert within the Sales team, strengthening customer engagements through tailored demonstrations, technical guidance, and structured tender support.
* Develop and deliver high\-impact solution demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and presentations that clearly communicate HID Global’s value to government and enterprise customers.
* Prepare detailed proposals and tender documentation for complex opportunities, ensuring compliance with government procurement requirements and alignment with customer technical needs.
* Interpret and refine customer requirements in collaboration with regional Sales, Product Management, and Engineering teams, ensuring proposed solutions address national authority use cases such as law enforcement, civil ID, and border management.
* Provide complete technical content for RFPs, RFIs, and government tenders, ensuring accuracy, competitiveness, and clarity.
* Architect, validate, and document biometric and identity‑management solutions across HID’s portfolio, ensuring alignment with mission‑critical government environments.
* Act as HID Global’s primary technical liaison throughout presales and post\-sales phases, ensuring consistent communication, clarity on deliverables, and alignment between customer expectations and internal teams.
* Maintain deep awareness of market trends, biometric technologies, and public\-sector digital transformation initiatives.
* Represent HID Global's technical capabilities at trade shows, partner events, and government briefings, delivering professional demonstrations and solution walkthroughs.


**Primary Duties:**
* Collaborate weekly with an international presales and solutions engineering team, sharing best practices and supporting cross\-regional opportunities.
* Support Sales across Middle East, and India regions, including travel for on‑site demonstrations, workshops, and government stakeholder engagements.
* Focus on presales activities for HID’s commercial and ABIS solutions, especially for small\-to\-medium national authorities, civil registry agencies, and security ministries.


**Essential Qualifications (Required)**
 To perform this role successfully, candidates must meet the following requirements:
   

  

* Fluent in English and Hindi
* Bachelor’s degree in computer information systems or related fields
* Minimum 5 years of presales and customer\-facing technical experience, including demonstrations, requirements analysis, and support
* Proven experience engaging with national authorities, such as Police agencies, Ministries of Interior/Justice, civil ID programs, or similar public\-sector clients.
* Minimum 3 years of experience with a focus on server / client solution architecture
* Excellent presentation and communication skills, particularly for non\-technical and government audiences
* Strong problem\-solving aptitude with an ability to engineer customer\-centric solutions that drive sales success
* Deep understanding of the hardware and software development lifecycle and technical solution delivery
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage several presales engagements simultaneously in a hybrid/remote environment


**Education and/or Experience:**
* Master’s degree or relevant technical certifications
* Experience drafting Statements of Work and technical proposals
* Experience of working as a liaison between Sales and an Engineering team
* Able to manage technical solutions by performing basic project management functions including but not limited to scope, tracking deliverables, providing meeting minutes and tracking action items
* Experience with scripting or programming languages for adapting or creating demo environments
* Hands\-on experience with development platforms or compilers (Android Studio, Visual Studio, etc.)
* Proven ability to configure, test, and validate server/client systems
* Ability to work as part of a team
* Familiarity with biometric systems (fingerprint, facial)
* Familiarity with document validation and proofing technologies for Passports or national IDs
* Experience with Enterprise and distributed system architecture
* Experience with collaboration and productivity tools: Salesforce, Confluence, Jira, SharePoint, Git
* Strong teamwork abilities and proficiency with Microsoft Office applications
* Proficient in MS Office applications, such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.
* Solid experience working within an MS Windows 11 environment


**Why apply?**
* Empowerment: You’ll work as part of a global team in a flexible work environment, learning and enhancing your expertise. We welcome an opportunity to meet you and learn about your unique talents, skills, and experiences. You don’t need to check all the boxes. If you have most of the skills and experience, we want you to apply.
* Innovation: You embrace challenges and want to drive change. We are open to ideas, including flexible work arrangements, job sharing or part\-time job seekers.
* Integrity: You are results\-orientated, reliable, and straightforward and value being treated accordingly. We want all our employees to be themselves, to feel appreciated and accepted.


 This opportunity may be open to flexible working arrangements.
   

  

 HID is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer – Minority/Female/Disability/Veteran/Gender Identity/Sexual Orientation
   

  

**We make it easier for people to get where they want to go!**
 On an average day, think of how many times you tap, twist, tag, push or swipe to get access, find information, connect with others or track something. HID technology is behind billions of interactions, in more than 100 countries. We help you create a verified, trusted identity that can get you where you need to go – without having to think about it.
   

  

 When you join our HID team, you’ll also be part of the ASSA ABLOY Group, the global leader in access solutions. You’ll have 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally. As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

What You'll Do
   

  

 Step into a pivotal role on Avalara’s high\-impact Solution Consulting team, where you’ll partner with our APAC Sales and Partner teams to showcase the power of our industry\-leading tax technology. You’ll lead engaging product demonstrations and navigate technical conversations, both within Avalara’s suite and seamlessly integrated with top ERP and e\-commerce platforms.
   

  

 As a trusted advisor, you will help customers tackle complex indirect tax challenges spanning VAT, GST, and Sales \& Use Tax by leveraging Avalara’s cutting\-edge solutions. This is more than a job; it’s a unique opportunity to build global tax expertise and shape transformative customer experiences.
   

  

 You will collaborate closely with our teams in Australia and India, playing a vital role in driving growth and success across the region while being part of a collaborative, high\-performance culture at the forefront of tax automation innovation.
   

  

**What Your Responsibilities Will Be**
 Partner with our APAC Sales and Partner teams to drive presales excellence across Avalara’s tax technology suite. You’ll lead product and ERP demonstrations, scope tailored solutions, and guide technical discussions that directly address the needs of prospects and customers. Your role will be pivotal in translating complex tax requirements into simple, effective solutions.
   

  

 Engage directly with clients to uncover their unique tax challenges and design strategies that deliver real impact. Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and delivery, helping customers achieve success from day one. You’ll also bring valuable market insight and thought leadership to shape Avalara’s APAC strategy and product innovation.
   

  

 What You’ll Need To Be Successful
   

  

* 5\+ years in presales consulting, solution consulting, or SaaS/professional services (ideally in Tax Technology).
* Strong understanding of indirect tax including VAT, GST, Sales \& Use Tax, and cross\-border compliance.
* Familiarity with ERP systems is highly preferred (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Workday NetSuite, Microsoft D365\)
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex topics and influence stakeholders.
* Highly self\-driven, adaptable, and comfortable working remotely across time zones.
* Quick learner with a passion for tax technology and delivering customer value.


 Avalara is an AI\-first Company
   

  

 AI is embedded in our workflows, decision\-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.
   

  

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI\-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges \- improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.


 How We’ll Take Care Of You
   

  

 Total Rewards
   

  

 In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.
   

  

 Health \& Wellness
   

  

 Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.
   

  

 Inclusive culture and diversity
   

  

 Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee\-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.
   

  

**What You Need To Know About Avalara**
 We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.
   

  

 We’ve already built an industry\-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6\.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real \- we're a billion dollar business \- and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission \- to be part of every transaction in the world.
   

  

 We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.
   

  

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**
 Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.
   

  

**Who You’ll Become**
 A Solution Advisor works closely with our customers and prospects to identify and solve business challenges and meet their strategic objectives using SAP solutions. As part of the sales team, a Solution Advisor is the “subject matter expert” responsible for the functional and technical knowledge within the sales cycle. A Solution Advisor provides deal support by participating in discovery sessions, executive meetings and presentations and delivers software demonstrations that help the customer understand SAP’s unique value proposition. In addition to deal support, the Solution Advisor participates in marketing events to generate demand, leads Design Thinking sessions, and collaborates with the broader sales team to identify whitespace opportunities at existing accounts.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 As a Solution Advisor within the SAP Next Gen \- Academy for Customer Success, you will be responsible to:
   

  

* Successfully complete a 10\-month program that strengthens the foundation for a successful customer\-facing career at SAP.
* Participate in experiential learning opportunities with colleagues from all over the world and acquire a wide variety of business, industry and SAP solution skills while working with emerging and cutting\-edge technologies.
* Receive on\-the\-job training under the mentorship of a senior Solution Advisor colleague while working with our customers to gain real world experience and acquire the skills necessary to help guide our customers through their Digital Transformation journey.


 The program will enrich your knowledge of SAP and give you the professional experience to serve our customers. We offer full\-time employment from day one with practical learning applications for your role. After successful completion of the program, you are expected to lead customer discovery sessions and survey activities to uncover business challenges and opportunities for innovation. You will create and deliver high impact and engaging software demonstrations that compel the customers to select SAP over other competitive offerings. You will also provide demand generation support through marketing events and deal execution support by responding to request for proposals
   

  

**What You Bring**
* 2\-3 years of professional experience with a strong foundation in technical and business processes, exposure to relevant technologies/solutions, and customer\-facing skills.
* Technical and business process knowledge, combined with hands\-on experience using relevant technologies and industry\-standard tools to support solution delivery and operational efficiency.
* A cooperative and productive approach to working relationships, internally and externally.
* A strong ability to quickly learn new concepts, adapt to changing environments, and apply knowledge to deliver results.
* An understanding of AI fundamentals, uses, and ethics, to identify business problems solvable with AI.
* Strong Business Acumen, including demonstrated knowledge of business processes and/or industries.
* Proficiency in English to engage with our global network.
* AI focus areas: (AI Adoption Mindset, Agentic AI Day\-to Day Practice, and Context Engineering)
* A curious and agile mindset, with a passion for learning and the resilience to adapt in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* Strong problem\-solving, project management, and creative thinking skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and communicate ideas clearly and effectively.
* Emotional intelligence and cultural awareness that support inclusive teamwork and thoughtful stakeholder engagement.
* A growing foundation in business acumen and emerging technologies, especially artificial intelligence, paired with a results\-oriented approach and the courage to take initiative.


**The SAP Academy for Customer Success is a global development program designed for talent who are early in their career.**
**About SAP Academy For Customer Success**
 The SAP Academy for Customer Success offers a three\-year journey that drives accountability and enhances productivity. It enables graduates to make a quick impact in customer\-facing roles while fostering career longevity and leadership potential.
   

  

 Join us for a unique opportunity to build a global network, collaborate with customers to solve real business challenges, and gain hands\-on experience with world\-class cloud solutions — all while learning in a dynamic environment and earning competitive pay and benefits.

a542731f.title: Presales Engineer
a542731f.description:
**Company Description** 
 VendiHalt is a startup focused on transforming the traditional vending machine business into a smart retail ecosystem. The company builds intelligent automated retail machines that also function as interactive marketing platforms using artificial intelligence, big data, and online payments. VendiHalt collaborates closely with large retailers and brand owners to launch their own branded automated retail platforms. Team members join a fast\-moving environment where innovation, customer focus, and scalable technology are central to the company’s growth.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Presales Engineer role based in Noida. The Presales Engineer will work closely with the sales team to understand customer requirements, prepare tailored solution proposals, and deliver technical demonstrations of VendiHalt’s smart retail platform. Daily responsibilities include collaborating with product and engineering teams to design integrations, addressing technical queries from prospects, and supporting proof\-of\-concept deployments. The role involves gathering client feedback to improve solution offerings, ensuring security and performance considerations are clearly communicated, and providing ongoing technical support during the sales cycle. The Presales Engineer will also contribute to documentation, presentations, and enablement materials that help customers and internal teams understand the platform’s capabilities.
   

**Qualifications**
  

* Strong Presales and Sales support skills, including requirements gathering, solution design, and customer presentations.
* Hands\-on experience with Technical Support and Integration of software or hardware systems, preferably in retail or IoT environments.
* Knowledge of Security principles related to cloud platforms, connected devices, and online payment systems.
* Ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working with APIs, data flows, and system architecture is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and documentation skills, with attention to detail.
* Comfort working in a startup environment, with adaptability to evolving priorities and customer needs.

dccc3f04.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
dccc3f04.description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you’ll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co\-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You’ll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world\-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that’s passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 Senior Solutions Engineers drives not only the early\-stage evaluation within the sales process, but also play a crucial role in enabling ongoing value\-realization for customers, all while helping them move up the adoption maturity curve. In this role you’ll partner with Account Executives to be the key technical advisor in service of the customers. You’ll be instrumental in surfacing the customers stated or implicit Business Needs, and coming up with Technical Designs to best meet these needs. You may find yourself at times facilitating art of the possible discussions and storytelling to inspire customers in adopting new patterns with confidence, and at other times driving creative solutioning to help get past difficult technical roadblocks. Overall, we look upon Solutions Engineers to be a key cog within the Customer Success Team that help foster an environment of sustained success for the customer and incremental adoption of Confluent’s Technology.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Help advance new \& innovative Data Streaming use\-cases from conception to Go\-Live
   

  

 Execute on and lead Technical Proofs of Concept
   

  

 Conduct Discovery \& Whiteboard Sessions to develop new use\-cases
   

  

 Provide Thought Leadership by delivering Technical Talks and Workshops
   

  

 Guide customers with hands\-on help and best practice to drive operational maturity of their Confluent Deployment
   

  

 Analyze Customer Consumption trends and identify Optimization opportunities
   

  

 Work closely with Product and Engineering teams, and serve as a key Product advocate across the Customer, Partner and Industry ecosystem
   

  

 Forge strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and serve as a dependable partner for them
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
 Solutions Engineering or similar work experience
   

  

 Experience with Open Source Flink
   

  

 Experience with Event\-Driven architecture, Data Integration \& Processing Techniques, Database \& Data Warehouse technologies
   

  

 First\-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment \& Application Development
   

  

 Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes
   

  

 Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL
   

  

 Technical certifications \- Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering \& Integration
   

  

 Clear, consistent demonstration of self\-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems
   

  

 Exceptional presentation and communications capabilities.
   

  

 Confidence presenting to a highly skilled and experienced audience, ranging from developers to enterprise architects and up to C\-level executives

2f9a40c9.title: Senior Architect
2f9a40c9.description:
Job description:

**Senior Architect**  
**Location:** Bangalore  
**Company:** Myscaai Bharat Construction Pvt. Ltd.  
**Experience:** 6\-10 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Notice Period:** Immediate Joiners  
**Compensation:** Best in Industry  
**Must\-Have Experience (Mandatory)**  
Candidates must have proven hands\-on experience in the planning, design, coordination, and execution of the following project types:

* High\-Rise Residential Buildings \& Apartment Projects
* Residential Communities, Townships \& Gated Communities
* Hospitality Projects including Hotels, Resorts \& Service Apartments
* Large Infrastructure Projects such as Schools, Colleges, Universities, Educational Campuses, Institutional Buildings, and Mixed\-Use Developments

Applicants without substantial experience in the above project categories may not be considered.  
**About Myscaai Bharat Construction**  
Myscaai Bharat Construction Pvt. Ltd. is a fast\-growing construction and design\-build company specializing in premium residential, smart homes, villas, apartments, and turnkey construction solutions. We are committed to delivering innovative, high\-quality, and sustainable projects through excellence in design, engineering, and execution.  
**Position Summary**  
We are seeking an experienced, creative, and execution\-oriented Senior Architect to lead architectural planning, design development, project coordination, and construction support across residential, hospitality, infrastructure, and high\-rise developments.  
The ideal candidate must possess strong design capabilities combined with practical site execution experience and the ability to manage projects from concept design through completion.  
**Key ResponsibilitiesArchitectural Design \& Planning**

* Lead architectural design development from concept through detailed design and construction stages.
* Prepare architectural layouts, presentations, working drawings, construction documentation, and specifications.
* Develop innovative design concepts, space planning solutions, façade treatments, and material selections.
* Ensure designs meet client expectations, project objectives, construction feasibility, and industry standards.
* Incorporate sustainable and future\-ready design solutions where applicable.

**Project Coordination**

* Coordinate with structural, MEP, interior, landscape, and external consultants.
* Work closely with project managers, site engineers, contractors, and vendors.
* Review consultant drawings and ensure seamless multidisciplinary coordination.
* Participate in project planning, budgeting, scheduling, and design review meetings.

**Technical Management**

* Prepare and review working drawings, construction details, BOQ inputs, and technical specifications.
* Ensure compliance with local building regulations, statutory approvals, fire safety norms, and building codes.
* Resolve technical and design issues arising during project execution.
* Conduct design reviews and value engineering exercises to optimize project outcomes.

**Site Execution \& Monitoring**

* Conduct regular site visits to monitor construction progress and architectural implementation.
* Verify execution against approved drawings and quality standards.
* Provide technical clarifications and practical solutions to site teams.
* Support construction teams in resolving on\-site design challenges.

**Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor architects, draftsmen, BIM modelers, and design team members.
* Review architectural deliverables for accuracy, quality, and compliance.
* Establish best practices and maintain high design standards across projects.
* Monitor team performance and support professional development.

**Client \& Stakeholder Management**

* Attend key client meetings and present architectural solutions.
* Manage design approvals and stakeholder coordination.
* Maintain strong relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and authorities.
* Ensure timely communication and resolution of project\-related concerns.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture (B.Arch) – Mandatory
* Master’s Degree in Architecture (M.Arch) – Preferred
* COA Registration preferred
* Minimum 10\+ years of relevant experience in architectural design and project execution
* Experience working with reputed construction companies, developers, architectural consultancies, or design\-build organizations

**Technical SkillsMandatory Software Proficiency**

* AutoCAD
* Revit Architecture
* SketchUp
* Lumion
* V\-Ray
* Enscape
* Twinmotion
* Adobe Photoshop
* Microsoft Office Suite

**Rendering \& Visualization**

* Photorealistic Architectural Rendering
* 3D Visualization \& Walkthrough Creation
* Presentation Design \& Client Demonstrations
* BIM\-Based Coordination

**Core Competencies**

* High\-Rise Residential \& Apartment Design
* Residential Communities \& Township Planning
* Hospitality Architecture (Hotels \& Resorts)
* Educational \& Institutional Infrastructure Design
* Architectural Design Excellence
* Construction Documentation \& Detailing
* Building Codes \& Regulatory Compliance
* Project Management \& Coordination
* Site Execution \& Construction Support
* Team Leadership \& Mentoring
* Client Relationship Management
* Problem Solving \& Decision Making
* Quality Assurance \& Technical Review
* Communication \& Presentation Skills

**Preferred Experience**

* Luxury Residential \& Villa Projects
* High\-Rise Towers \& Apartment Developments
* Hospitality \& Resort Projects
* Educational Campuses \& Institutional Buildings
* Design\-Build \& Turnkey Construction Projects
* Sustainable Design \& Green Building Practices

**Preference Will Be Given To**  
Candidates with strong portfolios demonstrating successful delivery of high\-rise residential projects, large\-scale communities, hospitality developments, and institutional infrastructure projects from concept design through construction completion.  
**Immediate joiners are highly preferred.**

Pay: ₹19,935\.72 \- ₹95,931\.31 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance

c67155f7.title: Salesforce Commerce Cloud Front End PWA Developer
c67155f7.description:
Lokalizacja: Bangalore, Karnātaka, India
Kategoria: Technologie informatyczne
Identyfikacja stanowiska: R57996
widget: Full time
Marka: PVH
Non\-Retail
  
**About Us:**


We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH\+.

  



One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH **here**.


**POSITION SUMMARY:**

We are seeking an experienced Software Engineer (Web) with deep expertise in Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) and a specialization in PWA Kit / Composable Storefront. You will be responsible for designing and developing high\-performance, headless B2C eCommerce solutions.

  



The ideal candidate is an expert in React, who has been part of migration projects from different eCommerce platforms and from SFCC – SFRA into SFCC – PWA Kit, is an expert in Managed Runtime (MRT) , can establish and follow coding standards, resolve bugs, vulnerabilities created by QA and Code quality platforms tools like SonarQube, and bridge modern frontend frameworks with SFCC’s backend power.

  


**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES/ACCOUNTABILITIES OF THE JOB:**


* Develop Headless Features: Build and maintain PWA storefront features including PDP, PLP, Cart, and Checkout using the Retail React App template.


* Code Optimization: Lead the cleanup of the codebase by monitoring SonarQube reports and implementing architectural fixes to ensure high quality\-gate scores.


* API Orchestration: Implement and extend SCAPI/OCAPI integrations and handle complex data mapping between SFCC and the React frontend.


* Managed Runtime (MRT): Deploy and manage bundle versions and environment configurations within the Salesforce Managed Runtime.


* Security \& Auth: Implement secure shopper authentication using SLAS (Shopper Login and API Access Service).


* UI/UX Excellence: Translate Figma/high\-fidelity designs into responsive, accessible, and performant React components.


* Collaboration: Partner with Product, UX/UI, and Backend teams to ensure seamless end\-to\-end user journeys.


* Troubleshooting: Use SFCC Log Center, MRT logs, and browser debugging tools to resolve complex production issues.


* Team work: Participate in scrums and work with SI partners to deliver business requirements.

**INTERNAL \& EXTERNAL CONTACTS:**


* **Internal:** Works closely with business and technology teams, including engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders.


* **External:** Engages with technology vendors, consultants, and industry partners to stay updated on best practices and emerging trends.


**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Direct: None


* Indirect: Provide leadership \& guidance to outsourced vendor resources


**BUDGETARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Maintain the environment to minimize budget overflows

**DECISION MAKING:**


* Leads decision\-making on data product development and prioritization in collaboration with stakeholders.


* Recommends technology investments and improvements to enhance data product capabilities.


**RESOURCEFULNESS/CREATIVITY:**


* Ensures technology solutions align with business needs, emphasizing usability, scalability, and cost\-effectiveness.


* Requires strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to navigate complex business and technical challenges.


**ENVIRONMENT:** This role requires the ability to work in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple priorities effectively. Domestic and international travel may be required.

  


**QUALIFICATIONS \& EXPERIENCE:**

**Experience:**


* 5\+ years of software engineering experience.


* 2\+ Headless storefront implementation experience preferably with full cycle implementation of SFCC Composable storefront/PWA Kit.


* Expert\-level React knowledge, including Hooks, Context API, SSR (Server\-Side Rendering), and state management.


* Strong grasp of SFCC Core Concepts: Mastery of SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API) and OCAPI is essential.


* Code Quality Specialist: Proven experience resolving issues reported by Code quality platforms, including security vulnerabilities, code smells, and maintainability debt.


* Modern Frontend Stack: Expertise in Node.js, TypeScript, ES6\+, and Chakra UI (or similar CSS\-in\-JS libraries).


* Integration Expertise: Experience integrating with OMS, Payment Gateways (via SLAS), and third\-party services in a decoupled environment.


* Performance Mindset: Strong understanding of Core Web Vitals, Service Workers, and caching strategies within Managed Runtime.


* Agile/Scrum: Experience delivering scalable UI within fast\-paced Agile environments.

  


 

**Education:**


* Bachelor’s degree required, in any relevant business, liberal arts, STEM, or technology/engineering disciplines

  



 **Skills:**


* SFCC PWA Kit and Composable Storefront.


* Experience with 3rd Party tools like Optimizely, Content stack


* Experience with Mocha for automated testing.


* Knowledge of traditional SFRA (to assist in migration/logic extraction).


* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines.


* Languages: JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, JSON, SCSS.


* SFCC: PWA Kit, Composable Storefront, SCAPI, OCAPI, Business Manager, SLAS.


* Frontend: React (Expert), TypeScript, Node.js, CSS\-in\-JS (Chakra UI).


* Quality/DevOps: SonarQube, Git, Jira, Postman, Managed Runtime (MRT).


* Legacy Systems: SFRA, ISML (understanding required for migration logic).


* Note: **Apex\-only or traditional SFRA\-only profiles are NOT suitable;** this role requires deep React and Headless\-specific SFCC experience. Candidates must demonstrate the ability to refactor legacy logic into modern React patterns. Candidates must have recent, hands\-on experience with **PWA Kit implementation**.

*PVH Corp. or its subsidiary ("PVH") is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants for employment on the basis of their individual capabilities and qualifications without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military status or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law. In addition to complying with all applicable laws, PVH is also committed to ensuring that all current and future PVH associates are compensated solely on job\-related factors such as skill, ability, educational background, work quality, experience and potential.*

ae8d6dd0.title: Solution Architecture Manager
ae8d6dd0.description:
**Overview**  

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

 **Responsibilities**  

People Management  



  

Managers deliver success through empowerment and accountability by modeling, coaching, and caring.

  

Model \- Live our culture. Embody our values. Practice our leadership principles.

  

Coach \- Define team objectives and outcomes. Enable success across boundaries. Help the team adapt and learn.

  

Care \- Attract and retain great people. Know each individual’s capabilities and aspirations. Invest in the growth of others.

  

Understanding Customer/Partner Technical Environment

  

Provides support for their team in gathering and propagating customer/partner insights to help shape and form both the definition and ongoing execution of the project. Holds teams accountable for mapping architecture and digital transformation solutions to customer/partner business outcomes, and ensures that proposed solutions are aligned with broader organizational strategy. Leverages prior work, customer/partner insights, and industry trends, and shares insights with team to apply.

  

Supports their team in working with customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Development Team, Operations Team) and business sponsor to socialize both the business solution and the project approach. Advises team on managing changes and facilitating feedback. Uses broad patterns of feedback to develop strategic and actionable insights and presents a compelling business case to program managers that influences product roadmaps and decision making. Contributes to Microsoft\-centric operations and cadences to align with customer feedback.

  

Drives internal advocacy by facilitating insight sharing with Product Engineering teams, and providing guidance through escalation, acceleration, and prioritization. Looks across multiple customers/partners for opportunities to consolidate and prioritize items across the business. Mentors peers and teams on best practices around internal resources usage. When appropriate, establishes accountabilities to drive customer outcomes and ensure internal stakeholders are in place. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams.

  

Architecture Design and Deployment

  

Holds teams accountable for leveraging existing architecture approaches to achieve Microsoft's agreed commitments to the customer/partner and developing new solutions to scale across multiple customers/partners and markets. When appropriate, governs areas of fiscal responsibility, through delivery team, staying within budget while driving engagement profitability and risk management.

  

Guides team in defining and documenting the architecture through an architecture description document, an architecture decisions log, and a requirements/constraints traceability matrix. Ensures team is equipped to communicate the value proposition of the business solution along with the project approach. Guides team in cost\-based and technology\-based discussions to explain the architecture in terms of its build, deployment, and ongoing operational use to determine customer appetite for the business solution. Promotes a business\-value approach that values return on investment (ROI) and customer costs\-savings over technical ease of execution. Provides coaching to allow architects to scale solutions. Support new customer opportunities in partnership with Sales with highly significant or global impacts for Microsoft, as needed.

  

Collaborates with the other managers to jointly drive project/technical governance of the design, build, and deployment into use of proof of concepts (POCs) and pilots. Provides end\-to\-end governance, oversight, and thought leadership within assigned account. Provides guidance to team in understanding and demonstrating business value (e.g., release of revenue, cost savings) that the business solution realizes.

  

Guides team in working with the business sponsor and customer/partner stakeholders (e.g., Business users, Enterprise Architects, Security Team, Operations Team) to gather and ratify requirements and constraints. Supports team in managing and resolving highly complex ambiguity in the requirements and constraints and documents assumptions and implications where it cannot be resolved. Ensures maintenance of the requirements/constraints traceability matrix to prove that solution components have a rationale/justification for inclusion in the architecture of the business solution. Oversees development and execution of test plans to prove that each requirement/constraint has been implemented as expected by the customer.

  

Leads team in collaborating to understand the business solution/problem. Drives agreement, based on the customer’s priorities, requirements/constraints, approach, principles, concepts, and expectations. Ensures team builds and documents a realistically costed, advanced/complex solution approach. Provides thought leadership on oversight and governance sets expectations for quality practices and standards to realize the business solution. Promotes a cohesive build methodology so the solution can be transitioned to live operations, leveraging solution expertise. Ensures communication of and adherence to the pre\-sales value proposition. Ensures that customer opportunities, questions, and/or issues are brought to the appropriate internal teams. When appropriate, negotiates, collaborates on, reviews, and contributes to deal approval processes. Challenges deal construct to ensure Microsoft initiatives are incorporated appropriately. Communicates current view of delivery to customer executives on regular cadence, as needed. When appropriate, oversees a broad portfolio of accounts. Manages and ensures the all\-up delivery of consulting engagements, as necessary. Innovates and implements long\-term, strategic plans, in partnership with Sales to create new opportunities and sustainable growth for customer accounts across the portfolio, as needed. Ensures delivery team alignment and holds delivery team accountable for delivering on sales strategy.

  

Creates a culture and clarity around technical insights and escalations, and ensures broad sets of projects move forward. Provides support and guidance to team in identifying scenarios that could slow or impede pre\-sales/delivery. Anticipates blockers and resolves escalations as needed and coaches team on best practices for handling escalations. Ensures that issues and blockers and addressed by the appropriate groups. Identifies widespread patterns in blockers across business areas or territories. Develops strategies to prevent blockers and issues in the future. When necessary, attends steering committee meetings with strategic customers to remove blockers and ensure delivery success.

  

Works in close collaboration with the Project Manager and Account Team to anticipate, identify, categorize, and communicate business and technical risks. Defines risk mitigation activities that are foundational to the project plan. Defines risk contingency plans for invocation should the risk occur. Outlines methodology and governance principles and practices for the broader organization that allows others to minimize risks.

  

Practice Development

  

Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Anticipates and addresses organization\- and industry\-wide gaps, patterns, and needs to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re\-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre\-sales and delivery. Leads and contributes to internal/external communities.

  

Trusted Advisor

  

Develops a deep network of internal/external relationships with senior\-level decision makers at high\-impact customers/partners to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. Provides guidance to others in doing so. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.  



  

Coaches team to use evidence\-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Leverages network and industry experience to connect customers/partners with ideas, people, and resources to support their success. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. Proactively resolves conflicts and seeks resolution to balance the overall outcome. Drives consensus where possible and leads decisions to resolve conflict when needed and guides team in doing so.

  

Drives awareness across all levels of the organization of partner challenges, industry trends, and competitor architectures to allow team members to engage with partners, demonstrate Microsoft's value, and develop counter strategy. Holds team accountable for leading the adoption of Microsoft technologies.

  

Thought Leadership

  

Fosters community sharing of stories and leveraging of pre\-existing resources by encouraging and empowering team to share learnings and by establishing a cadence (e.g., internal technical brainstorming calls, presenting latest challenges in staff meetings) to calibrate on challenges and trends that impact the team at the corporate level. Holds teams across all organizational levels accountable for sharing insights with virtual team members, including C\-level leaders, to inform the direction they take with customers/partners.

  

Initiates and drives external architect community events (e.g., conferences, seminars, technical meetups, Webcasts, blogs, hackathons). Acts a mentor to less experienced colleagues by educating them on technical and non\-technical concepts and sharing best practices. Serves as an industry\-leading expert and drives recognition for Microsoft solutions through presentations and engagements with external audiences and publishing white papers around key technical topics and/or architecture design templates.

  

Other

  

Embody our culture and values

 **Qualifications**  

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  

Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12\+ years' experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security))

  

OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 10\+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR equivalent experience.

  

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

  

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 15\+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR Master's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND 12\+ years experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security)

  

OR equivalent experience.

  

8\+ years technical sales experience.

  

8\+ years project management experience.

  

4\+ years managing multiple, complex projects or portfolios.

  

2\+ years experience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams.

  

5\+ years people management experience, including managing consultant practice managers, technical sales managers, and/or technical architect managers.

  

Technical or Professional Certification in Domain (e.g., Security).

  

  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

  

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

a2feb554.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
a2feb554.description:
**Introduction**
 At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you’ll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co\-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You’ll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world\-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that’s passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 Senior Solutions Engineers drives not only the early\-stage evaluation within the sales process, but also play a crucial role in enabling ongoing value\-realization for customers, all while helping them move up the adoption maturity curve. In this role you’ll partner with Account Executives to be the key technical advisor in service of the customers. You’ll be instrumental in surfacing the customers stated or implicit Business Needs, and coming up with Technical Designs to best meet these needs. You may find yourself at times facilitating art of the possible discussions and storytelling to inspire customers in adopting new patterns with confidence, and at other times driving creative solutioning to help get past difficult technical roadblocks. Overall, we look upon Solutions Engineers to be a key cog within the Customer Success Team that help foster an environment of sustained success for the customer and incremental adoption of Confluent’s Technology.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Help advance new \& innovative Data Streaming use\-cases from conception to Go\-Live
   

  

 Execute on and lead Technical Proofs of Concept
   

  

 Conduct Discovery \& Whiteboard Sessions to develop new use\-cases
   

  

 Provide Thought Leadership by delivering Technical Talks and Workshops
   

  

 Guide customers with hands\-on help and best practice to drive operational maturity of their Confluent Deployment
   

  

 Analyze Customer Consumption trends and identify Optimization opportunities
   

  

 Work closely with Product and Engineering teams, and serve as a key Product advocate across the Customer, Partner and Industry ecosystem
   

  

 Forge strong relationships with key customer stakeholders and serve as a dependable partner for them
   

  

**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
 Solutions Engineering or similar work experience
   

  

 Experience with Open Source Flink
   

  

 Experience with Event\-Driven architecture, Data Integration \& Processing Techniques, Database \& Data Warehouse technologies
   

  

 First\-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment \& Application Development
   

  

 Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes
   

  

 Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL
   

  

 Technical certifications \- Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering \& Integration
   

  

 Clear, consistent demonstration of self\-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems
   

  

 Exceptional presentation and communications capabilities.
   

  

 Confidence presenting to a highly skilled and experienced audience, ranging from developers to enterprise architects and up to C\-level executives

 by deploying

 .

 to work

 for real\-world impact.

 at the intersection of

 — ensuring enterprises not only deploy agentic systems, but transform their

 **shaping the future of intelligent systems**

ec9cd1eb.title: Solution Architect - JAVA
ec9cd1eb.description:
**ASSA ABLOY** is a global leader in access solutions, dedicated to shaping the future of security and convenience. With a rich heritage spanning over 150 years, ASSA ABLOY has built a reputation for delivering innovative and reliable locking and access control solutions. Their diverse portfolio includes well\-known brands like Yale, HID Global, and Mul\-T\-Lock, offering a comprehensive range of products and services to meet the unique needs of customers worldwide. From residential and commercial buildings to critical infrastructure and healthcare facilities, ASSA ABLOY's cutting\-edge technologies ensure safety, security, and seamless user experiences. With a commitment to sustainability and customer satisfaction, ASSA ABLOY continues to drive advancements in access solutions for a safer and more connected world.

  

**SUMMARY**:


The Solution Architect (SA) works within a targeted domain and focuses on the conversion of requirements into software solutions. The SA leverages experience in developing the blueprint for an IT solution, consistent with company standards and industry best practices. Responsibilities include working with business users to define the project scope; developing architecture and detail design; formulating and executing project plans.

  

**SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES:**


* Design and define scalable, secure, and high\-performance Java\-based application architectures.
* Translate application requirements into software solutions that adhere to software architecture and implementation standards.
* Lead architecture discussions and provide technical guidance to development teams.
* Define technology stacks, frameworks, and development standards for projects.
* Design and implement microservices, REST APIs, and integration solutions.
* Review application designs and code to ensure quality, scalability, and compliance with application requirements and implementation standards.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, project managers, and cross\-functional teams to deliver software solutions that meet business needs and expectations.
* Ensure application security through industry\-standard authentication, authorization, and data protection mechanisms.
* Identify and resolve performance, scalability, and reliability challenges.
* Define database, messaging, and integration architectures to support software solutions.
* Establish architecture governance, best practices, and technical standards across projects.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions to improve business outcomes.
* Mentor developers and technical leads on architecture principles and best practices.
* Conduct architecture reviews, risk assessments, and technical solution evaluations.
* Support project estimation, technical planning, and solution roadmaps.
* Identify technical risks and provide mitigation strategies.
* Develop and finalize solution proposal and/or presentation of recommended solutions.
* Ensure solutions are maintainable, reusable, and aligned with software solution objectives.
* Developing software using JAVA, Spring framework, Hibernate, MySQL, Smart GWT framework.

  

**RELATIONSHIPS/CONTACTS:**


* Reports directly to the Manager, Application Development.
* Works with employees at all levels of the organization.
* This position does not have any direct reports.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS:**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must meet expectations of each essential duty. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills and abilities required.

  

**EDUCATION:**


Preferred graduate degree in computer science/engineering/information technology.

  

**EXPERIENCE:**


* Minimum 15\+ years of progressive experience in Java application development, solution architecture, system design, and enterprise application delivery.
* Minimum 4\+ years of experience in a Solution Architect or Technical Architect role, designing and delivering large\-scale, mission\-critical applications.

  

**TECHNICAL KNOWLEDGE and/or ABILITIES:**


* Extensive experience designing and delivering enterprise\-scale applications using Java and related technologies.
* Strong expertise in Java, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, Hibernate/JPA, and RESTful API development.
* Experience designing and implementing Microservices Architectures and distributed systems.
* Proficiency with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
* Strong knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency with build and dependency management tools such as Maven and Gradle.
* Strong experience with Git\-based source code management and branching strategies.
* Expertise in relational databases, data modelling, SQL optimization, and database integration.
* Strong knowledge of application security, authentication, authorization, OAuth2, JWT, and secure coding practices.
* Experience conducting architecture reviews, defining technical standards, and establishing governance frameworks.
* Strong understanding of object\-oriented design principles, design patterns, and software architecture best practices.
* Ability to evaluate emerging technologies and recommend solutions that align with business and technical objectives.

  

**COMPETENCIES:**


* Strong leadership and team mentoring skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
* Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Experience leading cross\-functional, onshore, and offshore teams.
* Ability to drive architecture decisions and technical governance.
* Effective prioritization and multitasking in fast\-paced environments.
* Strong collaboration and relationship\-building skills.
* Proactive, self\-motivated, and results\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage technical risks and dependencies.
* Commitment to innovation, continuous improvement, and best practices.

  

**We are the ASSA ABLOY Group**
  

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

bd5360a4.title: Senior Manager, Global Connectivity, Cloud and Automation
bd5360a4.description:
Lage: Bangalore, Karnātaka, India
Kategorie: Informationstechnologie
Job\-ID: R61650
widget: Full time
Marke: PVH
Non\-Retail
  
**About Us:**


We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH\+.

  



One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH **here**.


**About the Role:**


The Sr Manager of Connectivity, Cloud and Automation serves as the enterprise leader for security‑focused cloud networking, global connectivity platforms, and automation engineering. This role defines and drives the strategy, architecture, delivery, and operational excellence of next‑generation network security, cloud connectivity, DNS/DHCP/IPAM platforms, automation frameworks, and reliability engineering practices.

  



**What You'll Do:**


**Strategic Leadership \& Architecture**


* Define and own the enterprise strategy for network security, cloud networking, connectivity platforms, and automation.
* Establish target‑state architectures across firewalls, cloud networking, DNS/DHCP/IPAM, observability, automation, and connectivity services.
* Align enterprise cloud, identity, and zero trust security standards.

  

**Security \& Cloud Networking**


* Check Point \& Cisco Firepower, F5 LTM/GTM/APM, NAC, AWS networking, Zero Trust integrations.
* Lead strategy and lifecycle of firewalls, IDS/IPS, URL filtering, and NAC.
* Oversee cloud networking for AWS and hybrid cloud environments.
* Drive Zero Trust integrations.

  

**Connectivity Platform \& Automation**


* DNS/DHCP/IPAM (Infoblox), Public DNS \& Domains, Akamai GTM/Geo, certificate management, automation (Terraform, Ansible, Python, Git), observability, reliability engineering, SRE practices, ITSM/ITIL stewardship.
* Own DNS, DHCP, IPAM, domain services, global traffic management.
* Lead automation strategy using Terraform, Ansible, Python, and Git.
* Implement observability and SRE frameworks.
* Manage digital certificate lifecycle.

  

**Vendor \& Platform Management**


* Lead strategic vendor partnerships and contract optimization.
* Ensure global platform resiliency and service delivery.

  

**Operational Excellence**


* Ensure network availability, performance, and scalability.
* Drive automation, AIOps, and reliability improvements.
* Lead governance representing Connectivity, Security, Automation services.

  

**Collaboration \& Leadership**


* Act as a trusted advisor to senior IT and business leaders on Network technology strategy and design.
* Collaborate with global teams across Security, Infrastructure, Enterprise Architecture, and Infrastructure \& Operations.
* Represent Network in global governance forums and architecture boards.
* Mentor engineers, fostering technical excellence, innovation, and accountability

  



**What You'll Bring:**


* 12\+ years in network security, cloud networking, or connectivity architecture, with 5\+ years leading teams
* Expertise in firewalls, SASE/Zero Trust, cloud networking (AWS), DNS/DHCP/IPAM, load balancing, NAC, and automation
* Experience leading global platform engineering and modernization
* Strong vendor and stakeholder management skills
* Experience with budget management and business case development / investment justification
* Bachelor’s Degree in Arts/Sciences (BA/BS) Engineering or Computer Science required
* Master’s degree in Arts/Sciences (MA/MS) preferred
* People management, coaching, and development experience required
* Strategic and analytical thinker with the ability to balance vision with execution
* Collaborative and inclusive leader who fosters global teamwork and shared accountability
* Continuous learner with curiosity about emerging technologies and their business impact
* Strong communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and simplify complex technical narratives
* Ownership mindset – accountable for technology / architecture integrity and driving measurable business outcomes

  

**Licenses and Certifications:**


* CCNA \- Cisco Certified Network Technician/Cisco Certified Network Architect Required
* AWS Certified Solution Architect/AWS Advanced Networking Required
* CCNP \- Cisco Certified Network Professional/Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert Preferred
* CCDP \- Cisco Certified Design Professional Preferred
* CISSP Certified Information Systems Security Professional Preferred
* Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Preferred

  

**Physical Demands Category:** Corporate Office


* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.

  



**Travel**


* Domestic: Minimal (1–10%) – Occasional travel, a few times a year.


* International: Minimal (1–10%) – Occasional travel, a few times a year.

  



**Communication Responsibilities:**


* Obtaining \& providing information to others


* Explaining policies or practices to others


* Influencing others


* Negotiating with others to come to agreement


* Negotiating with others with long\-term strategic importance to the business

  



**Scope of Communication:**


* Within own Department at PVH


* Across Departments at PVH


* Across Business Units/Brands at PVH


* Outside of PVH

  



**Overall Impact \& Contribution:**


* Sets objectives for self and others and delivers results that impacts the organization


*PVH Corp. or its subsidiary ("PVH") is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants for employment on the basis of their individual capabilities and qualifications without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military status or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law. In addition to complying with all applicable laws, PVH is also committed to ensuring that all current and future PVH associates are compensated solely on job\-related factors such as skill, ability, educational background, work quality, experience and potential.*

 We expect engineers to apply critical thinking to all AI‑generated outputs—validating accuracy, quality, and relevance before applying them in production environments. We view AI maturity as a spectrum, progressing from foundational adoption toward more strategic, advocacy‑driven integration, and you will play an active role in that journey.

* Excellent time management and organization skills, with the capability to manage multiple competing priorities
* Exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate, partner and collaborate
* Willingness to go the extra mile
* Dedication to achieving outstanding customer results with a team\-oriented drive and a demonstrated ability to lead by example
* Aptitude to pick up new concepts and technology rapidly; ability to explain it to both business \& IT stakeholders
* Open to work from 1:00 \- 10:00 PM IST


 You demonstrate a strong Growth Mindset—embracing curiosity, continuous learning, and adaptability in a fast‑changing technology environment. You are comfortable speaking about AI with confidence and conviction, and you view AI as an enabler to improve outcomes rather than a substitute for sound engineering principles.
   

  

 You challenge assumptions, learn quickly from change, and apply critical thinking to validate outputs and make informed decisions. You bring a thoughtful, quality‑driven approach to your work and actively contribute to a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

 XenonStack is the fastest\-growing

 .

 **AI \+ Human Intelligence**

 **trustworthy, explainable, and production\-ready** 
 .

 **Agentic AI at scale** 
 .
   

  

 This role goes beyond traditional software or ML architecture — you will define how
 **LLMs, tools, memory, and orchestration frameworks**

 .

 **AgentOps ecosystem** 
 .

* Architecture Design

+ Architect scalable, modular, and extensible agentic systems aligned with enterprise needs.

* Context \& Memory Orchestration
+ Design context pipelines using RAG, knowledge graphs, APIs, and multi\-tiered memory (short\-term, episodic, long\-term).
+ Ensure efficient token management and context allocation for reliability and cost efficiency.

* Integration \& Ecosystem
